tBYXtWARDQm_4vJR_H_4Hw.zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥州立大學(SDSU),今年9月累計報告14例病例,受影響者為該校球隊隊員。因應疫情,校方已免費提供學生疫苗追加劑。
tBYXtWARDQm_4vJR_H_4Hw.en: San Diego State University (SDSU) in California, USA, has reported a cumulative 14 mumps cases this September; those affected are members of the university's sports teams. In response, the university has provided free mumps vaccine booster doses to students.

wkGaehQ5K-mMBAn6EX_62w.zh: 美國紐約州今年截至10/3累計108例確定病例,鑑於該州及鄰近地區病例增加,於10/5發佈行政命令,宣佈進入緊急狀態,主要擴大疫苗施打對象,並持續提供臨床指引、病例調查與接觸者追蹤及加速實驗室檢驗。該國今年截至10/2累計47個行政區報告3,887例確定病例,已逾去年全年2,289例,95%為未接種疫苗或情況不明,其中以賓州(963例)、南卡羅萊納(670例)及猶他州(535例)為主。 澳洲南澳州阿德萊德(Adelaide)某中學發生群聚,截至9/24累計5例確定病例,該州今年迄今累計9例確定病例,去年全年僅7 例。澳洲今年病例持續增加,截至9月底累計119例,低於去年全年181例,惟已明顯高於2022‒24年同期及全年水準。病例主要與海外感染及輸入病例相關,該國提供未接種2劑疫苗者免費施打疫苗。 敘利亞今年截至第33週累計765例經實驗室檢驗之確定病例,當局與UNICEF、WHO等國際組織合作,於7月下旬在高風險地區啟動疫苗接種措施。
wkGaehQ5K-mMBAn6EX_62w.en: New York State has reported 108 confirmed cases this year as of 3 October. Given the rise in cases in the state and neighbouring areas, it issued an executive order on 5 October declaring a state of emergency, mainly expanding the eligible population for vaccination, and continues to provide clinical guidance, case investigation, contact tracing and accelerated laboratory testing. As of 2 October, the United States had reported 3,887 confirmed cases this year across 47 jurisdictions, already exceeding the 2,289 cases reported for all of last year; 95% were unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination status, mainly in Pennsylvania (963 cases), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). A cluster has occurred at a secondary school in Adelaide, South Australia, with 5 confirmed cases as of 24 September; the state has recorded 9 confirmed cases this year, compared with only 7 for all of last year. Australia has 119 cumulative cases as of the end of September, below the 181 for all of last year but clearly above the same period and full-year levels for 2022–24. Cases are mainly linked to overseas infection and imported cases, and the country provides free vaccination to people who have not received two doses. Syria has reported 765 laboratory-confirmed cases as of week 33 this year; working with UNICEF, WHO and other international organisations, authorities launched vaccination in high-risk areas in late July.

wqqBq_-tVYXrfxMRz-cHMg.zh: 美國今年截至10/5累計報告987例病例,疫情多集中於加州,其中加州洛杉磯郡今年截至10/1累計報告135例病例,其中5例死亡,有130例需住院,疫情高於去(2025)年全年的22例與2例死亡。另紐澤西州亦於10/5報告今年首例死亡個案,當局警告秋季氣溫降低之際仍須嚴防蚊蟲叮咬,呼籲⺠眾落實清除積水容器。
wqqBq_-tVYXrfxMRz-cHMg.en: As of 5 October this year, the United States has reported 987 cases, concentrated mainly in California. Los Angeles County, California, has reported 135 cases as of 1 October this year, including 5 deaths, with 130 requiring hospitalisation. This is higher than the 22 cases and 2 deaths reported for all of 2025. New Jersey also reported its first death of the year on 5 October. Authorities warn that cooling autumn temperatures do not end the risk, and urge people to continue guarding against mosquito bites and to clear containers holding standing water.

Vr0SYNlkLZUapzZA_Ghn6w.zh: 美國9/25報告13例感染大腸桿菌(O26:H11)病例,其中8例住院,有3例併發溶血性尿毒症候群(HUS),分布於加州等9個州,超過一半病例為5歲以下,發病日介於7/7-8/26。經當局調查,病患皆曾食用某生產商製造之生乳起司,已要求產品下架並溯源調查。
Vr0SYNlkLZUapzZA_Ghn6w.en: On 25 September, the United States reported 13 cases of E. coli O26:H11 infection, 8 of whom were hospitalised and 3 of whom developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS). Cases are distributed across 9 states including California, more than half are under 5 years old, and onset dates range from 7 July to 26 August. Authorities' investigation found that all patients had eaten raw-milk cheese made by a certain producer; the product has been ordered off the market and a traceback investigation is under way.

oVG2ymNW-1_iEFfCW4jDuQ.zh: 美國伊利諾州報告2例確定病例,個案均曾於今年8月前往某飯店,當局已進行環境調查及水質採樣,並已關閉相關設施,部分設施的供水系統檢體檢測陽性。
oVG2ymNW-1_iEFfCW4jDuQ.en: Illinois, USA, has reported 2 confirmed cases, both of whom visited a certain hotel in August this year. Authorities have carried out an environmental investigation and water sampling and have closed the relevant facilities; water-system samples from some of the facilities tested positive.

ifynwbcjkqJ-AGIl9IpV6w.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至9/28,累計47個州/地區報告3,659例確定病例、2例死亡,95%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明,以5-19歲(1,577例)佔43%為多,其中以賓州(850例)、南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(535例)等地為主。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至9/28,累計報告13,484例確定病例、22例死亡,其中以哈利斯科州(Jalisco)7,266例為多、其次為首都墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,033例;年齡分佈以1-4歲2,692例為多,其次為5-9歲(2,398例)及25-29歲(2,234例)。 秘魯今年截至9/25,累計報告2,438例確定病例,1例死亡,為洛雷托大區(Loreto)16歲未接種疫苗男孩,因麻疹併發症(包括肺炎)死亡。由於該區地理偏遠、交通不便等因素,致疫苗接種、病例追蹤與醫療服務等,面臨挑戰。
ifynwbcjkqJ-AGIl9IpV6w.en: US measles cases continue to rise. As of 28 September this year, 3,659 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported across 47 states/jurisdictions; 95% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and ages 5–19 (1,577 cases, 43%) accounted for the largest share. The largest numbers are in Pennsylvania (850), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). Mexico's epidemic continues: as of 28 September this year, 13,484 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, with Jalisco (7,266 cases) having the most, followed by the capital, Mexico City (1,033 cases). By age, the largest numbers were among those aged 1–4 (2,692), followed by 5–9 years (2,398) and 25–29 years (2,234). As of 25 September this year, Peru has reported 2,438 confirmed cases and one death: a 16-year-old unvaccinated boy in the Loreto region who died of measles complications, including pneumonia. Because the region is geographically remote and hard to reach, vaccination, case tracing and healthcare services face challenges.

l5eaNCYVnh2c6_RbaX5JSQ.zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥州立大學(SDSU),於今年9/18報告3例確定病例及2例可能(probable)病例。皆為同校學生,已啟動接觸者追蹤,並進行症狀篩檢及提供疫苗接種。該國今年截至9/10累計31州報告157例確定病例。
l5eaNCYVnh2c6_RbaX5JSQ.en: San Diego State University (SDSU) in California, USA, reported 3 confirmed cases and 2 probable cases on 18 September this year. All are students at the same university. Contact tracing has been initiated, with symptom screening and vaccination provided. As of 10 September this year, 31 states had cumulatively reported 157 confirmed cases in the country.

d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

j4iuKXFIJjwREzU4OchdxQ.zh: 孟加拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至9/20累計報告6萬1,972例病例,其中184例死亡,9月新增2萬6,126例病例及87例死亡,創今年單月最高紀錄。該國已於9月初啟動為期3個月之全國防疫計畫,加強病媒蚊孳生源清除與衛教宣導。 美國佛羅里達州本土疫情持續擴大,今年迄今累計報告152例病例,疫情多集中於希爾斯波羅郡(Hillsborough County),其中9/18報告1例死亡病例,血清型以第2型(DENV-2)為多,當局已擴大病媒蚊噴藥與孳生源清除,提醒⺠眾落實個人防蚊措施,並加強對重症之監測。
j4iuKXFIJjwREzU4OchdxQ.en: Bangladesh's epidemic is severe. As of 20 September this year, 61,972 cases and 184 deaths have been reported cumulatively; 26,126 new cases and 87 deaths were recorded in September alone, the highest monthly figure this year. At the start of September, the country launched a three-month nationwide prevention programme, strengthening the removal of mosquito breeding sites and health education. In the United States, locally acquired dengue in Florida continues to expand: 152 cases have been reported so far this year, concentrated in Hillsborough County. One death was reported on 18 September. Serotype 2 (DENV-2) predominates. Authorities have expanded mosquito spraying and breeding-site removal, urged people to take personal mosquito-protection measures, and strengthened surveillance of severe cases.

Izt40JwE0k2ay1DjeH1l9g.zh: 美國截至9/11累計報告1萬2,883例確定病例,其中570例住院及2 例死亡,疫情影響31個州,高於去年同期疫情(5-8月報告1,180例),最後1例於8/17發病,當局業於9/11宣布此波疫情結束,疫情主要感染來源為墨西哥生產的結球萵苣,相關單位仍持續於加工廠採樣調查中。
Izt40JwE0k2ay1DjeH1l9g.en: As of 11 September, the United States has cumulatively reported 12,883 confirmed cases, including 570 hospitalisations and 2 deaths, affecting 31 states. This is higher than the same period last year (1,180 cases reported May–August). The last case had onset on 17 August, and on 11 September authorities declared the outbreak over. The main source of infection was head lettuce grown in Mexico; relevant agencies continue to sample and investigate at processing plants.

V_taC8E7Ipo9TmVFVGAKNA.zh: 美國自2026年7月以來,多個地區通報人類暴露風險呈增加趨勢,CDC於7-8月接獲之相關諮詢較2025年同期增加17%,且至少有8個州衛生部門反映PEP使用增加或發生施打錯誤情形。截至9/2止,疫苗及免疫球蛋白之使用量分別較去年同期增加約33% 及76%,惟目前無藥品供應短缺情形。該疾病暴露事件通常在夏季較為常見,主要與⺠眾戶外活動增加、接觸野生動物機會提高有關。在該國50個州中,目前僅夏威夷州為非狂犬病疫區。 WHO於今年9/4宣布不丹成功消除犬隻傳播的人類狂犬病,為東南亞區第一個達成之國家。該國自2023年6月迄未再發生犬傳人之死亡案例。WHO消除認證標準要求至少連續2年無相關人類死亡病例,並具備完善公衛監測、實驗室診斷、犬隻疫苗接種及暴露後預防處置(PEP)等整備能力。
V_taC8E7Ipo9TmVFVGAKNA.en: Since July 2026, several US regions have reported a rising trend in human exposure risk. CDC received 17% more related consultations in July and August than in the same period of 2025, and at least eight state health departments reported increased use of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) or administration errors. As of 2 September, vaccine and immunoglobulin use had risen by about 33% and 76% respectively compared with the same period last year, but there is currently no drug shortage. Such exposure events are usually more common in summer, mainly because of increased outdoor activity and greater contact with wildlife. Of the 50 states, only Hawaii is currently rabies-free. WHO announced on 4 September this year that Bhutan had successfully eliminated dog-mediated human rabies, the first country in the South-East Asia Region to do so. Bhutan has recorded no dog-transmitted human deaths since June 2023. WHO elimination certification requires at least two consecutive years without related human deaths, as well as adequate public health surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, dog vaccination and PEP preparedness.

xDTyh6KXKhAKngDhlHrBsg.zh: 美國紐約市南布朗克斯區(South Bronx)發生群聚,截至9/14累計報告11例確定病例,3例住院、1例死亡,當局已啟動調查,並針對受影響區域之冷卻水塔進行實驗室檢測及清消作業。
xDTyh6KXKhAKngDhlHrBsg.en: A cluster has occurred in South Bronx, New York City, USA. As of 14 September, 11 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, with 3 hospitalised and one death. Authorities have launched an investigation and are testing and disinfecting the cooling towers in the affected area.

QkWx_T6ZifDX1nNOfpTTGw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/22(第33週),計17個國家/地區累計報告51,027例確定病例及55例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4.6倍,96%病例來自瓜地馬拉(32,566例)、墨西哥(12,607例)、美國(2,777例)及加拿大(1,117例)。
QkWx_T6ZifDX1nNOfpTTGw.en: Americas regional update: as of 22 August this year (week 33), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 51,027 confirmed cases and 55 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about 4.6 times the number in the same period last year. 96% of cases came from Guatemala (32,566), Mexico (12,607), the United States (2,777) and Canada (1,117).

Y4E-BQz4OUIQU10UFCSlrg.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續上升,今年截至9月初累計報告42,590例住院病例,其中117例死亡,疫情已擴散至全國64個行政區,9/6單日新增1,558例住院病例,達今年高峰,各地醫院病床不堪負荷。當局警告9月疫情將更為嚴峻,單月住院病例恐突破3萬例,評估疫情可能延燒至10月。同時該國現亦承受麻疹疫情壓力(今年累計近千名兒童死亡),醫療與公衛雙重壓力遽升。 美國佛羅里達州本土疫情持續升溫,今年截至8/29累計報告73 例本土確定病例,其中近一週新增32例,新增病例主要集中於坦帕灣(Tampa Bay area),以第2型血清型(DENV-2)為多。當局已啟動空中與地面聯合噴藥作業,進行成蚊撲滅與蚊子幼蟲防治,呼籲⺠眾落實個人防護與清除孳生源。
Y4E-BQz4OUIQU10UFCSlrg.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to rise: as of early September this year, 42,590 hospitalised cases and 117 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 64 districts nationwide, and on 6 September 1,558 hospitalised cases were added in a single day, the highest this year, with hospital beds across the country overloaded. Authorities warn that the epidemic will be more severe in September, with monthly hospitalisations possibly exceeding 30,000, and assess that it may continue into October. The country is also under pressure from a measles epidemic (nearly 1,000 children have died this year), placing a sharp dual burden on health and public health systems. In Florida, USA, locally acquired dengue continues to rise: as of 29 August this year, 73 locally acquired confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 32 of them in the past week. New cases are concentrated in the Tampa Bay area, mainly serotype 2 (DENV-2). Authorities have launched joint aerial and ground spraying to kill adult mosquitoes and control larvae, and urge people to take personal protective measures and remove breeding sources.

dFMj7vj2uLjNHpNAdcZ_kg.zh: 美國東北部紐約州、紐澤西州、賓夕法亞州及馬里蘭州於2026 年7月底至8月下旬分別報告蝙蝠、土撥鼠、郊狼及浣熊等4件動物狂犬病案例。各事件地理上彼此分散,無流行病學關聯,均已進行動物處置、接觸者調查及暴露後預防接種措施,未報告次級傳播人類感染事件,當局呼籲遭動物抓咬傷者應儘速就醫評估。
dFMj7vj2uLjNHpNAdcZ_kg.en: In late July to late August 2026, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Maryland in the north-eastern United States each reported animal rabies cases, involving bats, groundhogs, coyotes and raccoons, four cases in total. The events are geographically dispersed and epidemiologically unrelated. Animal control measures, contact investigations and post-exposure prophylaxis have been carried out in each case; no secondary human infection has been reported. Authorities urge anyone bitten or scratched by an animal to seek medical assessment promptly.

lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.zh: 南非今年截至8/16(第33週),累計報告3,891例確定病例,較上週增加144例,1-14歲兒童佔總病例數之70%,新增病例以西開普省38例為多,其次為林波波省30例及北開普省20例;疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為主要因素,1歲以下未接種疫苗比例從2017年12.1%上升至2026年36.3%,該國優先針對未接種疫苗或尚未完整接種之兒童進行補接種作業。 秘魯今年截至第33週報告1,747例確定病例,其中以普諾地區(1,264例)為多,由於病例數增加,該國衛生部發佈流行病學警報,針對醫療機構加強流行病學監測及早期發現,並在受影響地區採取防治措施。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/8(第31週),計17個國家/地區累積報告48,690例確定病例及51例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4倍,97%病例來自瓜地馬拉(31,140例)、墨西哥(12,479例)、美國(2,465例)及加拿大(1,114例),部分國家通報延遲,研判疫情可能低估。
lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.en: South Africa: as of 16 August this year (week 33), 3,891 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of 144 over the previous week; children aged 1–14 account for 70% of total cases. The largest numbers of new cases are in Western Cape (38), followed by Limpopo (30) and Northern Cape (20). Insufficient vaccination coverage is the main factor: the proportion of unvaccinated children under 1 year old rose from 12.1% in 2017 to 36.3% in 2026. The country is prioritising catch-up vaccination for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children. Peru: as of week 33 this year, 1,747 confirmed cases have been reported, mainly in the Puno region (1,264 cases). Because case numbers are rising, the Ministry of Health has issued an epidemiological alert, strengthening surveillance and early detection in healthcare facilities and taking control measures in affected areas. Americas regional update: as of 8 August this year (week 31), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 48,690 confirmed cases and 51 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about four times the number in the same period last year; 97% of cases came from Guatemala (31,140), Mexico (12,479), the United States (2,465) and Canada (1,114). Because some countries reported with delays, the outbreak is likely underestimated.

SA36WHr6CAP9fJ4oPWpoUw.zh: 美國路易斯安那州報告1例罕見確定病例,病患為7歲兒童,於克萊本湖游泳後感染並住院治療。該病原體常存在夏季溫暖淡水中,所引發腦膜腦炎症狀進展快速,致死率逾97%以上,惟未具人傳人能力,整體人群感染風險極低,此案為該州自1937年以來第4例個案。該國於1937-2025年間計180例病例,每年確定病例約0至8例。當局提醒⺠眾戲水時,應避免將頭部浸入水中及攪動淺水區之底部泥沙,以降低感染風險。
SA36WHr6CAP9fJ4oPWpoUw.en: Louisiana, USA, has reported one rare confirmed case in a 7-year-old child, who was infected after swimming in Lake Claiborne and was hospitalised for treatment. The pathogen is commonly found in warm fresh water in summer. The meningoencephalitis it causes progresses rapidly, with a case fatality rate above 97%, but it cannot spread from person to person, so the overall risk of infection in the population is extremely low. This is the fourth case in the state since 1937. Nationally, 180 cases were recorded during 1937–2025, with about 0 to 8 confirmed cases per year. Authorities remind people to avoid submerging their heads in water and to avoid stirring up sediment at the bottom of shallow water when swimming, to reduce the risk of infection.

0gyY18h9ysT74cMJ08bzTQ.zh: 美國今年5/31-8/8累計15個州報告55 例與疫情相關疾病,包括46 例桿菌性痢疾病例、7例沙門氏菌感染症病例及2例混合感染,其中4例住院,76%病例發病前曾食用苜蓿芽,經調查感染源為明蘇達州某生產商經銷之苜蓿芽,本事件在流行病學上屬罕見,單一食品涉及3種產志賀毒素大腸桿菌(STEC)型別及1種沙門氏菌株,當局已要求產品下架並擴大檢測。
0gyY18h9ysT74cMJ08bzTQ.en: From 31 May to 8 August this year, 15 US states reported 55 illnesses linked to this outbreak, including 46 shigellosis cases, 7 Salmonella infection cases and 2 mixed infections; 4 were hospitalised. 76% of cases had eaten alfalfa sprouts before onset. Investigation identified the source as alfalfa sprouts distributed by a producer in Minnesota. The event is epidemiologically rare: a single food was linked to three types of Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC) and one Salmonella strain. Authorities have ordered the product removed from sale and expanded testing.

M7go168phjbkCdKVOZ5icQ.zh: 美國賓州今年截至8/24累計報告393例確定病例(過去7天新增86 例)、2例死亡(均未接種疫苗),為該州自1991年來首次出現相關死亡病例;為因應此波疫情,該州衛生部計劃增設臨時疫苗診所加強接種。另該國疫情持續,今年截至8/20累計47州/地區報告2,777例確定病例(含16例境外移入),66%為19歲以下兒童及青年,94%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明,7%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例)為多,兒童疫苗接種率自2019-20年之95.2%下降到2025-26年92.4%。
M7go168phjbkCdKVOZ5icQ.en: Pennsylvania, USA, has reported 393 confirmed cases this year as of 24 August (86 added in the past seven days) and 2 deaths, both unvaccinated; these are the first measles deaths in the state since 1991. In response, the state health department plans to add temporary vaccination clinics. Nationally, the outbreak continues: as of 20 August this year, 2,777 confirmed cases (including 16 imported cases) had been reported cumulatively across 47 states and jurisdictions. 66% were children and young people aged 19 and under, 94% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 7% of patients were hospitalised. The largest numbers are in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Childhood vaccination coverage has fallen from 95.2% in 2019–20 to 92.4% in 2025–26.

ifFg3IrfBdN2gXP9XgBmCA.zh: 美國近年蜱蟲相關傳染病疫情擴張,每年估計有50萬例病例;推估有50萬人曾因孤星蜱罹患AGS紅肉過敏症(alpha-gal syndrome),該蜱蟲活動範圍也從過去僅限於南部,擴張至東北部及中西部地區;紐約州蘇福克郡(Suffolk County)為蜱蟲高風險地區,今年7月報告罕見的波旁病毒(Bourbon virus)感染病例。氣候變遷、郊區擴張及白尾鹿等宿主數量增加,造成蜱蟲相關傳染病疫情上升,另該疾病疫苗仍在研發中。
ifFg3IrfBdN2gXP9XgBmCA.en: Tick-borne infectious diseases in the US have expanded in recent years, with an estimated 500,000 cases a year. An estimated 500,000 people have developed alpha-gal syndrome (AGS, red-meat allergy) because of lone star ticks, and the range of this tick has expanded from the south alone to the north-east and Midwest. Suffolk County, New York, is a high-risk area for ticks; in July this year it reported a rare Bourbon virus infection. Climate change, suburban expansion and rising numbers of hosts such as white-tailed deer have driven the rise in tick-related diseases. A vaccine for this disease is still under development.

-4t7f7kpRPqp0cI9Ch1oyQ.zh: 人類疫情:本週新增1例。全球今年累計報告39例,分別為28例H9N2、8例H5N1、1例H5、1例H5N6及1例H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 美國密西根州於8/21報告2例未滿18歲之A(H1N2)v病例,於今年第32週出現症狀並就醫,其中1例曾接受抗病毒藥物治療,均已康復。調查顯示,個案發病前均曾參加出現染病豬隻之農業博覽會,個案間無相關接觸史,迄未發現其他病例。該國自2025年起累積4例A(H1N2)v病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計67國家/地區報告4,095起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  ○ 共1國於2026/8/14-21期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,為美國2起。 ○ 共7國於2026/7/21-8/21期間報告28起H5N1疫情,秘魯20 起、挪威3起、墨西哥/巴西/智利/瑞典/荷蘭各1起。
-4t7f7kpRPqp0cI9Ch1oyQ.en: Human cases: 1 new case this week. Globally, 39 cases have been reported this year: 28 H9N2, 8 H5N1, 1 H5, 1 H5N6 and 1 H10N3; most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals before illness onset. Michigan, USA, reported 2 cases of A(H1N2)v in people under 18 on 21 August; they developed symptoms and sought care in week 32 of this year, and one had received antiviral treatment; both recovered. Investigation showed that all cases had attended an agricultural fair where infected pigs were present before onset; there was no contact between cases, and no other cases have been found. The country has reported 4 A(H1N2)v cases since 2025. Animal/avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 4,095 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks have been reported by 67 countries/territories this year. A total of 1 country reported 2 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 14–21 August 2026, both in the United States. A total of 7 countries reported 28 H5N1 outbreaks during 21 July–21 August 2026: 20 in Peru, 3 in Norway, and one each in Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Sweden and the Netherlands.

B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續擴大,今年截至8/11,累計報告近14萬例病例其中17,385例確定病例及880例死亡(98例確定),所有行政區皆有病例,主要集中於首都達卡(Dhaka Division;60,866例、404例死亡),較為嚴重,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)及巴里薩爾(Barishal),當局持續擴大疫苗接種活動。 美洲區今年截至7月中旬,累積4,7459例確定病例,44例死亡,今年累積確定病例數相較去年同期5,123例增加8倍,且為自2004年以來確定病例數最多之一年,病例數以瓜地馬拉、墨西哥、美國及祕魯最為嚴峻,合計占該洲病例數95%,另以20-29 歲年齡組病例比例最高(31%)。 美國今年截至8/13累積報告2,566例(含16例境外移入),約19% 為5歲(含)以下兒童,67%為青少年,7%患者需住院治療。主要集中於南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例);賓州為目前疫情熱區,8/17當週新增60例確定病例,迄今累計307例。另93%病患為未接種疫苗或疫苗接種史不明。 瑞典今年截至8/17報告10例疑病例,可能與7/31至8/1辦理之音樂節相關,多數病例為18歲以下兒童;該國已啟動接觸者追蹤與跨國通報,並持續監測相關疫情。
B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to expand. As of 11 August this year, nearly 140,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17,385 confirmed cases and 880 deaths (98 of them confirmed). Cases have been reported in all administrative areas and are concentrated mainly in the capital, Dhaka Division (60,866 cases, 404 deaths), followed by Chattogram and Barishal; authorities continue to expand vaccination activities. In the Americas, as of mid-July this year, 47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Confirmed cases this year are 8 times the 5,123 in the same period last year, making this one of the years with the highest number of confirmed cases since 2004. Cases are most severe in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States and Peru, which together account for 95% of the region's cases; the 20–29 age group has the highest proportion (31%). In the United States, as of 13 August this year, 2,566 cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively; about 19% were children aged 5 and under, 67% were adolescents, and 7% of patients required hospitalisation. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Pennsylvania is currently the hotspot, with 60 confirmed cases added in the week of 17 August and 307 cumulatively to date. In addition, 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Sweden reported 10 suspected cases as of 17 August this year, possibly linked to a music festival held on 31 July–1 August; most were children under 18. The country has initiated contact tracing and cross-border notification and continues to monitor the related outbreak.

kFSGKEanfINbxyHiYCvuuQ.zh: 馬來西亞今年截至8/11累計報告5萬5,855例病例,其中死亡49 例,已超越2025年全年病例數(5萬5,399例)。該國過往主要流行型別為DENV-2型,惟今年DENV-3型已構成威脅,過往曾感染DENV-2型之⺠眾對於DENV-3型不但未具保護力,反而更容易引發重症,當局評估聖嬰現象之高溫將導致疫情持續上升,惟評估應不會達到2023及2024年之12萬例高峰。 美國南部佛羅里達州坦帕灣(Tampa Bay)地區爆發本土疫情,近日累計報告10例本土確定病例,該州南部之邁阿密戴德郡(Miami-Dade)及棕櫚灘郡(Palm Beach)亦報告本土病例。
kFSGKEanfINbxyHiYCvuuQ.en: Malaysia reported 55,855 cases cumulatively this year as of 11 August, including 49 deaths, already exceeding the full-year total for 2025 (55,399 cases). Malaysia's main circulating serotype has previously been DENV-2, but this year DENV-3 has posed a threat; people previously infected with DENV-2 have no protection against DENV-3 and are in fact more prone to severe disease. Authorities assess that high temperatures associated with El Niño will keep the epidemic rising, but assess that it should not reach the peak of 120,000 cases seen in 2023 and 2024. In the Tampa Bay area of southern Florida, USA, a local outbreak has occurred; 10 locally acquired confirmed cases have recently been reported cumulatively. Locally acquired cases have also been reported in Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties in southern Florida.

Qq2PEVILiiFdwkoVjD3hWw.zh: 美國俄亥俄州凱霍加郡於8/10發布警訊,當地近2個月內檢出5隻蝙蝠狂犬病陽性,檢出率高於往年。雖目前尚無人類感染病例,惟該郡人口密集,⺠眾接觸風險較高。蝙蝠為該國人類狂犬病之主要感染來源,在2000年至2024年間報告的42例本土病例中,其中35例(83%)具蝙蝠接觸史。
Qq2PEVILiiFdwkoVjD3hWw.en: Cuyahoga County, Ohio, USA, issued an alert on 10 August after detecting five rabies-positive bats in the past two months, a detection rate higher than in previous years. No human cases have been reported so far, but the county is densely populated and public exposure risk is relatively high. Bats are the main source of human rabies in the country: of 42 locally acquired human cases reported in 2000–2024, 35 (83%) had a history of bat contact.

3Hs66sj55Ox-gP4o_cOgew.zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥郡報告當地首例第一分支(Clade I)病例,個案具疫區旅遊史,目前密切接觸者均無症狀。該郡今年累計27例,皆為17-53歲男性,且多數未完整接種疫苗。 香港於8/5報告1例31歲男性確定病例,患者曾有多次高風險性行為,目前於醫院隔離治療中。因該病例與先前個案無流行病學關聯,顯示社區恐存在未偵測到之隱性傳播鏈。香港今年報告8例,自2022年迄今累計94例病例(含75例本土及19例境外移入),皆為男性,且多與高風險性行為密切相關。
3Hs66sj55Ox-gP4o_cOgew.en: San Diego County, California, USA, reported its first Clade I case in the county; the individual had a history of travel to an affected area, and all close contacts are currently asymptomatic. The county has reported 27 cases this year, all men aged 17–53, most of whom had not completed vaccination. Hong Kong reported 1 confirmed case in a 31-year-old man on 5 August; the patient had had multiple high-risk sexual encounters and is isolated in hospital for treatment. Because this case has no epidemiological link to previous cases, undetected hidden transmission chains may exist in the community. Hong Kong has reported 8 cases this year; since 2022, a cumulative 94 cases (75 local and 19 imported) have been reported, all in men, and most closely linked to high-risk sexual behaviour.

vnli3G_qRYW0x9V9jeB14g.zh: 美國路易斯安那州今年截至8/6累計報告9例病例,其中5例死亡(CFR:56%)。病患皆因傷口接觸海水而感染,未發現與食用海鮮相關之食媒傳染途徑。該州過去10年同期平均為7例病例及1例死亡,今年死亡數顯著上升,當局已發布公衛警示,提醒免疫力低下等高風險族群應避免傷口接觸海水。另佛羅里達州今年迄今亦已報告2例死亡病例。
vnli3G_qRYW0x9V9jeB14g.en: Louisiana, USA, reported 9 cases this year as of 6 August, of which 5 died (CFR 56%). All patients were infected through wound exposure to seawater, and no foodborne transmission through eating seafood has been identified. The state's same-period average over the past 10 years was 7 cases and 1 death; deaths this year have risen markedly. Authorities have issued a public health alert, reminding high-risk groups such as people with weakened immunity to avoid wound contact with seawater. Florida has also reported 2 deaths so far this year.

uE4GKLNz0Nw0087qa09aXA.zh: 美國俄亥俄州1間⻑期照護機構,今年截至8/6,累計報告8例確定病例,無死亡病例,因病情嚴重,全部病例皆已住院,該機構收治住⺠多為罹患呼吸道疾病及癌症等高風險族群,感染源仍在調查中,當局已在該機構採取全面防治措施。
uE4GKLNz0Nw0087qa09aXA.en: A long-term care facility in Ohio, USA, has reported 8 confirmed Legionnaires' disease cases as of 6 August this year, with no deaths. Because the illnesses are severe, all cases have been hospitalised. Residents of the facility are mainly people with high-risk conditions such as respiratory disease and cancer. The source of infection is still under investigation, and authorities have taken comprehensive prevention and control measures at the facility.

gVEXCTZBRWgKeLrWnjw0XQ.zh: 葉門馬里卜(Marib)今年8/2宣布公共衛生緊急狀態(Public health emergency),今年截至8/2,累計報告1,624例病例,其中僅290例確定病例,及12例相關死亡案例。因當地診斷能力嚴重受限,疫情實際負擔比報告病例數要高得多。由於戰亂導致未接種疫苗等,當局已擴大疫苗接種,防止疫情擴散。 哈薩克北部庫斯塔奈(Kostanay)今年上半年累計報告167例確定病例,較去年同期10例,增加16倍,其中57例(34.1%)為未滿1 歲嬰兒。近期顯示疫情在北部多個地區蔓延,⺠眾疫苗猶豫現象造成免疫覆蓋率偏低,疫情持續傳播 。另該國於2024年報告27,967例病例,成為當年歐洲區域麻疹負擔最重之國家。 馬達加斯加瓦卡南卡拉特拉(Vakinankaratra),截至今年7月中旬,累計報告229例確定病例,2例於8/4-5期間死亡;該國42區中,有24區處於活躍期,18區為監測期。由於該國去年疫苗覆蓋率僅72%,以及學校假期,增加兒童跨區互動,加速疫情擴散。當局已在受影響地區進行補接種疫苗,並預計今年10月展開全國大規模疫苗接種。 美國疫情持續,今年截至8/9,累計報告2,465例確定病例(含16 例境外移入),高於去年2,289例。有68%為19歲以下兒童及青少年,93%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,7%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(524例)為多。另賓州近期疫情快速上升,8/10之當週新增57例確定病例,今年累計達232例。
gVEXCTZBRWgKeLrWnjw0XQ.en: Yemen: Marib declared a public health emergency on 2 August this year. As of 2 August, 1,624 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which only 290 were confirmed, along with 12 related deaths. Because local diagnostic capacity is severely limited, the true disease burden is much higher than the reported case count. Owing to armed conflict and low vaccination, authorities have expanded vaccination to prevent the outbreak from spreading. Kazakhstan: in Kostanay in the north, 167 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively in the first half of this year, compared with 10 in the same period last year, a 16-fold increase; 57 (34.1%) were infants under 1 year old. Recent data show the outbreak is spreading across several northern areas. Vaccine hesitancy among residents has led to low immunity coverage, and transmission continues. In addition, the country reported 27,967 cases in 2024, making it the country with the heaviest measles burden in the European Region that year. Madagascar: in Vakinankaratra, 229 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-July this year, and 2 died between 4 and 5 August. Of the country's 42 districts, 24 are in the active phase and 18 are under surveillance. Because vaccination coverage last year was only 72%, and school holidays increased inter-district contact among children, the outbreak has accelerated. Authorities have carried out catch-up vaccination in affected areas and plan to launch nationwide mass vaccination in October this year. United States: the outbreak continues. As of 9 August this year, 2,465 confirmed cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 2,289 cases last year. 68% were children and young people aged 19 and under, 93% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 7% of patients were hospitalised. The largest numbers are in South Carolina (670) and Utah (524). In Pennsylvania, the outbreak has risen rapidly recently; 57 confirmed cases were added in the week of 10 August, bringing the total this year to 232.

j6h0yJi4txZnrMLU7RMfow.zh: 美國8/4報告3例確定病例,個案皆具斐濟旅遊史;紐西蘭亦於第30週(7/25-31)報告3例病例,具斐濟(2例)及印(1例)旅遊史。斐濟當局並未報告感染症病例,可能與當地使用的檢驗工具敏感度較低,或與登革熱等產生血清交叉反應等有關,估計實際感染人數可能被低估,美國CDC呼籲赴斐濟旅客(特別是孕婦及備孕婦女) 應加強防蚊措施。
j6h0yJi4txZnrMLU7RMfow.en: The US reported 3 confirmed cases on 4 August, all with a history of travel to Fiji. New Zealand also reported 3 cases in week 30 (25–31 July), with travel histories to Fiji (2) and India (1). Fiji has not reported any Zika cases; this may be related to the lower sensitivity of locally used test tools or to serological cross-reaction with dengue and other infections, and the actual number of infections may be underestimated. The US CDC urges travellers to Fiji, especially pregnant women and women planning pregnancy, to strengthen mosquito-protection measures.

yeC-hoofSr3mnJgi79EHig.zh: 美國紐約州薩福克郡報告3例疑病例,全美近年病例呈上升趨勢,相較2019至2023年每年報告仍少於200例。此疾病於5至9月較常見,其中蜱蟲或鹿蠅叮咬多發生在夏季,因狩獵和接觸動物引起的感染則不限季節。另男性病例較多,推估與狩獵和園藝活動暴露風險高有關,病患雖涵蓋各年齡層,惟以兒童為較高風險族群。
yeC-hoofSr3mnJgi79EHig.en: Suffolk County, New York State, has reported 3 suspected cases. Nationally, cases have trended upward in recent years, but annual reports remain below 200, compared with 2019–2023. The disease is more common from May to September. Tick bites and deer fly bites mostly occur in summer, while infections from hunting and animal contact can occur at any time of year. Male cases are more numerous, which is estimated to reflect higher exposure risk from hunting and gardening activities. Although patients span all age groups, children are at higher risk.

MeY8mXUQDpQ27Gtc87-Ihw.zh: 美國疫情更新,今年5月截至7/31累計報告逾2.1萬例病例,其中疫情集中於密西根州,該州迄今報告1萬1,234例病例,並於8/3首次報告2例死亡病例。
MeY8mXUQDpQ27Gtc87-Ihw.en: US outbreak update: From May this year through 31 July, more than 21,000 cases have been reported cumulatively in the United States, with the outbreak concentrated in Michigan. Michigan has reported 11,234 cases to date and, on 3 August, reported its first 2 deaths.

D8B3t8Z-PX8Ly_W-PLmi8Q.zh: 美國紐約市7/31宣布上東區疫情已結束,連續2週未新增確定病例且無相關症狀,今年截至7/30,累計報告92例確定病例及7例死亡。 瑞士西北部巴塞爾(Basel)爆發群聚疫情,今年累計報告26例確定病例(含1例死亡、9例住院),該國進行冷卻水塔檢測發現有8 座濃度超標,已於7/31要求關閉受影響之設施。
D8B3t8Z-PX8Ly_W-PLmi8Q.en: On 31 July, New York City declared the outbreak in the Upper East Side over, as no new confirmed cases had been reported for 2 consecutive weeks and no related symptoms were present. As of 30 July this year, 92 confirmed cases and 7 deaths have been reported cumulatively in the city. In Basel, northwestern Switzerland, a cluster outbreak has occurred, with 26 confirmed cases reported cumulatively this year, including 1 death and 9 hospitalizations. Switzerland tested cooling towers and found 8 with concentrations above the limit, and on 31 July it required the affected facilities to shut down.

SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞衛生部於今年7/7宣佈爆發疫情,該國8個省份自今年1月以來累計報告108例疑個案(含3例確定病例),由於該國實驗室檢驗量能不足,須送往澳洲進行檢驗,可能低估實際傳播情形。另病例地理分佈無流行病學關聯,且該國疫苗覆蓋率低,預期疫情擴散。 巴西今年截至7/31,累計報告18例確定病例,主要集中於首都聖保羅(15例)之2歲以下與20-50歲族群。此波疫情為該國獲得消除麻疹認證後,首次出現持續性本土傳播,主因為該地區為重要樞紐,且近期世界盃結束後人潮返國及7至8月學校假期等因素。該國已針對特定地區擴大疫苗接種對象為6個月至59歲族群,防止疫情向外擴散。 美洲地區疫情持續,自今年截至7/25,共17國/地區累計報告4 萬7,026例確定病例及48例死亡(CFR:0.10%),病例數較去年同期增加5倍。其中,高達97%確定病例集中於瓜地馬拉(30,040例)、墨西哥(12,233例)、美國(2,318例)及加拿大(1,107 例)。
SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.en: Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health declared an outbreak on 7 July this year. Across 8 provinces, 108 suspected cases (including 3 confirmed) have been reported since January this year. Because the country's laboratory testing capacity is limited, samples must be sent to Australia for testing, which may underestimate the actual spread. In addition, cases are geographically dispersed with no epidemiological links, and vaccination coverage is low, so the outbreak is expected to spread. As of 31 July this year, Brazil has reported 18 confirmed measles cases, mainly in the city of São Paulo (15 cases), among children under 2 years and people aged 20 to 50 years. This is the first sustained local transmission since the country was certified as having eliminated measles. The main factors are that the area is an important hub, the return of travellers after the recently concluded World Cup, and school holidays in July and August. Brazil has expanded vaccination in specific areas to people aged 6 months to 59 years to prevent the outbreak from spreading further. Measles activity in the Region of the Americas continues. As of 25 July this year, 17 countries and territories have reported a cumulative 47,026 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (CFR: 0.10%), a five-fold increase over the same period last year. As many as 97% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Guatemala (30,040), Mexico (12,233), the United States (2,318) and Canada (1,107).

KOTrewojwXlBvC3oKBpK2Q.zh: 美國紐約州薩福克郡(Suffolk)今年截至7月報告1例確定病例及2例疑病例,其中1例兒童病患的住家庭院有野兔及蜱蟲活動。另美國年平均報告205例,近10年疫情呈上升趨勢,其中紐約州1993-2023年報告30例病例,有病患43%居住在薩福克郡,當局警告今年疫情上升。
KOTrewojwXlBvC3oKBpK2Q.en: Suffolk County, New York State, has reported 1 confirmed and 2 suspected tularaemia cases so far this year, as of July. In one child patient's case, rabbits and ticks were active in the family's yard. The United States reports an annual average of 205 cases, and cases have risen over the past decade. New York State reported 30 cases from 1993 to 2023, and 43% of those patients lived in Suffolk County. Authorities warn that cases are rising this year.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

6cQNa_97x_LuY1ggCtvtkA.zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,今年5月截至7/28累計報告逾6,707例確定病例,其中423例住院,病患年齡中位數44歲,另有11,500例疑病例仍待實驗室檢測,疫情分布達45州,為該國史上最大規模之疫情。其中1,947例經調查與連鎖速食店群聚事件相關,密西根州疫調顯示高達9成患者曾食用結球萵苣。本次疫情出現兩波高峰(6月中旬及7月初),推測為多次暴露所致。
6cQNa_97x_LuY1ggCtvtkA.en: The outbreak in the United States continues to expand. From May this year through 28 July, more than 6,707 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 423 were hospitalized. The median patient age is 44 years. A further 11,500 suspected cases are still awaiting laboratory testing. The outbreak has reached 45 states and is the largest in the country's history. Of the cases, 1,947 have been linked through investigation to a cluster associated with a chain of fast-food restaurants. Michigan's epidemiological investigation shows that as many as 90% of patients had eaten iceberg lettuce. The outbreak has had two peaks (mid-June and early July), presumed to result from multiple exposures.

qX7KUJgm_jeuzTLBGCAPFw.zh: 美國7/24報告一起群聚事件,累計報告98例病例,其中26例住院,疫情波及17州。接受疫調的患者有91%曾食用雞蛋,經全基因定序檢測疑感染源為德州某雞蛋生廠商,已緊急回收160 萬盒雞蛋。
qX7KUJgm_jeuzTLBGCAPFw.en: On 24 July, the United States reported a cluster event with 98 cumulative cases, of which 26 were hospitalized, spanning 17 states. Of the patients interviewed, 91% had eaten eggs. Whole-genome sequencing suggests the suspected source is an egg producer in Texas, and 1.6 million egg boxes have been urgently recalled.

0aVC0tO5qNWIogZhjYmm6A.zh: 美國紐約市今年截至7/27,已累計報告90例確定病例,目前有7例住院、65例出院、5例死亡。
0aVC0tO5qNWIogZhjYmm6A.en: As of 27 July this year, New York City has reported 90 confirmed cases cumulatively. Currently, 7 are hospitalized, 65 have been discharged, and 5 have died.

JCG5Z-gSaS0Vx3DyMo-DSQ.zh: 美國今年截至7/23,累計2,318例確定病例,已超越去年全年2,289例,19歲以下族群達1,581例,其中有10%之5歲以下兒童住院,且高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。賓州迄7/27,過去7天新增報告31例確定病例,累計142例確定病例,為近期疫情上升地區之一。該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至7/24,累計報告12,335例確定病例,18例死亡,超越去年全年6,614例。其中以西部哈利斯科州(Jalisco)6,611例為多,墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,012例次之。確診人數以1-9歲孩童(4,753例)及25-29歲年輕成人(2,154 例)為好發族群。 哈薩克巴甫洛達爾州(Pavlodar)疫情上升,今年上半年已累積報告398例確定病例,有345例(87%)未接種疫苗,其中288例為14歲以下兒童。該國指出疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為此次爆發疫情的主要原因,該國已加強疫苗接種,並針對拒絕接種疫苗之家庭加強溝通。 瓜地馬拉(Guatemala)今年截至7/24,累計報告30,040例確定病例,29例死亡(CFR:0.1%) ,約10%個案住院,另15至39歲族群佔確定病例63%,1歲以下為高風險族群。
JCG5Z-gSaS0Vx3DyMo-DSQ.en: The United States has reported 2,318 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 23 July, exceeding last year's full-year total of 2,289. Cases aged under 19 years total 1,581, and 10% of children under 5 years have been hospitalized. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Pennsylvania reported 31 new confirmed cases in the 7 days to 27 July, bringing its cumulative total to 142 confirmed cases, and it is one of the areas where the outbreak has recently increased. The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. Mexico's outbreak continues. As of 24 July this year, 12,335 confirmed cases and 18 deaths have been reported cumulatively, exceeding last year's total of 6,614. Jalisco State accounts for most cases (6,611), followed by Mexico City (1,012). Children aged 1 to 9 years (4,753 cases) and young adults aged 25 to 29 years (2,154 cases) are the most affected groups. In Pavlodar Region of Kazakhstan, cases are rising. In the first half of this year, 398 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 345 (87%) were unvaccinated, including 288 children aged under 14 years. The country identifies insufficient vaccination coverage as the main cause of this outbreak, has strengthened vaccination, and has enhanced communication with families who refuse vaccination. Guatemala has reported 30,040 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 24 July, including 29 deaths (CFR: 0.1%). About 10% of cases were hospitalized. People aged 15 to 39 years account for 63% of confirmed cases, and infants under 1 year are a high-risk group.

XsMNiCYuXwHioYPyqOS5ow.zh: 美國今年迄今累計報告2,318例確定病例,已超越去年全年2,289 例,疫情創下自1991年以來新高。除16例屬境外移入,餘皆為本土感染,高達93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近9成感染者為19 歲以下兒童與青少年,住院率達7%,目前尚無死亡病例。猶他州為最大疫區(逾500例),賓州為新增疫區(單週新增29例,累計達139例)。專家建議加強MMR疫苗接種,防堵疫情擴散。該國恐於今年秋季失去自2000年迄今之麻疹消除地位。
XsMNiCYuXwHioYPyqOS5ow.en: The United States has reported 2,318 confirmed cases to date this year, exceeding last year's full-year total of 2,289, and the highest since 1991. Of these, 16 were imported, and the rest were locally acquired infections. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and nearly 90% of cases were children and adolescents aged under 19 years. The hospitalization rate is 7%, and no deaths have been reported so far. Utah is the largest outbreak area (more than 500 cases), and Pennsylvania is a newly affected area (29 new cases in a single week, bringing its total to 139). Experts recommend strengthening MMR vaccination to prevent further spread. The country may lose the measles elimination status it has held since 2000 as early as this autumn.

DKVoduzDfzOj3Nc3bGsYNg.zh: 美國疫情更新,今年5/4-7/20累計報告4,173例病例,其中308 例住院,疫情分布於41州,並估計仍有至少7,400例待實驗室確認病例,疫情顯著高於2025年同期。FDA已發布澄清報告指出,墨西哥生產的萵苣檢體,經複測結果為偽陽性。
DKVoduzDfzOj3Nc3bGsYNg.en: US outbreak update: From 4 May to 20 July this year, 4,173 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 308 were hospitalized, across 41 states. At least 7,400 more cases are estimated to be still awaiting laboratory confirmation. The outbreak is significantly higher than in the same period of 2025. The FDA has issued a clarification report stating that retesting of lettuce samples from Mexico produced false-positive results.

K3YSWv-gFj-8YY-2dw4lPA.zh: 美國7/12報告一起郵輪群聚事件,累計18例病例,占所有乘客的29%,乘客係於前往阿拉斯加之航程上發病。該郵輪今年已發生過兩起諾羅病毒感染疫情(5月報告12例、6月報告20例)。該國今年迄今累計報告8件船隻上之腸胃道相關疫情,另2025年累計報告23件,諾羅病毒為郵輪疫情的常見致病原(占9成)。
K3YSWv-gFj-8YY-2dw4lPA.en: On 12 July, the United States reported a cruise ship cluster with 18 cumulative cases, accounting for 29% of all passengers. Passengers fell ill during a voyage to Alaska. The ship has already experienced two norovirus outbreaks this year (12 cases reported in May and 20 in June). So far this year, the country has reported 8 gastrointestinal outbreaks on ships; 23 were reported cumulatively in 2025. Norovirus is a common pathogen in cruise ship outbreaks, accounting for 90%.

21jkRlIA8KSIAQa_mc7UvQ.zh: 美國紐約市今年截至7/20,累計報告76例確定病例,其中有7例住院、4例死亡,病例主要集中於曼哈頓上東區。另截至7/20,經檢測發現當地至少有76座冷卻水塔存在退伍軍人菌,該市針對檢測呈陽性之冷卻水塔進行清潔和消毒。
21jkRlIA8KSIAQa_mc7UvQ.en: As of 20 July this year, New York City has reported 76 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 7 hospitalized and 4 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the Upper East Side of Manhattan. Also as of 20 July, testing found that at least 76 cooling towers in the area contained Legionella bacteria. The city is cleaning and disinfecting cooling towers that tested positive.

6Wr7CB2J61PMs4Ct4w2-Ug.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至7/16,累計報告2,260例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19歲以下(70%)族群,有146 例(6%)需住院治療,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(518例)、德州(182例)及維吉亞州(176)例;該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 孟加拉今年截至7/15,累計報告逾11萬例病例(1萬3,907例確定病例),累計達771例(95例確定)死亡,以首都達卡(8,912例確定病例、59例死亡)最為嚴峻,疫情呈地域性蔓延,全國8個行政區均有通報及死亡病例。儘管該國疫苗覆蓋率高達99%,惟疫情仍持續傳播,懷疑覆蓋率高為近期加強推動接種活動的結果,後續仍需結合常規免疫指標,監測流行學病學趨勢。 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情上升,今年截至6/28,累計報告9萬9,200例確定病例,高於去年同期3萬4,000例,主要集中於東部南基伍省(26,900例)和北基伍省(17,500例),兩省總病例數合計佔該國45%;由於該國面臨兒童營養不良、武裝衝突等因素,影響WHO常規疫苗接種計畫,導致該國疫情擴大。
6Wr7CB2J61PMs4Ct4w2-Ug.en: The outbreak in the United States continues to rise. As of 16 July this year, 2,260 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years; 146 (6%) required hospitalization, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (518), Texas (182) and Virginia (176). The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. In Bangladesh, as of 15 July this year, more than 110,000 cases have been reported cumulatively (13,907 confirmed cases), and cumulative deaths have reached 771 (95 confirmed). The capital, Dhaka, is the most severely affected (8,912 confirmed cases and 59 deaths), and the outbreak is spreading regionally, with cases and deaths reported in all 8 administrative divisions nationwide. Although the country's vaccination coverage is as high as 99%, transmission continues. It is suspected that the high coverage rate is the result of recently intensified vaccination campaigns, so routine immunization indicators need to be considered alongside monitoring of epidemiological trends. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), cases are rising. As of 28 June this year, 99,200 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 34,000 in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in South Kivu Province (26,900) and North Kivu Province (17,500), which together account for 45% of the national total. Because of factors including child malnutrition and armed conflict, which affect WHO's routine vaccination programme, the outbreak has expanded.

v-GqluvbI-i6szf6yG1nbQ.zh: 美國疫情擴大,今年截至6/30累計報告至少81例病例,其中約有79%出現嚴重神經侵襲性疾病,病患分布於亞利桑那及德州等18個州,病例數為2004年以來年平均數(約10例)的8倍且流行季較往年提早開始 ,並有23個州報告有病毒的病媒蚊活動情形,為10年來最高,相關資料顯示目前流行的病毒株毒性高或暴露族群多為易感族群。目前尚無核准的人用疫苗和特效抗病毒療法,故必須落實病媒控制和個人防護措施。
v-GqluvbI-i6szf6yG1nbQ.en: The outbreak in the United States is expanding. As of 30 June this year, at least 81 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which about 79% had severe neuroinvasive disease. Cases are distributed across 18 states, including Arizona and Texas. The number of cases is eight times the annual average since 2004 (about 10 cases), and the transmission season began earlier than usual. Virus-carrying mosquito activity has been reported in 23 states, the highest in 10 years. Relevant data suggest that the currently circulating virus strain is highly virulent, or that exposed populations are largely susceptible. There are currently no approved human vaccines or specific antiviral therapies, so vector control and personal protective measures must be implemented.

p4xpsBMlWgJs9LtW0vrs1A.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/14-15新增113例確定病例,其中74例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(96例)、北基伍省(17例)。另7/15伊圖里省新增1個受影響衛生區(Mahagi),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前疫情分佈於5個省份共46個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國90%的病例數。 烏干達自6/22迄今無新增疫情,7/16宣布該國最後一名患者出院,將啟動42天監測期追蹤,若無新增病例,可依WHO規定宣布此波疫情結束。 全球疫情概況:截至7/15,疫情波及4個國家,累計報告2,147例確定病例,其中830例死亡(CFR38.7%)。病例主要集中於DRC,計2,124例確定病例(含828例死亡、390例康復);鄰國烏干達計20例確定病例(含2例死亡、18例康復),其個案均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關;美國計2例(含1例已康復)、法國計1例(已康復),此零星個案皆為於DRC當地進行醫療照護之人員或人道救援者。
p4xpsBMlWgJs9LtW0vrs1A.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. Between 14 and 15 July, 113 new confirmed cases were added, including 74 deaths, in Ituri Province (96 cases) and North Kivu Province (17). On 15 July, one newly affected health zone was added in Ituri Province (Mahagi), and the geographic spread continues to expand. The outbreak is currently distributed across 5 provinces (46 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases. Uganda has reported no new cases since 22 June. On 16 July, the country announced the discharge of its last patient and began a 42-day monitoring period; if no new cases are reported, Uganda can declare the end of this wave of the outbreak in line with WHO requirements. Global overview: as of 15 July, the outbreak has spread to 4 countries, with 2,147 confirmed cases reported cumulatively, including 830 deaths (CFR: 38.7%). Most cases are in the DRC, with 2,124 confirmed cases (including 828 deaths and 390 recoveries). Neighbouring Uganda has 20 confirmed cases (including 2 deaths and 18 recoveries), all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. The United States has 2 cases (1 recovered) and France 1 case (recovered). These sporadic cases were all healthcare workers or humanitarian responders providing care in the DRC.

02vjTO9GmpJqmqAu9KyH_A.zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,CDC統計今年5/1截至7/13累計報告1,645例確定病例,其中141例住院,病患分布34個州,年齡中位數為44 歲,56%為女性,介於5-7月發病,評估全國疑及調查中病例數逾7,000例,導致今年疫情為2025年的27倍。密西根州迄今已報告逾2,500例,當局表示可能感染源為萵苣;紐約市疫情已為去年3 倍;佛羅里達州關閉恐有環孢子蟲暴露的戲水區。當局呼籲⺠眾避免食用覆盆子、包裝沙拉、羅勒等生鮮蔬果,且食物應充分加熱。該國之該疾病流行期為5-8月。
02vjTO9GmpJqmqAu9KyH_A.en: The outbreak in the United States continues to expand. According to CDC statistics, from 1 May to 13 July this year, 1,645 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 141 were hospitalized. Patients are spread across 34 states, the median age is 44 years, and 56% are female. Onset occurred between May and July. Based on an estimate of the national total, the number of suspected cases and cases under investigation exceeds 7,000, making this year's outbreak 27 times that of 2025. Michigan has reported more than 2,500 cases to date, and authorities said the likely source is lettuce. New York City's outbreak is already three times that of last year. Florida closed a water play area where cyclospora exposure may have occurred. Authorities urge the public to avoid eating raw produce such as raspberries, bagged salads and basil, and to heat food thoroughly. The disease season in the country runs from May to August.

OmZ5GT75Ek_0lYVPu7v9jQ.zh: 一名於剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)從事人道救援工作之美國公⺠確診,個案已於7/13後送至德國醫院治療,目前病況穩定。 美國CDC於7/13宣布,延續針對過去21天內曾停留DRC、烏干達或南蘇丹之外籍人士實施暫停入境措施,目前僅允許該國公⺠、國⺠、特定政府與軍事人員,或經專案核准個案入境。
OmZ5GT75Ek_0lYVPu7v9jQ.en: A US citizen working in humanitarian aid in the DRC was diagnosed with Ebola. After 13 July, the patient was evacuated to a hospital in Germany for treatment, and their condition is currently stable. On 13 July, the US CDC announced that it would extend its entry suspension for foreign nationals who had been in the DRC, Uganda or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Currently, only the country's citizens and nationals, certain government and military personnel, or individuals approved on a case-by-case basis may enter.

B7h4_XpQL2VpYQ4xos8YkQ.zh: 美國紐約市今年截至7/13,累計60例確定病例,其中有15例住院,病例主要集中於曼哈頓上東區。另截至7/9,經檢測發現當地至少有31座冷卻水塔存在退伍軍人菌。
B7h4_XpQL2VpYQ4xos8YkQ.en: As of 13 July this year, New York City has reported 60 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 15 hospitalized. Cases are concentrated in the Upper East Side of Manhattan. In addition, as of 9 July, testing found that at least 31 cooling towers in the area contained Legionella bacteria.

KhKSOeYBHdArwCvsWF8y9A.zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,今年截至6月,累計報告2,231例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19 歲以下(70%)族群,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(516例)、德州(182例)及佛羅里達州(141)例。 英國近期疫情上升,今年截至7/6,累計報告883例確定病例及3 例死亡,病例主要分布於倫敦(52%),其次為西密德蘭郡(17%) 。該國疫苗覆蓋率偏低與倫敦為國際主要交通樞紐,是引發此波疫情主因。該國優先針對免疫功能不全者、未滿 1 歲嬰兒及孕婦等高風險族群進行補接種計畫。 馬爾地夫今年截至7/11累計報告121例確定病例,近期單週新增55例確定病例。疫情集中於首都馬列(Malé),且多數為15至35 歲族群。該國採取擴大疫苗接種,並進行接觸者追蹤與基因定序等防疫措施。
KhKSOeYBHdArwCvsWF8y9A.en: The US outbreak continues to rise. As of June this year, 2,231 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (516), Texas (182) and Florida (141). The UK has seen a recent rise in cases. As of 6 July this year, 883 confirmed cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in London (52%), followed by West Midlands County (17%). Low vaccination coverage in the country and London's status as a major international transport hub are the main drivers of this wave. The country is prioritizing catch-up vaccination for high-risk groups, including immunocompromised people, infants under 1 year and pregnant women. Maldives has reported 121 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 11 July, with 55 new confirmed cases added in the most recent week. Cases are concentrated in the capital, Malé, and most are aged 15 to 35 years. The country is expanding vaccination and carrying out contact tracing and genomic sequencing.

CQhQaxl-hOfaGM_Dio1cWQ.zh: 美國加州聖地牙哥郡於7/13報告當地首例本土病例(Chagas disease),該病例無症狀,於進行例行捐血篩檢時發現 ,係該郡自2024年列為需通報傳染病以來之第4例病例(前3例為境外移入),當局表示此案例顯示該疾病已不僅止於拉丁美洲地區流行。該疾病症狀通常輕微或不明顯,可能出現發燒、頭痛、淋巴結腫大或叮咬處出現紅腫發炎,部分患者會在數年後發展為重症,導致臟肥大及衰竭等嚴重併發症。
CQhQaxl-hOfaGM_Dio1cWQ.en: On 13 July, San Diego County, California, United States, reported its first locally acquired case of Chagas disease. The case was asymptomatic and was found during routine blood donation screening. It is the county's fourth case since the disease became notifiable in 2024; the previous three were imported. Authorities said this case shows the disease is no longer confined to Latin America. The disease usually causes mild or inconspicuous symptoms, which may include fever, headache, swollen lymph nodes, or redness and inflammation at the bite site. Some patients develop serious complications years later, such as enlargement of organs and organ failure.

T2GPz8si_xnrFYz62ddU9Q.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/11新增53例確定病例,其中30例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(45例)及北基伍省(8例),另新增6個受影響的衛生區(分別位於伊圖里省、喬波省及上韋萊省),有地理區持續擴大情形。迄至7/11累計1,926例確定病例(702例死亡、318例康復),致死率36.4%,疫情分佈於5個省份(42個衛生區),其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國90%的病例數。 全球疫情:目前波及4個國家,迄7/11累計1,949例確定病例、704例死亡(致死率36%)。主要分布於DRC(1,926例確定病例、702例死亡);鄰國烏干達(20例確定病例、2例死亡)之個案均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關;美國(2例確定病例)及法國(1例確定病例)之零星個案,皆為於DRC當地進行醫療照護之人員或人道救援者。
T2GPz8si_xnrFYz62ddU9Q.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 11 July, 53 new confirmed cases were added, including 30 deaths, in Ituri Province (45 cases) and North Kivu Province (8). In addition, 6 newly affected health zones were added (in Ituri Province, Tshopo Province and Haut-Uélé Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 11 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,926 (702 deaths, 318 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 36.4%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (42 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases. Global situation: the outbreak has spread to 4 countries. As of 11 July, 1,949 confirmed cases and 704 deaths (CFR 36%) have been reported cumulatively. Most cases are in the DRC (1,926 confirmed cases, 702 deaths). Uganda's 20 confirmed cases (2 deaths) are all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. The sporadic cases in the United States (2 confirmed cases) and France (1 confirmed case) were all healthcare workers or humanitarian responders providing care in the DRC.

VpF4RVbNEldubDrSsKB4WA.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/9新增38例確定病例,其中23例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(32例)及北基伍省(6例),7/1新增1個受影響衛生區(為伊圖里省Boga),有地理區持續擴大趨勢。迄7/9累計1,830例確定病例(648例死亡、300例康復),致死率35.4%,疫情分佈於37個衛生區,以伊圖里省最為嚴峻(1,663 例,影響25個衛生區,占該省69.4%)、其次為北基伍省(163例,影響11個衛生區,占該省32.4%)及南基伍省(3例,影響1個衛生區,占該省2.9%),整體接觸者追蹤率78.1%。 DRC喬波省基桑加衛生區(Kisangani)新增2例個案,該省目前共報告4例確定病例(其中2例死亡),均來自伊圖里省亞亞衛生區。另上韋萊省初估有5例確定病例(為自伊圖里省移入之病患,可能為參加葬禮之接觸者)。 法國於6/24通報之首例境外移入個案,在連續兩次PCR檢測皆呈陰性後,已於7/4宣布康復出院。 美國於7/10證實1名於DRC從事人道救援工作之美國公⺠確診,過去1個月主要於伊圖里省布亞(Bunia)從事後勤,目前於當地治療中隔離中,突顯第一線高暴露風險。CDC評估國內風險低,惟呼籲⺠眾避免前往DRC東部三省。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,截至7/10累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、17例康復),尚無社區傳播疫情。
VpF4RVbNEldubDrSsKB4WA.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 9 July, 38 new confirmed cases were added, including 23 deaths, in Ituri Province (32 cases) and North Kivu Province (6). On 1 July, one newly affected health zone was added (Boga in Ituri Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 9 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,830 (648 deaths, 300 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 35.4%. Cases are distributed across 37 health zones. Ituri Province is the most severely affected, with 1,663 cases and 25 health zones affected, 69.4% of the province. North Kivu Province follows with 163 cases and 11 health zones affected (32.4% of the province), and South Kivu Province has 3 cases and 1 health zone affected (2.9% of the province). The overall contact tracing rate is 78.1%. In Kisangani health zone, Tshopo Province, 2 new cases were reported, bringing the province's total to 4 confirmed cases (2 deaths), all from Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province. In addition, Haut-Uélé Province preliminarily reports 5 confirmed cases, patients imported from Ituri who may have been contacts of funeral attendees. France's first imported case, notified on 24 June, was discharged on 4 July after two consecutive negative PCR tests. On 10 July, the United States confirmed that a US citizen working in humanitarian aid in the DRC had been infected. In the past month, the patient mainly worked in logistics in Bunia, Ituri Province, and is currently being treated in isolation locally, which highlights the high exposure risk for frontline workers. The CDC assesses the domestic risk as low but urges the public to avoid travel to the three eastern DRC provinces. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 10 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 17 recoveries), with no community transmission.

EM1bZSyIdsel6IKaKmfhdQ.zh: 美國17個州自今年5月截至6月中旬累計報告145例環孢子蟲病例(Cyclosporiasis),其中20例住院。密西根州近期疫情快速上升,6/22-7/4累計報告572例病例,紐約州近期疫情亦上升。當局評估疫情可能為多州同時爆發,過往疫情常見感染源為覆盆子或袋裝沙拉等蔬果,提醒⺠眾應用流動的水徹底清洗蔬果,並高溫烹調以確保飲食衛生。
EM1bZSyIdsel6IKaKmfhdQ.en: From May this year to mid-June, 17 states in the United States reported 145 cyclosporiasis cases cumulatively, of which 20 were hospitalized. The outbreak in Michigan has risen rapidly, with 572 cases reported cumulatively from 22 June to 4 July, and the outbreak in New York State has also risen recently. Authorities assess that the outbreak may involve several states at the same time. Common sources of past outbreaks have been fruits such as raspberries or bagged salads, and the public is reminded to wash fruits and vegetables thoroughly under running water and to cook food at high temperatures to ensure food safety.

SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.zh: 尚比亞疫情上升,今年1月至7月3日,全國累計報告700例疑個案(含119例確定病例與4例死亡)。目前全國10個省中已有9個省份出現確定病例,其中以西部省(Western Province)最為嚴峻。高達87.4%的確定病例無疫苗接種紀錄,當局預計於7/6-11 在5個高風險地區,針對6個月至9歲兒童展開緊急疫苗接種。 瓜地馬拉疫情嚴峻且範圍持續擴大,今年截至7/5,全國累計報告逾2萬5,700例病例,其中7,260例經實驗室確診,並有24例死亡。此波疫情源自去(114)年12月的大型宗教集會,首例個案於今(115)年1/9確診。自6月中旬迄今之3週內,快速新增近9,000 例確定病例,當局正擴大疫苗接種計畫中。 美洲地區麻疹疫情嚴峻。自今年初迄6/27止,共17國累計報告逾2萬2,900例確定病例及39例死亡,較去年同期遽增181%。逾96%確定病例集中於墨西哥(11,820例)、瓜地馬拉(7,067例)、美國(2,134例)及加拿大(1,079例)。近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第23至24週病例報告數較前2週下降51.1%,主要為墨西哥、秘魯及美國病例減少;加拿大則處於疫情低點;另瓜地馬拉恐有通報延遲情形,須謹慎解讀該國疫情趨勢。
SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.en: Measles is rising in Zambia. From January to 3 July this year, 700 suspected cases have been reported nationally, including 119 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases have now been identified in 9 of the country's 10 provinces, with the most severe situation in Western Province. As many as 87.4% of confirmed cases had no vaccination record. Authorities plan to carry out emergency vaccination for children aged 6 months to 9 years in 5 high-risk districts from 6 to 11 July. Guatemala's outbreak is severe and continues to expand. As of 5 July this year, more than 25,700 cases have been reported nationally, of which 7,260 were laboratory-confirmed, and 24 deaths have occurred. This wave originated from a large religious gathering in December 2025, and the first case was confirmed on 9 January 2026. In the three weeks since mid-June, nearly 9,000 confirmed cases have been added rapidly, and authorities are expanding the vaccination programme. The measles outbreak in the Region of the Americas is severe. From the start of this year to 27 June, 17 countries have reported more than 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths cumulatively, a sharp 181% increase over the same period last year. More than 96% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Mexico (11,820), Guatemala (7,067), the United States (2,134) and Canada (1,079). The recent trend is declining: case reports in weeks 23–24 were 51.1% lower than in the previous two weeks, mainly because of fewer cases in Mexico, Peru and the United States. Canada is at a low point. Guatemala may have reporting delays, so its trend should be interpreted with caution.

g1M3XN9BEQ_tAwyvQ7OhDg.zh: 美國今年截至6/30累計12州報告48例病例,其中38例造成嚴重侵犯神經系統疾病,由於今年流行季提早開始,病例數為近10年來同期最高, 以亞利桑那州病例數最多。
g1M3XN9BEQ_tAwyvQ7OhDg.en: As of 30 June this year, 48 cases have been reported cumulatively from 12 states, of which 38 were severe neuroinvasive disease. Because the transmission season started earlier this year, the number of cases is the highest for this time of year in the past 10 years. Arizona has the largest number of cases.

-Aa0UWbC-VOFGfW0zUBsnA.zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥6/23報告1例確定病例(第1分支),近期無旅遊史,此為該市第2例確定病例,與2025年12月首例境外移入病例無關,感染源尚待釐清。今年該國累計報告11例確定病例(包含各分支),全美則已累計逾20例(第1分支)。該分支在歐美部分地區已出現社區傳播,主要影響MSM族群,因適逢當地舉辦驕傲大遊行活動,當局呼籲高風險族群應儘速接種兩劑型JYNNEOS疫苗。
-Aa0UWbC-VOFGfW0zUBsnA.en: The city of Chicago, Illinois, United States, reported a confirmed clade I case on 23 June. The patient had no recent travel history. This is the city's second confirmed case and is unrelated to the first imported case in December 2025; the source of infection remains unclear. This year, the country has reported 11 confirmed cases cumulatively (all clades), and more than 20 clade I cases have been reported nationwide cumulatively. This clade has shown community transmission in parts of Europe and the United States, mainly affecting men who have sex with men (MSM). Because a local Pride parade is taking place, authorities urge high-risk groups to get two doses of JYNNEOS vaccine as soon as possible.

Zv47-rf4Br5XvH06ckqdwQ.zh: 世界盃足球賽(FIFA) 主辦國疫情持續,  墨西哥自6/18-22新增55例確定病例。自2025年至2026/6/22止,已累計報告1萬8,440例確定病例,並導致11個州共43人死亡,其中西部哈里斯科州累計報告6,517例確定病例,為全國最高;而首都墨西哥城則累計達993例確定病例。 美國加州截至6/12報告50例確定病例,為去年度總數之兩倍,亦創下2019年以來新高。 加拿大截至6/22累計報告1,073例確定病例,專家表示頻繁的賽事跨國移動及墨國的本土疫情,疫情可能持續擴散。
Zv47-rf4Br5XvH06ckqdwQ.en: The outbreak continues in the host countries of the FIFA World Cup. Mexico reported 55 confirmed cases between 18 and 22 June. From 2025 through 22 June 2026, 18,440 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, causing 43 deaths across 11 states. Jalisco State in the west has the highest cumulative total, with 6,517 confirmed cases, while the capital, Mexico City, has reached 993 confirmed cases cumulatively. California, United States, reported 50 confirmed cases as of 12 June, twice last year's total and the highest since 2019. Canada reported 1,073 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 22 June. Experts say frequent cross-border movement during the tournament, together with the local outbreak in Mexico, may allow the outbreak to continue spreading.

AbvJosY3kTk-y4p-SW9DtQ.zh: 美國維吉亞州阿帕契步道(ATC)於5-6月爆發多起疫情,且有往北蔓延趨勢,多名健行者於旅途中陸續發病,累計感染人數不明,且無通報死亡病例。當局已發布公告,提醒健行者用肥皂洗手,勿共食或共用餐具,妥善處理排泄物,有症狀應休養3天。該國之典型流行季節為11月至隔年4月。
AbvJosY3kTk-y4p-SW9DtQ.en: Several outbreaks occurred on the Appalachian Trail (ATC) in Virginia from May to June and appear to be spreading northward. Multiple hikers fell ill during their journeys. The cumulative number of infections is unknown, and no deaths have been reported. Authorities have issued notices reminding hikers to wash hands with soap, avoid sharing food or utensils, dispose of waste properly, and rest for 3 days if symptomatic. The country's typical season is November to April.

m3B-QSkjq4z1pBzYacu06w.zh: 美國上週新增 31 例確定病例,今年累計2,104例(含11例境外移入),趨近114年全年確定病例數(2,288例) 。高達93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,其中21%為5歲以下兒童,51%為5至19 歲青少年,另約 6%的患者需住院治療 。以東南部南卡羅來納州累計670例為多,其次為西部猶他州(498例)。此外,東部維吉亞州近期疫情升溫,上週新增19例確定病例,累計達129例,多與5月白金漢郡(Buckingham)群聚疫情相關。 孟加拉自今年3月中旬以來疫情持續擴大,全國已累計通報9萬2,790例疑病例及逾1萬例確定病例,此為該國史上規模最大疫情,近期新增7名兒童疑染疫死亡。達卡地區累計病例最多,疑病例42,766例,確診病例7,501例;其他累計疑病例較多之地區包括吉大港(15,700例)、巴里薩爾(9,063例)、拉傑沙希(7,639 例)和庫爾納(6,648例)。
m3B-QSkjq4z1pBzYacu06w.en: The United States reported 31 new confirmed cases last week, bringing its total for this year to 2,104 (including 11 imported cases), approaching the 2,288 confirmed cases reported for the whole of 2025. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. By age, 21% were children under 5 years and 51% were adolescents aged 5 to 19 years, and about 6% required hospitalization. South Carolina has the highest cumulative total, with 670 cases, followed by Utah (498). In addition, cases in eastern Virginia have risen recently, with 19 new confirmed cases last week, bringing the cumulative total to 129; most are linked to a May outbreak in Buckingham County. In Bangladesh, the outbreak has continued to expand since mid-March this year. Nationwide, 92,790 suspected cases and more than 10,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, making this the largest outbreak in the country's history. Recently, 7 children with suspected infection have died. Dhaka has the most cumulative cases, with 42,766 suspected and 7,501 confirmed cases. Other areas with high cumulative suspected cases include Chattogram (15,700), Barisal (9,063), Rajshahi (7,639) and Khulna (6,648).

wLuFeInLehe5jCeRsXAI7w.zh: 美國亞利桑那州馬里科帕郡疫情上升,今年截至6/18已報告25例本土病例(2例死亡),高於去年同期的10例病例(無死亡),當局表示當地蚊媒活動增加,呼籲⺠眾採取防蚊措施,預防疾病發生。
wLuFeInLehe5jCeRsXAI7w.en: Maricopa County, Arizona, United States, has seen rising cases. As of 18 June this year, 25 locally acquired cases have been reported, including 2 deaths, compared with 10 cases and no deaths in the same period last year. Authorities say mosquito activity has increased locally and urge the public to take mosquito-prevention measures to prevent disease.

x8c7K9KuaiSaixHxn5CWHw.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,過去24小時內新增972例病例,自今年3月中旬爆發疫情迄今累計報告86,923例疑病例(10,387例為確定病例),死亡656例(其中93例確定病例死亡),致死率為0.9%,疫情以首都達卡地區最為嚴峻。 美國疫情更新,今年迄今累計2,073例病例,6%病患住院治療,近期維吉亞州白金漢郡病例數明顯上升,該州今年迄6/11 已累計110例病例。另該國去年全年累計2,288例病例。 瓜地馬拉自今年1/9迄6/12累計報告16,840例病例(6,903例為確定病例),其中有22例死亡,死亡病例以7歲以下兒童為主,1歲以下兒童死亡率高於一般族群,隨著當局大規模疫苗接種措施,疫情已呈下降趨勢,惟隨著實驗室診斷確診為非必要項目,實際疫情仍可能受低估。
x8c7K9KuaiSaixHxn5CWHw.en: Bangladesh outbreak update: in the past 24 hours, 972 new cases were added. Since the outbreak began in mid-March this year, 86,923 suspected cases (including 10,387 confirmed cases) have been reported cumulatively, with 656 deaths (93 of them confirmed cases), a case fatality ratio of 0.9%. The outbreak is most severe in the capital, Dhaka. United States outbreak update: 2,073 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, and 6% of patients were hospitalized. Cases in Buckingham County, Virginia, have risen markedly recently, and the state has reported 110 cases cumulatively this year as of 11 June. The country reported 2,288 cases for the whole of last year. Guatemala has reported 16,840 cases cumulatively from 9 January this year to 12 June (6,903 confirmed), including 22 deaths. Deaths are mainly among children under 7 years, and the mortality rate among infants under 1 year is higher than in the general population. With large-scale vaccination by authorities, the outbreak has shown a downward trend; however, as laboratory confirmation is no longer a required step for every case, the actual outbreak may still be underestimated.

YKLilwWshQVZnsBg-L2Gow.zh: 美國6/13報告3例病例,皆為嬰兒,分布於加州、華盛頓及賓夕法亞州,病患介於4/20-5/31發病,目前持續住院治療中,經調查感染源為某生產商生產的嬰兒配方奶,於全美市場占比小於1%,當局已要求產品下架。
YKLilwWshQVZnsBg-L2Gow.en: On 13 June, the United States reported 3 cases, all in infants, located in California, Washington and Pennsylvania, with onset between 20 April and 31 May. The patients remain hospitalized. Investigation traced the source to infant formula produced by one manufacturer, which accounts for less than 1% of the US market, and authorities have ordered the product withdrawn from sale.

7kg21dMdCNrHBBqWrn2sEQ.zh: 美國新墨西哥州聖塔菲郡報告今年首例女性死亡病例,當局已進行接觸者調查。該州於2024及2025年分別報告1、 3例人類感染病例。
7kg21dMdCNrHBBqWrn2sEQ.en: In Santa Fe County, New Mexico, United States, authorities reported the first death of a woman this year and have carried out contact investigations. The state reported 1 and 3 human infection cases in 2024 and 2025, respectively.

-v4rB5fxM4Xy74jljXsMkA.zh: 美國報告近期於都會區發現野生動物狂犬病案例。加州聖地牙哥郡(San Diego County)警示當地蝙蝠陽性檢出率攀升;羅德島州東普羅維登斯(East Providence )亦通報1件土撥鼠感染確定病例。針對羅德島州,相關單位已完成4名接觸者與2隻犬隻暴露後預防接種。
-v4rB5fxM4Xy74jljXsMkA.en: The United States has reported recent cases of wildlife rabies in metropolitan areas. San Diego County, California, has warned that the positivity rate in local bats is rising. East Providence, Rhode Island, has reported one confirmed rabies infection in a woodchuck. For Rhode Island, the relevant authorities have completed post-exposure vaccination for four contacts and two dogs.

7y0LnGrNoiw1KQYpL1RJYA.zh: 孟加拉今年自3/15截至6/9累計報告8萬0,104例病例(其中9,779 例為確定病例),死亡628例(其中92例確定病例死亡),已有61,278例康復,疫情以首都達卡地區最為嚴峻,已報告3萬7,387例疑病例及6,794例確定病例。 美國今年截至6/4累計報告2,030例確定病例,其中127例住院,疫情分布40個州,病患以5-19歲年齡層占大宗(51%),有92%病例未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。
7y0LnGrNoiw1KQYpL1RJYA.en: Bangladesh has reported 80,104 cumulative cases this year from 15 March to 9 June, of which 9,779 were confirmed, with 628 deaths (92 among confirmed cases) and 61,278 recovered. The outbreak is most severe in the capital Dhaka region, where 37,387 suspected cases and 6,794 confirmed cases have been reported. The United States has reported 2,030 confirmed cases this year as of 4 June, of which 127 were hospitalised. Cases have been reported in 40 states; those aged 5–19 years make up the majority (51%), and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status.

TNdBRnh0EJcY8A4iGFNsGQ.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/6累計515例確定病例(91例死亡、12例康復),致死率17.7%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約50.3%。過去 24 小時新增27例確診病例,均集中在伊圖里省。 1名在剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省布亞(Bunia)醫院執行手術而暴露感染的美國籍醫師,於德國醫院接受治療(包括實驗性治療), 現已康復出院。該病患於5/20後送德國,接受抗病毒藥物及支持性治療後,因連續72小時無症狀,且2次PCR結果為陰性,故解除隔離。其5名同住家人接觸者,經預防性隔離均無症狀 。
TNdBRnh0EJcY8A4iGFNsGQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 6 June, 515 confirmed cases have been reported (91 deaths, 12 recovered), with a CFR of 17.7%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 50.3%. In the past 24 hours, 27 new confirmed cases were added, all in Ituri Province. A US citizen physician who was exposed to infection while performing surgery at Bunia Hospital in Ituri Province, DRC, was treated in a German hospital, including with experimental therapy, and has now recovered and been discharged. The physician was transferred to Germany after 20 May and received antiviral drugs and supportive care. Isolation was lifted after 72 consecutive hours without symptoms and two negative PCR results. Five household contacts placed under precautionary isolation remained asymptomatic.

kZIfjnb25tN1rTnJTicyng.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/3累計381例確定病例(64例死亡、7例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約55.5%。 美國CDC 於6/5 MMWR 表示目前R0相對較高,且隔離率低於50%情況下,預估有1萬例確診與2,000例死亡。另評估疫情輸入與社區傳播機率極低,在未來 3 個月對美國一般⺠眾整體風險為「低」,惟一旦發生個案,疾病嚴重度與防疫資源需求將造成「高影響」。
kZIfjnb25tN1rTnJTicyng.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 3 June, 381 confirmed cases have been reported (64 deaths, 7 recovered). The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 55.5%. The US CDC, in its 5 June MMWR, stated that with a relatively high R0 and an isolation rate below 50%, it estimates 10,000 confirmed cases and 2,000 deaths. The CDC assessed the probability of importation and community transmission as extremely low. Over the next three months, the overall risk to the general US public is rated low; however, if a case occurs, the high impact on disease severity and prevention resource needs would be rated high.

z8yLb29WscLB_zR8c2jXyQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 363 例確定病例(62 例死亡、6 例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 25 個衛生區,其中重災區伊圖里省新增曼巴薩(Mambasa)衛生區,DRC 接觸者追蹤率僅約 45.5%。 西班牙取消 DRC 國家足球隊的世界盃熱身賽;美國要求 DRC 國家足球隊在入境參與世界盃前,必須先完成 21 天隔離。
z8yLb29WscLB_zR8c2jXyQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 2 June, 363 confirmed cases have been reported (62 deaths, 6 recovered), concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Within the heavily affected Ituri Province, Mambasa health zone has been newly added. DRC's contact tracing rate is only about 45.5%. Spain has cancelled the DRC national football team's World Cup warm-up match. The United States requires the DRC national football team to complete 21 days of quarantine before entering to take part in the World Cup.

uIIDKs3S1KUFOYCafYYgwA.zh: 美國紐約州布魯姆郡(Broome)某矯正機構自 5/25 迄今累計報告逾300 例病例,其中 10 例住院,經查感染源為該矯正機構餐廳之雞肉沙拉,當局已加強清消、暫停探視、進行接觸者追蹤並將食物分開採購。另美國每年估計有 130 萬例沙門氏菌感染者。
uIIDKs3S1KUFOYCafYYgwA.en: A correctional facility in Broome County, New York State, has reported more than 300 cumulative cases since 25 May, of which 10 were hospitalised. The investigation identified the source as chicken salad from the facility's restaurant. Authorities have intensified disinfection, suspended visitation, conducted contact tracing and separated food procurement. The United States is estimated to have 1.3 million Salmonella infections each year.

SJmBrqhe4YPbdZj9G7ox1Q.zh: 美國紐約州長島報告當地首例人類感染波旁病毒(Bourbon virus)病例,為一名67歲男性戶外工作者,於2021年遭蜱蟲叮咬,出現皮疹、發燒、盜汗及頭痛,經5天醫療照護,最後康復,該病例其後參加追蹤研究,並每季抽血,於今年5月確診。專家評估長島之孤星蜱蟲數量眾多,該地區可能有未被發現的感染者。
SJmBrqhe4YPbdZj9G7ox1Q.en: New York's Long Island has reported its first locally acquired human Bourbon virus infection. The patient is a 67-year-old man who works outdoors. He was bitten by a tick in 2021 and developed a rash, fever, night sweats and headache. After five days of medical care he recovered. He later took part in a follow-up study with quarterly blood draws, and was diagnosed in May this year. Experts assess that the population of lone star ticks on Long Island is large, and undetected infections may exist in the area.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

fw7XnYqO5xXj4vpOOG2wMw.zh: 美國加州南洛杉磯郡5/23公布1起群聚疫情,病例數仍調查中,病患皆食用從墨西哥銷入的未殺菌起司。該郡過往每年報告低於15例病例,多與食用未殺菌起司、職業或實驗室暴露有關,當局呼籲民眾避免食用生食或未經殺菌的乳製品。
fw7XnYqO5xXj4vpOOG2wMw.en: On 23 May, Southern Los Angeles County, California, United States, announced a cluster; case numbers are still under investigation. All patients ate unpasteurised cheese sold after being shipped from Mexico. In past years the county has reported fewer than 15 cases a year, mostly linked to eating unpasteurised cheese or to occupational or laboratory exposure. Authorities urge the public to avoid eating raw or unpasteurised dairy products.

azpg5Le0VR9qCorl0ziicw.zh: 馬達加斯加第I分支Ib子分支(Ib型)疫情持續升溫,自2025年12月爆發疫情迄今,累計通報2,793例,其中1,606例確診,檢測陽性率達67%,疫情已蔓延至54個衛生區,目前累計6例死亡。當局已啟動及擴大(包括監獄等高風險場所)疫苗接種計畫。 美國康乃狄克州於2026年5月13日公布首例Clade1病例,為具西歐旅遊史之境外移入個案。自2024年11月迄今,全美累計報告逾20例Clade1病例,均與前往疫區旅行或與旅客密切接觸有關,尚無本土社區傳播。當局呼籲高風險者儘速完成兩劑JYNNEOS疫苗接種。
azpg5Le0VR9qCorl0ziicw.en: Madagascar's clade I, subclade Ib outbreak continues to escalate. Since the outbreak began in December 2025, 2,793 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 1,606 are confirmed, with a test positivity rate of 67%. The outbreak has spread to 54 health zones, with six deaths cumulatively. Authorities have launched and expanded vaccination, including in high-risk settings such as prisons. Connecticut, United States, announced its first clade I case on 13 May 2026, an imported case with a recent travel history to Western Europe. Since November 2024, more than 20 clade I cases have been reported in total across the United States. All are linked to travel to outbreak areas or close contact with travellers, and there is no local community transmission. Authorities urge high-risk people to complete a two-dose JYNNEOS vaccination course as soon as possible.

tT9I7Ozz-Y4xuXXRITLszA.zh: 秘魯普諾大區今年截至5/14報告231例確診及115例疑病例,近期疫情大幅增加且為近年來規模最大的疫情之一,該國宣布疫情為衛生緊急事件,涵蓋大都會利馬、卡亞俄憲法省及另外12個省份。另美洲地區2025年報告14,891例確診病例,高於2024年的466例。 美國疫情持續,今年迄今累計報告1,893例病例,76%為19歲以下兒童及青年,92%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,6%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州及猶他州為多,該國去年共計2,288例病例。
tT9I7Ozz-Y4xuXXRITLszA.en: In the Puno Region of Peru, 231 confirmed cases and 115 suspected cases had been reported as of 14 May this year. Recent cases have increased sharply, and this is one of the largest outbreaks in recent years. The country has declared the outbreak a public health emergency, covering the Lima Metropolitan Area, the Constitutional Province of Callao and 12 other provinces.
