In addition, the Americas reported 14,891 confirmed measles cases in 2025, up from 466 in 2024. In the United States, the outbreak continues: 1,893 cases have been reported so far this year, 76% of them aged 19 or under, 92% unvaccinated or with unknown vaccination history, and 6% hospitalised. Cases are most numerous in South Carolina and Utah. The country reported 2,288 cases last year.

gMS68mUFR5VmI18yfaw-lA.zh: 美國及丹麥等9個歐洲國家今年截至5/12累計報告62例病例,病患多為兒童及年輕人,多數需住院治療,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疑為單一食物來源感染,各國當局仍持續調查感染來源。 美國5/12報告37例病例,其中多數需住院治療,病患分布於12個州,經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商之奶粉相關產品,產品已要求下架。
gMS68mUFR5VmI18yfaw-lA.en: The United States and nine European countries including Denmark have reported 62 cases this year as of 12 May. Most patients are children and young people, and most required hospitalisation. Genotyping shows Salmonella Stanley ST2045, which is suspected to be infection from a single food source; authorities in each country continue to investigate the source. On 12 May, the United States reported 37 cases, most requiring hospitalisation, distributed across 12 states. An investigation by authorities suspects a milk powder-related product from a certain manufacturer as the source, and the product has been asked to be withdrawn.

WqgH0fc6E59X80_IFJEN4Q.zh: 美國報告1起郵輪群聚事件,截至5/11累計報告160例病例,占全體乘客及工作人員的3.6%,符合侵襲率超過3%需通報的規範,並確認致病原為諾羅病毒。該船4/28自佛羅里達州啟航,預計經過巴哈馬後前往佛羅里達州。另美國近年研究顯示GII.17型病毒的盛行,可能導致多數乘客於欠缺免疫防護下感染病毒。
WqgH0fc6E59X80_IFJEN4Q.en: The United States reported one cruise-ship cluster, with 160 cases cumulatively as of 11 May, equal to 3.6% of all passengers and crew. This meets the reporting criterion of an attack rate above 3%, and norovirus was confirmed as the pathogen. The ship departed from Florida on 28 April and is expected to call at the Bahamas before returning to Florida. Recent US studies show circulation of GII.17 virus, which may lead to most passengers becoming infected without immune protection.

VtbuANBexIxPct0vorNSdA.zh: 美國加州洛杉磯郡報告全球首例透過家貓傳人之H5N1禽流感確診病例。2024年底當地5戶19隻貓隻因食用含病毒之生乳或生肉染病,並檢測出A(H5N1;2.3.4.4b基因型B3.13)。1名無家禽接觸史之獸醫,在未著防護下接觸染病貓隻,雖暴露後7天PCR檢測陰性且全程無症狀,惟於2025年4月血清檢測出針對A(H5N1)2.3.4.4.b病毒抗體陽性。此案證實貓傳人途徑,當局呼籲獸醫落實防護、避免寵物生食,並嚴防與季節性流感發生基因重組。
VtbuANBexIxPct0vorNSdA.en: Los Angeles County, California, reported the world's first H5N1 avian influenza case confirmed as transmitted from a domestic cat to a human. At the end of 2024, five households with 19 cats locally were infected after eating raw milk or raw meat containing the virus, and A(H5N1; genotype B3.13 of clade 2.3.4.4b) was detected. A veterinarian with no poultry exposure handled infected cats without protection. Although the veterinarian's PCR tests were negative seven days after exposure and he remained asymptomatic throughout, antibodies against A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b virus were detected in serum in April 2025. This case confirms the cat-to-human route of transmission. Authorities urge veterinarians to use protection, avoid feeding pets raw food, and guard strictly against genetic reassortment with seasonal influenza.

Yx6f3Cr9T8D715PBvTjq8g.zh: 美國紐澤西州馬瓦市於5/3發生罕見攻擊事件,1隻海狸自水中衝出後,於湖畔咬傷多名遊客,該海狸於5/5確診狂犬病。目前接觸個案皆已進行暴露後預防接種。此外,德州艾爾帕索郡亦於5月初檢出1件蝙蝠確診案例。該國每年報告近4,000件動物案例,逾90%發生於野生動物(蝙蝠、浣熊、臭鼬及狐狸等),當局呼籲民眾避免接觸野生動物,若遭抓咬傷應盡速就醫。
Yx6f3Cr9T8D715PBvTjq8g.en: In Mahwah, New Jersey, a rare attack occurred on 3 May when a beaver ran out of the water and bit several people along the lakeshore; the beaver was confirmed rabid on 5 May. All exposed people have received post-exposure vaccination. In addition, El Paso County, Texas, detected one rabid bat in early May. The United States reports nearly 4,000 animal rabies cases each year, more than 90% in wildlife (bats, raccoons, skunks and foxes, among others). Authorities urge people to avoid contact with wildlife and to seek medical care promptly if bitten or scratched.

SiXhOcqZuwOcv8ywEp3lMQ.zh: 美國密西根州病例數上升,今年截至 4 月累計 250 例確診病例,2025 年報告 3,380 例病例,高於 2024 年及 2022 年病例數(分別為 1,969 及 1,114 例)。該國許多地區於今年春季因蜱蟲叮咬之急診就診率達2017 年以來同期最高,相較往年多數病例發生在 5-8 月間,顯示蜱蟲活躍季比往年更早且更為嚴重,另流行範圍已從東北部和中大西洋地區的高發率區往外擴展。
SiXhOcqZuwOcv8ywEp3lMQ.en: Case numbers are rising in Michigan, with 250 confirmed cases reported cumulatively as of April this year. The state reported 3,380 cases in 2025, higher than in 2024 and 2022 (1,969 and 1,114 cases respectively). In many parts of the country, emergency department visits for tick bites this spring were the highest for the same period since 2017. Compared with previous years, when most cases occurred between May and August, the tick season is earlier and more severe, and the outbreak range has expanded outward from high-incidence areas in the northeast and mid-Atlantic regions.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

RlAEsdiyCHKKzWF1-x-6BA.zh: 美國近期報告廣泛抗藥性的病例顯著增加,檢出率從 2011 年的 0% 上升至 2023 年的 8.5%,其中約三分之一需住院治療,8 成無國際旅遊史。早期病例多為兒童或前往衛生環境較差地區旅遊的旅客,近年病患多為成年男性,且多有 MSM 經驗,其中半數同時感染 HIV,另街友亦是高風險族群。
RlAEsdiyCHKKzWF1-x-6BA.en: The United States has recently reported a significant increase in extensively drug-resistant shigellosis, with the detection rate rising from 0% in 2011 to 8.5% in 2023. About one-third of cases required hospitalisation, and 80% had no international travel history. Early cases were mainly children or travellers to areas with poor sanitation. In recent years, patients have mostly been adult men, many with a history of sex with men (MSM), and half of them were co-infected with HIV. Homeless people are also a high-risk group.

eK65tlfnocPqcZP_5VrW1g.zh: 美國2/26-3/31報告34例病例,其中13例住院,尚無死亡報告,病患分布於佛羅里達等13個州,以密西根州6例為多,5 歲以下病患占41%,約8成病患有家中家禽(雞、鴨)接觸史,當局評估疑有相關供應鏈販售之雞鴨遭受汙染,此波疫情造成的高住院率需密切監測。另該國每年約有135萬例病例。
eK65tlfnocPqcZP_5VrW1g.en: The United States reported 34 cases from 26 February to 31 March, of which 13 were hospitalised, with no deaths reported. Cases were distributed across 13 states including Florida, with Michigan the highest at six cases. Children under five made up 41% of patients, and about 80% had contact with domestic poultry (chickens and ducks) at home. Authorities assess that poultry sold through related supply chains may be contaminated, and the high hospitalisation rate in this wave requires close monitoring. The country also has around 1.35 million cases a year.

9kbwa7GYOXovxoSQxO2CCQ.zh: 美國加州今年截至 4/18 平均每週報告 14.5 例病例,疫情高於 2025 年(3.4 例/週)及 2024 年(5.8 例/週)。另今年迄今已累計報告 7 例 I 型病例,當局表示多數感染者未接種疫苗,呼籲高風險族群應踴躍接種疫苗。
9kbwa7GYOXovxoSQxO2CCQ.en: California, United States, has averaged 14.5 reported cases a week so far this year through 18 April, higher than in 2025 (3.4 cases a week) and 2024 (5.8 cases a week). A total of seven clade I cases have been reported this year. Authorities say most infected people were unvaccinated and urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated.

Ol0O_z_3oI0r5xELmgSfYw.zh: 美國麻疹疫情趨緩,最新 1 週新增 34 例,為 2026 年單週最低。今年累計報告 1,748 例,94%與 19 起群聚相關,病例分布於全國32 州及紐約市,迄無死亡報告,住院率約 6%。92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,且 72%為 19 歲以下族群。 WHO及非洲CDC分析,2000 至 2024 年間非洲 44 國將第 2 劑麻疹疫苗納入常規接種,覆蓋率從 5%提升至 55%,逾 5 億兒童受惠,病例下降 40%,成功預防近 1,950 萬例死亡案例。
Ol0O_z_3oI0r5xELmgSfYw.en: The US measles outbreak is slowing: the latest week saw 34 new cases, the lowest weekly figure for 2026. This year, 1,748 cases have been reported cumulatively, 94% of them linked to 19 clusters. Cases are distributed across 32 states and New York City, with no deaths reported and a hospitalisation rate of about 6%. 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 72% were under 19 years old. WHO and Africa CDC analysed that between 2000 and 2024, 44 African countries introduced a second dose of measles vaccine into routine immunisation, raising coverage from 5% to 55%. More than 500 million children have benefited, cases have fallen by 40%, and nearly 19.5 million deaths have been averted.

PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,今(2026)年截至 4/8 累計報告 236 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印12例為多,其次為紐西蘭7例,以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 72 例、鹿兒島縣27 例、愛知縣 23 例及神奈川/千葉縣 20 例為多。 美國疫情持續,今年截至 4/9 共 33 州累計報告 1,704 例確定病例,其中 96 例住院,病患以 5-19 歲年齡層族群(888 例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(667 例),其次為猶他州(408)及德州(176 例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他州。
PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 8 April this year, 236 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. Indonesia accounted for the most imported cases (12), followed by New Zealand (7). Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (72 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (27), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa and Chiba Prefectures (20) reported the most. The United States outbreak continues: as of 9 April, 1,704 confirmed cases have been reported across 33 states this year, of which 96 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (888 cases), concentrated in South Carolina (667 cases), followed by Utah (408) and Texas (176). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah.

SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 11 週(3/16-22)全球陽性率上升為 2.47%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 德國疫情呈下降,目前處低點,第 13 週新增 282 例病例;變異株以 NB.1.8.1(68%)為主,另變異株 BA.3.2 占比上升,從今年9-10 週的 5%,上升至第 10-11 週的 11%。 英國疫情略升,第 13 週實驗室檢測陽性率略增至 2.1%。變異株以 XFG 占大宗,BA.3 於 2/16-3/1 占比為 2.13%。 GISAID 去年 12 月迄今的病毒株定序資料顯示,BA.3.2 多數易感宿主為年輕族群,其中,愛爾蘭高達 38.8%及法國 27%病例為 18 歲以下族群;美國 49.1%及盧森堡 23.4%病例為 10 歲以下族群,與其他變異株感染病患的年齡層分布顯著不同。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 31.44%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30.68%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有 6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.en: Epidemic update: In week 11 of this year (16–22 March), the global positivity rate rose to 2.47%, with notable increases in the WHO South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean regions. Germany's epidemic is declining and is currently at a low point, with 282 new cases reported in week 13. NB.1.8.1 (68%) remains the predominant variant, while the share of BA.3.2 has risen from 5% in weeks 9–10 of this year to 11% in weeks 10–11. The UK's epidemic has risen slightly, and laboratory test positivity increased slightly to 2.1% in week 13. XFG accounts for the largest share of variants, and BA.3 accounted for 2.13% during 16 February–1 March. Sequencing data in GISAID since December last year show that most BA.3.2 infections occur in young people: 38.8% of cases in the Republic of Ireland and 27% in France were under 18 years, and 49.1% of cases in the United States and 23.4% in Luxembourg were under 10 years, a significantly different age distribution from patients infected with other variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (31.44%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30.68%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至4/1累計報告197例,其中28例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占50%),分布以東京都48例、鹿兒島縣24例、愛知縣23例及神奈川縣19例為多。該國去(2025)年報告265例確定病例。 孟加拉疫情上升,該國今年截至3月累計報告722例確定病例,其中僅3月即報告514例,57%病例為6個月以下嬰兒,自3月中旬以來已報告逾7,600例疑病例,近6週報告逾113例死亡,當局已針對30個高風險地區,共計逾130萬名6個月至5歲以下兒童啟動緊急疫苗接種作業。 美洲疫情持續,墨西哥今年截至4/6累計報告8,750例確定病例,其中9例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(5,062例)為多;美國今年截至4/2共33州累計報告1,671例確定病例,猶他州近期疫情上升;加拿大今年截至3/21累計報告650例確定病例,病例數以曼托巴省(392例)及亞伯達省(209例)為多;瓜地馬拉疫情上升,今年截至3/29共計22省累計報告3,594例確定病例,其中54%病例集中於中南部瓜地馬拉省,該國正聖週期間,宗教活動及旅遊增加,預期病例數將持續上升。
0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 1 April this year, 197 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 28 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (48 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (24), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa Prefecture (19) reported the most. Japan reported 265 confirmed cases last year. Bangladesh's outbreak is rising: as of March this year, 722 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 514 were reported in March alone; 57% of cases were infants under 6 months old. Since mid-March, more than 7,600 suspected cases have been reported, and more than 113 deaths were reported over the past six weeks. Authorities have launched emergency vaccination for more than 1.3 million children aged 6 months to under 5 years in 30 high-risk areas. The outbreak in the Americas continues: as of 6 April this year, Mexico has reported 8,750 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 9 deaths, with most cases in western Jalisco State (5,062 cases). As of 2 April this year, the United States has reported 1,671 confirmed cases across 33 states, and the outbreak in Utah has recently risen. As of 21 March this year, Canada has reported 650 confirmed cases, mainly in Manitoba (392 cases) and Alberta (209 cases). Guatemala's outbreak is rising: as of 29 March this year, 3,594 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 departments, with 54% concentrated in Guatemala Department in the central-south. ZD8Wm_weSJsAdzg7B7IEYA.en: The United States reported 9 cases as of 30 March. Of three hospitalized patients, one developed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS). Cases were distributed across California, Florida and Texas, and children under 5 years accounted for more than half of cases. Authorities investigated and suspect the source of infection to be fresh cheese manufactured by a certain producer; the product has been withdrawn from sale.

xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.zh: WHO美洲區更新流行病學報告,該區去年共計報告46,870例確定病例,低於2024年同期(66,184例),其中以美國病例數為多,共計報告28,783例確定(含疑)病例,以11-19歲年齡層為多,其次為秘魯(4,632例),另智利(3,387例)、巴西(2,682例)、墨西哥(1,596例)、阿根廷(1,210例)及哥倫比亞(1,178例)亦報告逾千例確定病例。另美國今年截至3/27已報告2,355例確定病例。
xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.

VVLKRAMh2PYcC-p6bAkmLw.en: Epidemic update: In week 10 of this year (2–8 March), the global positivity rate fell to 2.27%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region. The United States' epidemic is declining, with the positivity rate down to 2.5% in week 11, and XFG the main variant. Since the first imported case of the BA.3.2 variant was reported last June, the first locally acquired BA.3.2 case was newly reported on 25 March this year. A recent US CDC study shows that as of 11 February this year, 23 countries worldwide had reported BA.3.2 cases cumulatively, and BA.3.2 accounted for 30% of reports in Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (48.87%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (16.59%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

VkV-BraII9UK1d48LmYMGw.en: The United States outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 1,478 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 32 states, of which 74 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (781 cases), and cases are concentrated in South Carolina (668 cases), followed by Utah (275 cases) and Texas (147 cases). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah and Texas, and 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 7,584 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Cases are concentrated in western Jalisco State (4,439 cases), southern Chiapas State (650 cases) and Mexico City in the central region (563 cases). All states have reported cases since last year, mainly among children aged 1–4 years. Yemen's outbreak is severe: in government-controlled areas, more than 1,200 confirmed cases and 8 deaths were reported in January this year, and cases have risen sharply in the coastal area of Hadramawt, where vaccination coverage is only 7%. Authorities say the outbreak in areas not controlled by the government may be even more severe. The country is estimated to have reported more than 23,000 confirmed cases cumulatively last year.

IbhX00P0GiXta-e5PcGGpA.en: New York City reported the first imported Clade I mpox case in the United States on 13 March; subclade typing is pending. The patient had travelled to Europe and is in isolation. Authorities say there is no local transmission and assess the risk to the public as low. Since November 2024 the United States has reported 12 Clade I cases cumulatively; in response to rising Clade Ib cases in Europe, authorities have strengthened disease surveillance, contact tracing and assessment of post-exposure vaccination for high-risk groups. Argentina reported its first locally acquired Clade Ib case, a 31-year-old man in the capital, Buenos Aires City, who developed rash, fever, muscle and headache pain, anorectal pain and lymphadenopathy from 24 February. The patient reports no recent international travel, but had sexual contact with several travellers before symptom onset.

GWGDQhSjp3Lfe9cim6to7Q.zh: 美國佛羅里達州新增1起郵輪群聚事件,累計報告193例病例,分別為乘客141例、工作人員52例,病患占全體郵輪人員約3%。該郵輪於3/15抵達該州的羅德岱堡市港口(Fort Lauderdale),當局已介入調查及輔導感染管制措施。
GWGDQhSjp3Lfe9cim6to7Q.en: Florida, USA, has reported one new cruise ship cluster, with 193 cases cumulatively: 141 passengers and 52 crew members. Patients account for about 3% of all cruise ship personnel. The ship arrived at the port of Fort Lauderdale in the state on 15 March, and authorities have intervened to investigate and advise on infection control measures.

KqSJDjpCRWqdUxFwep7LAw.zh: 美國新墨西哥州報告今年首例確定病例,病患住院治療後已康復,該州疫情多發生在5-8月,當局提醒民眾於春季大掃除前,應進行通風換氣,並於清理可能存在囓齒動物區域時,採取預防措施。該州於2025年累計報告7例確定病例,其中3例死亡,另自1993年以來累計142例確定病例,該州為該國病例數最多之地區。
KqSJDjpCRWqdUxFwep7LAw.en: New Mexico, USA, has reported its first confirmed case this year; the patient recovered after hospital treatment. Outbreaks in the state usually occur from May to August. Authorities remind residents to ventilate their homes before spring cleaning and to take precautions when clearing areas where rodents may be present. The state reported 7 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 3 died. Since 1993 the state has reported 142 confirmed cases cumulatively, the highest number of any state in the country.

The current situation in the two countries is as follows. United States: as of 5 March this year, 1,277 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 31 states, of which 62 were hospitalized. Of the cases, 23% were children under 5 years and 77% were under 19 years; 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 662 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (184 cases); recent outbreaks have been concentrated in Texas, Utah, Colorado and North Dakota. Mexico: the outbreak continues, with 6,104 confirmed cases reported cumulatively as of 6 March this year, including 7 deaths. Cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (3,604 cases), southern Chiapas (540 cases) and central Mexico City (424 cases).

gKtBSPfc1u_0vfD75q6LTA.en: Indonesia reported 572 confirmed cases this year through week 7, including 4 deaths. Eleven provinces reported 21 outbreaks (13 confirmed), and authorities have strengthened surveillance and investigation. Last year, Indonesia reported more than 11,000 confirmed cases, including 69 deaths. The United States outbreak continues: as of 26 February this year, 1,136 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 28 states, of which 58 were hospitalized; 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 653 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (149 cases) and Florida (107 cases) (US CDC). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 10 February this year, 20,231 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 provinces, including 238 deaths. In the same period last year, 7,491 cases were reported, including 93 deaths. The country's vaccination coverage among children under 5 years was only 57% in 2018, and authorities urge parents to take children to vaccination sites to complete vaccination.

WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.zh: 哈薩克疫情上升,今 (2026) 年截至2/20報告3,343例確定病例,其中84.2%為14歲以下兒童,另77.6%為未接種疫苗兒童,分布於阿斯塔納和阿拉木圖等9個地區。當局已發布防疫命令,包括擴大免疫接種運動、暫時禁止未接種疫苗兒童進入學校和幼稚園,以及強制醫護人員接種疫苗。 美國疫情持續,今(2026)年截至2/19共26州累計報告982例確定病例,其中38例住院,該國94%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明, 病例數以南卡羅來納州報告632例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(117例)及佛羅里達州(64例),其中佛羅里達州病患主要與柯里爾郡(Collier)之聖母瑪利亞大學相關,該校已加強相關疫情防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至2/23累計報告4,497例確定病例,其中5例死亡,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(2,662例)、南部恰帕斯州(393例)為多。該國自去(2025)年年初爆發疫情,2025年累計報告6,444例確定病例,其中27例死亡,其中以1-4歲嬰兒為多(1,548例)。 英國北倫敦地區爆發疫情,英蘭地區今年已累計96例確診病例,主要分布於倫敦及西密德蘭區域,病例以10歲以下兒童為多,2成之感染兒童住院治療中,所有住院兒童均未完全接種疫苗。當局已設立臨時疫苗接種所,鼓勵補接種疫苗。
rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.en: Kazakhstan's outbreak is rising. As of 20 February this year, 3,343 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 84.2% were children under 14 years and 77.6% were unvaccinated children, distributed across nine regions including Astana and Almaty. Authorities have issued prevention orders, including expanding immunization campaigns, temporarily banning unvaccinated children from entering schools and kindergartens, and requiring health workers to be vaccinated. The United States outbreak continues: as of 19 February this year, 982 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 states, of which 38 were hospitalized; 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 632 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (117 cases) and Florida (64 cases). Florida's patients are mainly linked to Ave Maria University in Collier County, which has strengthened outbreak prevention and control measures. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 23 February this year, 4,497 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 5 deaths; cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (2,662 cases) and southern Chiapas (393 cases). The outbreak in Mexico began in early last year; 6,444 confirmed cases, including 27 deaths, were reported in 2025, mainly among infants aged 1–4 years (1,548 cases). In north London, an outbreak has occurred: England has reported 96 confirmed cases so far this year, mainly in London and the West Midlands, mostly among children under 10 years. Twenty per cent of infected children are being treated in hospital, and all hospitalized children were not fully vaccinated. Authorities have set up temporary vaccination sites to encourage catch-up vaccination.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

iNWe5elwnuQeRAYk3gHxfQ.zh: 美國於1/29報告65例病例,其中14例住院,病患分布於28個州,發病日介於2025年8/22至今年1/11,與典型的季節性(夏末至初秋達到高峰)模式不同。經當局調查疑感染源為某生產商製造之辣木葉粉,商品已下架。 新加坡今年第3週(1/18-24)報告22例病例,較近5年同期中位數(24例)低;近期發表的研究顯示該國2019年之沙門氏菌感染症病例累計2,050例,占該國食物相關傳染病之大宗(占33%),並造成812萬美元之經濟負擔。CDA 1/29、Value in Health Regional Issues 1/16
iNWe5elwnuQeRAYk3gHxfQ.en: The United States reported 65 cases on 29 January, 14 of them hospitalised, across 28 states, with onset dates between 22 August 2025 and 11 January 2026. This differs from the typical seasonal pattern, which peaks from late summer to early autumn. Authorities suspect the source is moringa leaf powder produced by one manufacturer, and the product has been removed from sale. Singapore reported 22 cases in week 3 (18–24 January), below the five-year median of 24 for the same period. A recently published study found 2,050 cumulative Salmonella infection cases in Singapore in 2019, the largest share of food-related infectious diseases (33%), with an economic burden of US$8.12 million. Sources: CDA, 29 January; Value in Health Regional Issues, 16 January.

veEJc0FEsZOrYtgpONTj9g.zh: 美國疫情持續,今(2026)年截至1/29共17州累計報告588例確定病例,其中17例住院,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告467例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州53例確定病例,該國94%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/猶他/亞利桑那州。該國去(2025)年報告2,267例病例,為近30年最高。
veEJc0FEsZOrYtgpONTj9g.en: The outbreak in the United States continues. As of 29 January 2026, 588 confirmed cases had been reported this year across 17 states, 17 of whom were hospitalised. Most cases were in South Carolina, with 467 confirmed cases, followed by Utah with 53. 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina, Utah and Arizona. The country reported 2,267 cases in 2025, the highest in nearly 30 years.

9wU_xa_LRU9ctXgUAHFAAA.zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥市於1/15-30報告7例成人確定病例,其中2例死亡,3例為Y血清型,Y型為該市自2022年以來之主要流行菌株,當局已啟動密切接觸者追蹤及防治作業。該市每年約有10-15例確定病例,病患多集中於冬季,病例常見於老年人、青少年及年輕成人,為獲得最佳保護,該州建議11、12歲之青少年接種MenACWY 疫苗,並於16歲時追加1劑。美國(CDC)表示,自2021年以來病例急劇增加,2024年通報503例病例。
9wU_xa_LRU9ctXgUAHFAAA.en: The city of Chicago, Illinois, reported 7 confirmed adult cases between 15 and 30 January, including 2 deaths; 3 cases were serogroup Y. Serogroup Y has been the main circulating strain in the city since 2022, and authorities have started contact tracing and prevention measures. The city typically has 10–15 confirmed cases a year, mostly concentrated in winter, and cases are common among older adults, adolescents and young adults. For optimal protection, the state recommends MenACWY vaccination for adolescents at ages 11 and 12, with a booster dose at age 16. The US CDC says cases have risen sharply since 2021, with 503 cases reported in 2024.

OgGslcWPCqvWEfx9ZxfYWw.zh: 疫情更新:  全球陽性率於今年第1週(12/29-1/4)略降至3.37%,惟西太平洋及非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 中國疫情處低點,第3週(1/12-18)門急診陽性率略降至0.9%。 香港疫情略升,第3週陽性率上升至0.18%,已連續3週上升,惟整體仍處低點,汙水監測之變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 智利疫情於高點波動,疫情自2025年7月起持續攀升,今年第1週陽性率12.44%,為美洲最高,變異株占比以XFG為多。 美國疫情持續上升,今年第2週(1/4-10)陽性率增至5.2%,近期變異株占比以XFG為主。  評估與建議 全球陽性率近期略降,惟西太平洋及非洲區署陽性率增加;近期全球流行變異株占比以XFG最高(83.33%)。鑒於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。WHO 12/2、WHO 1/25
OgGslcWPCqvWEfx9ZxfYWw.en: Situation update: global test positivity dipped slightly to 3.37% in week 1 of this year (29 December–4 January), but rose notably in the Western Pacific and African Regions. China's situation is at a low point; outpatient and emergency test positivity fell slightly to 0.9% in week 3 (12–18 January). Hong Kong's situation rose slightly: test positivity increased to 0.18% in week 3 and has risen for three consecutive weeks, though overall it remains low; the largest share of variants in wastewater surveillance is NB.1.8.1. Chile's situation fluctuates at a high level; it has continued to rise since July 2025, and test positivity was 12.44% in week 1 this year, the highest in the Americas, with XFG the predominant variant. The United States' situation continues to rise: test positivity increased to 5.2% in week 2 (4–10 January), with XFG the main recent variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has dipped slightly recently, but has increased in the Western Pacific and African Regions. XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (83.33%). Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat (WHO, 2 December; WHO, 25 January).

LfXdZ8QQW602VUQNcLFpzA.zh: 印度南部坦米爾那都邦再次出現疫情,於清奈、琴阿爾帕圖、甘吉布勒姆、維盧布勒姆等地區之病例數上升,由於過去數年間當地病例數已下降,對於此次疫情上升,當局已加強監測、防治及宣導措施。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡報告首例本土病例,於2025年12月發病,致該國2025年累計2例本土病例,另1例發生於紐約州長島西部的納蘇郡。
LfXdZ8QQW602VUQNcLFpzA.en: Tamil Nadu state in southern India has seen a renewed outbreak, with case numbers rising in areas including Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kanchipuram and Villupuram. Because local case numbers had declined over recent years, authorities have strengthened surveillance, control and awareness measures in response to the rise. Miami-Dade County in Florida, United States, reported its first locally acquired case, with onset in December 2025, bringing the US total for 2025 to two locally acquired cases. The other case occurred in Nassau County, on western Long Island, New York state.

-HFSrFDRRXTBQUnodY6OTg.zh: 中國2025年12月累計報告約5.2萬例病例,其中3例死亡,通報數較10、11月(約5萬例)為高。中國疾控中心1/9 美國2024年累計報告約19萬例病例,其中近4,000例為先天性梅毒,先天性梅毒病例已連續第12年增加,並以密西西比州疫情最為嚴峻。Labroots 1/4、USCDC 9/24
-HFSrFDRRXTBQUnodY6OTg.en: China reported about 52,000 syphilis cases in December 2025, including 3 deaths. Reported numbers were higher than in October and November, which were about 50,000 each (China CDC, 9 January). In the United States, about 190,000 cases were reported in 2024, of which nearly 4,000 were congenital syphilis. Congenital syphilis cases have increased for the 12th consecutive year, with Mississippi the most severely affected (Labroots, 4 January; USCDC, 24 September).

Yyc_smC8dxHjftVFSx7adQ.zh: 美國南卡羅萊納州疫情嚴峻,1/16-20新增88例病例,此波疫情已累積646例,其中,87%病例未接種疫苗,目前有538例採居家隔離、33例採醫院隔離治療。當局已公告感染者曾造訪的地點(含17所學校),並呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗,落實相關防疫措施。
Yyc_smC8dxHjftVFSx7adQ.en: The outbreak in South Carolina is severe. Between 16 and 20 January, 88 new cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total for this wave to 646. 87% of cases were unvaccinated. Currently, 538 cases are under home isolation and 33 are being treated in hospital isolation. Authorities have published the locations visited by infected people, including 17 schools, and urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible and implement related prevention measures.

eu7ww-ye481FvTwsUHqNsQ.zh: 墨西哥疫情持續,今(2026)年第1-2週新增報告506例確定病例,其中逾5成病例來自中西部哈利斯科州,該國去年共計31州報告6,427例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(70%)為多,PAHO預定於4/13邀集美國及墨西哥召開線上會議審查其麻疹消除情形。 哈薩克今年截至1/16累計報告370例確定病例,其中298例為14歲以下兒童,85%之感染兒童未接種疫苗,病例主要分布於東南部江布爾州(191例),該國去年報告4,240例病例,另推估2024年報告達2.4-2.8萬例,當局表示目標年齡層兒童的疫苗涵蓋率低,且拒絕接種的人數增加,致疫情持續。 美國今年共9州累計報告171例確定病例,其中2例住院,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告145例確定病例為多,該州已匡列409名接觸者並預定監測至2/9,該國95%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。該國近年疫苗接種率持續落後,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/猶他州。
eu7ww-ye481FvTwsUHqNsQ.en: Measles continues in Mexico: in weeks 1–2 of 2026, 506 new confirmed cases were reported, more than half from Jalisco state in the central-west. Last year, the country reported 6,427 confirmed cases across 31 states, including 24 deaths; cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (70%). The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) plans an online meeting with the United States and Mexico on 13 April to review their measles elimination status. Kazakhstan has reported 370 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 16 January this year, of which 298 were children under 14, and 85% of infected children were unvaccinated. Cases are concentrated in Zhambyl region in the southeast (191 cases). The country reported 4,240 cases last year, and estimates indicate 24,000–28,000 cases in 2024. Authorities say vaccination coverage among target-age children is low and refusals have increased, which has sustained the outbreak. The United States has reported 171 confirmed cases this year across 9 states, 2 of them hospitalised. Most cases are in South Carolina (145 confirmed). The state has identified 409 contacts and plans monitoring until 9 February. 95% of patients in the country were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and Utah.

rgEoN1mnvc0qw6SPioZtlQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第52週(12/22-28)全球陽性率略增至3.51%,其中美洲、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加明顯。 中國疫情於低點波動,第2週(1/5-11)門急診陽性率略降至1.1%,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 香港疫情上升,第2週陽性率上升至0.11%,已連續兩週上升,惟整體仍處低點,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 美國疫情持續上升,第1週(12/28-1/3)陽性率增至5%,近期變異株占比以XFG占多數(61%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升,其中美洲、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加;近期全球流行變異株占比以XFG最高(75%),其次為NB.1.8.1(9.26%),新公告的BA.3.2占比為2.78%。鑒於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
rgEoN1mnvc0qw6SPioZtlQ.en: Situation update: global test positivity rose slightly to 3.51% in week 52 of 2025 (22–28 December), with notable increases in the Americas, African and European Regions. China's situation fluctuates at a low level; outpatient and emergency test positivity dipped slightly to 1.1% in week 2 (5–11 January), and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant in wastewater surveillance. Hong Kong's situation is rising: test positivity increased to 0.11% in week 2 and has risen for two consecutive weeks, though it remains low overall; NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant in wastewater surveillance. The United States' situation continues to rise: test positivity increased to 5% in week 1 (28 December–3 January), with XFG the majority of recent variants (61%). Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently risen, with increases in the Americas, African and European Regions. XFG is currently the most common variant globally (75%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (9.26%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for 2.78%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

_ovMBMThAVStW5-i0B8FGA.zh: 美國1/14報告45例病例,其中12例住院,病患分布於威斯康辛州等21個州,發病日介於2025年8/22至12/30;當局調查疑感染源為某牌營養補充粉,該公司已於1/14召回產品。
_ovMBMThAVStW5-i0B8FGA.en: The United States reported 45 cases on 14 January, 12 of them hospitalised, across 21 states including Wisconsin, with onset dates between 22 August and 30 December 2025. Authorities investigating suspect the source is a nutritional supplement powder from one brand, and the company recalled the product on 14 January.

gXMhuvKkYU_AkwxjzcJpIA.zh: 美國1/8新增1起郵輪群聚事件,郵輪上包括2,593名乘客及1,005名船員,於2025年12/28至今年1/9航行期間,累計報告94例病例(含85名乘客及9名船員)。此郵輪自英國南安普敦郵輪碼頭出發,預計於4/3返回,郵輪業者已隔離患者、保留糞便檢體並持續加強清消。
gXMhuvKkYU_AkwxjzcJpIA.en: On 8 January, the United States recorded one new cruise ship cluster. The ship, carrying 2,593 passengers and 1,005 crew, reported 94 cumulative cases (85 passengers and 9 crew) during its voyage from 28 December 2025 to 9 January 2026. The ship departed from the Southampton cruise terminal in the United Kingdom and is expected to return on 3 April. The cruise operator has isolated patients, retained stool samples and continued to strengthen disinfection.

FXJo3Z34RsjzxtXssuawcw.zh: 印東爪哇省帕梅卡桑縣去(2025)年累計報告1,248例疑病例,其中,209例經實驗室確診,12人死亡,確診/死亡病例主要為1-4歲兒童,約78%確診病患未曾接種疫苗,由於疫情持續迅速傳播,該縣宣布其18個村莊疫情為重大公共衛生事件,並啟動家戶主動訪視之疫苗接種作業。該國去年截至8月累計報告逾2.3萬疑病例(3,444例確診),相較2023-24年之10,628例及3,520例為高。 美國南卡羅來納州於今年1/7-9新增99例確定病例,病患主要集中於斯帕坦堡( Spartanburg),累計病例數達310例,當局已匡列200名接觸者並發布警報,建議醫療機構提高警覺及落實個人防護措施。該國去年共44州累計報告2,144例確定病例,其中240例住院、3例死亡,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。該國近年疫苗接種率持續落後,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/北卡羅來納州。 智利報告1例境外移入確定病例,為居住於聖地牙哥首都大區43歲女性,當局調查可能感染地點為2025/12/15-19於西班牙馬德里舉行之國際會議,病患於31日搭乘智利南美航空(LATAM Chile, LA 8118)自烏拉圭蒙特維多機場返回智利,當局已啟動接觸者聯繫及安排其疫苗接種作業並加強疫情監測。
FXJo3Z34RsjzxtXssuawcw.en: In Pamekasan Regency, East Java province, Indonesia, 1,248 suspected cases were reported cumulatively last year (2025), of which 209 were laboratory-confirmed and 12 people died. Confirmed and fatal cases were mainly children aged 1–4, and about 78% of confirmed patients were unvaccinated. As the outbreak continued to spread rapidly, the regency declared the outbreak in its 18 villages a major public health incident and launched household vaccination outreach. Indonesia reported more than 23,000 suspected cases through August last year (3,444 confirmed), higher than the 10,628 suspected and 3,520 confirmed cases in 2023–24. In the United States, South Carolina added 99 confirmed cases on 7–9 January this year, mainly in Spartanburg, bringing the cumulative total to 310. Authorities have identified 200 contacts, issued an alert, and recommended that healthcare facilities remain vigilant and implement personal protective measures. Last year, the United States reported 2,144 confirmed cases across 44 states, including 240 hospitalisations and 3 deaths; 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and North Carolina. Chile reported one imported confirmed case, a 43-year-old woman residing in the Santiago Metropolitan Region. Authorities investigated that she may have been infected at an international conference held in Madrid, Spain, from 15 to 19 December 2025. The patient returned to Chile on LATAM Chile flight LA 8118 from Montevideo airport in Uruguay on the 31st. Authorities have activated contact tracing, arranged vaccination, and strengthened surveillance.

9iHZ_Y_3Knt-QlxVeS2k7w.zh: 美國疫情持續,第53週(2025/12/28-2026/1/3)新增8例兒童死亡病例,本季累計17例,第53週類流感門診就診率為7.2%,高於全國基準 (3.1%),陽性率為24.7%,病患人數及住院/死亡率皆上升。本流感季截至1/9,逾1,500萬例感染、18萬人住院治療及7,400人死亡,共44個地區為高度或極高度流行,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),其中9成為K分支。當局列為中度嚴重流感季,推估流感活動度將持續數週,另疫苗經證實可降低重症風險,建議民眾應接種本季疫苗,且高風險者應儘早使用抗病毒藥物治療。
9iHZ_Y_3Knt-QlxVeS2k7w.en: The US influenza season continues. In week 53 (28 December 2025–3 January 2026), 8 new paediatric deaths were reported, bringing the season total to 17. The outpatient influenza-like illness rate in week 53 was 7.2%, above the national baseline (3.1%), and test positivity was 24.7%. Patient numbers and hospitalisation and death rates have all risen. As of 9 January, this flu season has seen more than 15 million infections, 180,000 hospitalisations and 7,400 deaths. A total of 44 areas are at high or very high activity levels. The main circulating type is A(H3N2), 90% of which belongs to subclade K. Authorities have classified this as a moderately severe flu season and estimate that influenza activity will continue for several weeks. Vaccines have been shown to reduce the risk of severe disease, and people are advised to get this season's vaccine. High-risk people should start antiviral treatment as early as possible.

YaNhD8o6YH6u5wCkF7YPaA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第51週(12/15-21)全球陽性率下降至3.23%,西太平洋、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加。 香港疫情於低點波動,2025年第53週(12/28-1/3)陽性率上升至0.05%,汙水監測變異株占比以NB.1.8.1最高。 德國疫情下降,2025年第51-52週陽性率為13%,近期變異株轉為BA.3.2占多數(38%)。 美國疫情自2025年11月起持續上升,第52週陽性率增至3.9%,近期變異株以XFG占多數(61%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,西太平洋、非洲及歐洲區署陽性率增加;近期全球流行變異株占比以XFG最高,其次為NB.1.8.1,新公告的BA.3.2占比為3.7%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
YaNhD8o6YH6u5wCkF7YPaA.en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 3.23% in week 51 of 2025 (15–21 December), with increases in the Western Pacific, African and European Regions. Hong Kong's situation fluctuates at a low level; test positivity rose to 0.05% in week 53 of 2025 (28 December–3 January), and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant in wastewater surveillance. Germany's situation has declined; test positivity was 13% in weeks 51–52 of 2025, and the recent predominant variant is now BA.3.2 (38%). The United States' situation has continued to rise since November 2025; test positivity rose to 3.9% in week 52, with XFG the majority of recent variants (61%). Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently trended down, while positivity has increased in the Western Pacific, African and European Regions. XFG is currently the most common variant globally, followed by NB.1.8.1, and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for 3.7%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

fJn5T1hLKpcjCoMmoCPjhg.zh: 美國疫情上升,共48個地區為高度流行,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),其中9成為K分支,第52週類流感門診就診率為8.2%,高於全國基準 (3.1%),陽性率由第50週14.8上升至32.9%,病患人數及住院/死亡率皆上升。本流感季截至1/5,逾1,100萬人感染、12萬人住院治療及5,000 人死亡,其中,兒童死亡病例達9例,當局列為中度嚴重流感季,推估流感活動度將持續數週,建議民眾應接種本季流感疫苗,另高風險者應儘早使用抗病毒藥物治療。
fJn5T1hLKpcjCoMmoCPjhg.en: The US situation is rising, with 48 areas at high activity levels. The main circulating type is A(H3N2), 90% of which is subclade K. In week 52, the outpatient influenza-like illness rate was 8.2%, above the national baseline (3.1%). Test positivity rose from 14.8% in week 50 to 32.9%. Patient numbers and hospitalisation and death rates have all risen. As of 5 January, this flu season has seen more than 11 million infections, 120,000 hospitalisations and 5,000 deaths, including 9 child deaths. Authorities have classified it as a moderately severe flu season and estimate that influenza activity will continue for several weeks. People are advised to get this season's flu vaccine, and high-risk people should start antiviral treatment as early as possible.

1ZonIlpAw7ucUOrR85HNjg.zh: 美國2025年截至12/30共44州報告49起疫情及2,065例確定病例,其中235例住院、3例死亡,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以德州(803例)、南卡羅來納州(181例) 、亞利桑那州(196例)為多,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/亞利桑那/猶他州;另紐澤西州紐華克自由國際機場、麻州洛根機場及科羅拉多州丹佛國際機場曾有感染麻疹旅客出入,當局提醒民眾可能有傳播風險。該國2025年病例數為近30年最高,2024年報告285例病例。 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州及南澳州發布警示,報告1名自東南亞返國之旅客於具傳染力期間,曾到訪雪梨及阿得雷德部分地區,可能有傳播風險,當局提醒在指定時間出現在暴露地點者,應留意自身健康狀況,並於出現疑症狀時,儘速就醫。該國於2025年累計報告179例,為2024年病例數3倍,病例數多與旅行相關。
1ZonIlpAw7ucUOrR85HNjg.en: As of 30 December 2025, 44 US states had reported 49 outbreaks and 2,065 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 235 were hospitalised and 3 died. 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases were most numerous in Texas (803), Arizona (196) and South Carolina (181). Recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina, Arizona and Utah. Infected travellers also passed through Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey, Boston Logan Airport in Massachusetts and Denver International Airport in Colorado, and authorities warn of possible transmission risk. The US case count for 2025 is the highest in nearly 30 years; 285 cases were reported in 2024. New South Wales and South Australia issued alerts after a traveller returning from Southeast Asia visited parts of Sydney and Adelaide during the infectious period, posing a possible transmission risk. Authorities advise people who were at the exposure locations at the specified times to monitor their health and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear. Australia reported 179 cases in 2025, three times the 2024 number, mostly linked to travel.

vR8PuOpxkXFfQvYw7e-vZA.zh: 美國2025年截至12/13累計報告37例病例,高於近兩年同期,且為10年來最高,病患居住地以佛羅里達州為多;當局評估疫情升溫與疫苗涵蓋率下降有關,淹水及野火等氣候變遷相關災害,亦造成傷口與土壤接觸之風險增加。
vR8PuOpxkXFfQvYw7e-vZA.en: The US reported 37 cumulative cases in 2025 up to 13 December, more than the same period in the past two years and the highest in 10 years. Most patients live in Florida. Authorities assess that the rise is linked to declining vaccination coverage. Climate-related disasters such as flooding and wildfires have also increased the risk of wounds coming into contact with soil.

xQYPhyhcf-Ie3rMG54fsig.zh: 美國今年共46州累計報告2,039例病例,高於去年同期(約1,800例),其中,1,404例為神經侵襲性病例。病例數以科羅拉多州為多,該州累計報告285例病例,較去年同期上升275%,17例死亡數亦居全國最多,病例主要分布於該州賴瑞默爾、圓石、韋爾德及亞當斯等郡。
xQYPhyhcf-Ie3rMG54fsig.en: This year, 2,039 cases have been reported cumulatively across 46 US states, higher than the same period last year (about 1,800), of which 1,404 were neuroinvasive. Most cases are in Colorado, which has reported 285 cumulative cases, up 275% on the same period last year. Colorado also recorded the most deaths nationally, with 17. Cases are mainly in Larimer, Boulder, Weld and Adams counties.

KI-YXd8DFjRUiBRidgS8rg.zh: 美國12/23報告64例病例,其中20例住院,無死亡案例,病患分布於22個州;當局表示本起疫情病患住院率高,經調查牡蠣為疑感染源,建議民眾勿生食。
KI-YXd8DFjRUiBRidgS8rg.en: The US reported 64 cases on 23 December, 20 of them hospitalised, with no deaths; cases are spread across 22 states. Authorities say the hospitalisation rate for this outbreak is high. Investigation identified oysters as the suspected source, and people are advised not to eat them raw.

4gfVFYDlnJmO-h5nmrZDNA.zh: 美國2025-26流感季開始,共17個地區為高度流行,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),其中9成為K分支,第50週類流感門診就診率為4.1%,高於全國基準 (3.1%),陽性率由第49週8.1%上升至14.8%,病患人數及住院/死亡率皆上升。另本流感季累計報告3例流感相關兒童死亡病例;當局估計本流感季截至12/19,逾460萬人感染、4.9 萬人住院治療及1,900 人死亡,建議民眾應接種本季流感疫苗,另高風險者應儘早使用抗病毒藥物治療。
4gfVFYDlnJmO-h5nmrZDNA.en: The US 2025–26 flu season has begun, with 17 areas at high activity levels, mainly A(H3N2), 90% of which are subclade K. The outpatient influenza-like illness rate in week 50 was 4.1%, above the national baseline (3.1%). Test positivity rose from 8.1% in week 49 to 14.8%. Patient numbers, hospitalisation and death rates have all risen. This season so far, 3 paediatric influenza-associated deaths have been reported. Authorities estimate that as of 19 December, more than 4.6 million people have been infected this flu season, 49,000 have been hospitalised and 1,900 have died. People are advised to get this season's flu vaccine, and high-risk people should start antiviral treatment as early as possible.

GV8fKrQDST4l4ixfM0ICJQ.zh: 美國疫情更新,截至12/10累計報告51例嬰兒病例,年齡介於16-264天,病例皆已住院治療,無死亡案例,分布於加州等19個州,病患皆攝食某廠商之全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,經調查疫情最早開始於2023年12月,當局已對產品下架不徹底之零售商發出警告。
GV8fKrQDST4l4ixfM0ICJQ.en: US update: as of 10 December, 51 infant cases had been reported cumulatively, aged 16–264 days. All cases were hospitalised, with no deaths, and they were spread across 19 states including California. All patients had consumed a complete-nutrition infant formula from one manufacturer. The investigation found the earliest onset was in December 2023. Authorities have warned retailers that did not fully withdraw the product.

BYfkL5-urx_T93LdOjPeHA.zh: 美國今年截至12/9共43州報告47起疫情及1,912例確定病例,其中218例住院、3例死亡,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他/亞利桑那/南卡羅來納州,疫情主要爆發於疫苗接種率低之學校及社區教堂等場所。
BYfkL5-urx_T93LdOjPeHA.en: As of 9 December this year, 43 US states had reported 47 outbreaks and 1,912 confirmed cases, of which 218 were hospitalised and 3 died. 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Recent activity is concentrated in Utah, Arizona and South Carolina. Outbreaks have mainly occurred in schools and community churches with low vaccination coverage.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

G1khzBYF4bm1a_8-f9soOw.zh: 美國於12/5報告因器官移植致感染之死亡案例,愛達荷州之男性器官捐贈者於去年10月被臭鼬抓傷,致染病死亡並器捐,受贈腎臟移植者於術後5週出現疑症狀,並於移植後51日死亡。捐贈者於移植前檢測血清為陰性,後於其右腎臟樣本檢出病毒變異株;另有3名接受該捐贈者之角膜移植者,因角膜檢出陽性,除已完成暴露後預防(PEP)並接受移植角膜切除手術,迄無症狀。當局匡列370名接觸者,其中357人完成風險評估,共46人建議接受PEP。此為該國自1978年以來第4次器官移植傳播事件,共計13名受贈者,其中7例死亡,6例接受PEP者仍存活。另該國歷年死亡數皆10例。
G1khzBYF4bm1a_8-f9soOw.en: On 5 December, the US reported a death from infection transmitted through organ transplantation. A male organ donor in Idaho had been scratched by a skunk last October, died of the infection, and donated his organs. A kidney recipient developed suspected symptoms 5 weeks after surgery and died 51 days after transplantation. The donor's serum tested negative before transplantation, but a rabies virus variant was detected in a sample of his right kidney. Three corneal transplant recipients who received tissue from the same donor had positive corneal tests; they have completed post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) and corneal graft removal surgery, and remain asymptomatic. Authorities identified 370 contacts, of whom 357 completed risk assessment, and 46 were recommended to receive PEP. This is the fourth organ-transplant transmission event in the country since 1978, involving 13 recipients in total, 7 of whom died; the 6 recipients who received PEP remain alive. The country reports 10 deaths each year.

a-2PYed-VmIBsAopSarAqw.zh: 美國佛羅里達州於12/3報告14例病例,患者皆曾至橘郡(Orange)之某健身房,當局檢視其水療中心有違規事項,另已針對環境檢體進行採樣調查;該州今年迄今累計報告665例,為近10年最高,其中以橘郡(Orange)82例為多。
a-2PYed-VmIBsAopSarAqw.en: Florida reported 14 cases on 3 December. All patients had visited a gym in Orange County. Authorities found violations at the gym's spa centre and have collected environmental samples for investigation. This year to date, the state has reported 665 cumulative cases, the highest in 10 years, with Orange County accounting for 82 of them.

I7lgLIhArwtC_eWrU2ch1Q.zh: 印度疫情更新,今年10月報告22,659例病例,較9月18,803例病例增加21%。今年截至10/31已累計91,015例病例,低於去年同期184,712例病例,去年全年共報告232,425例。 寮國疫情更新,今年1-11月累計11,629例病例及1例死亡,主要分布於永珍5,520例病例及1例死亡,該國去年報告逾20,000例病例及11例死亡。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡近1週新增2例本土病例,該州今年迄今累計60例本土病例,主要分布於布里瓦德郡、希爾斯波羅郡、邁阿密-戴德郡及帕斯科郡,主要檢出型別為DENV-3;該州去年報告91例病例,2023年報告186例病例。
I7lgLIhArwtC_eWrU2ch1Q.en: India update: 22,659 cases were reported in October this year, a 21% increase over 18,803 cases in September. Cumulatively this year to 31 October, 91,015 cases have been reported, lower than the 184,712 cases in the same period last year; 232,425 cases were reported in the whole of last year. Laos update: 11,629 cases and 1 death were reported cumulatively in January–November this year, mainly in Vientiane Capital, with 5,520 cases and 1 death. The country reported more than 20,000 cases and 11 deaths last year. In Miami-Dade County, Florida, 2 new local cases were reported in the past week. The state has recorded 60 locally acquired cases so far this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, with DENV-3 the main serotype detected. The state reported 91 cases last year and 186 cases in 2023.

Nq3p5ltNvbFGgH5hofsPvQ.zh: 美國1998-2022年長期研究顯示,有20%疫情與雞肉有關,造成10,344例病例,其中住院1,426例、死亡12例,疫情有30%發生於餐廳、25%發生於家中,生食雞肉風險為熟食5倍;研究建議:為雞隻(尤其繁殖母雞)接種疫苗、加強衛生屠宰製程、進行餐飲業及民眾衛教可降低感染風險。
Nq3p5ltNvbFGgH5hofsPvQ.en: A long-term study of the United States covering 1998–2022 found that 20% of outbreaks were linked to chicken, causing 10,344 cases, including 1,426 hospitalizations and 12 deaths. Thirty percent of outbreaks occurred in restaurants and 25% in homes, and the risk of eating raw chicken was five times that of eating cooked chicken. The study recommends vaccinating chickens (especially breeding hens), strengthening hygiene in slaughter processes, and providing food-service and public health education to reduce infection risk.

bALLB5fVHh4tDXClH1v27Q.zh: 美國今年截至11/26報告逾2.5萬例病例,另2024年同期通報病例超過33,000例,近兩年病例數皆高於往年,其中德克薩斯/肯塔基州病例數為該州近10年最高,並有2-3例嬰兒死亡病例,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗。
bALLB5fVHh4tDXClH1v27Q.en: The United States has reported more than 25,000 cases this year as of 26 November. The same period in 2024 saw more than 33,000 reported cases, and case numbers in both of the past two years were higher than in earlier years. Texas and Kentucky each recorded their highest case counts in the past 10 years, and 2–3 infant deaths have been reported. Authorities urge the public to get vaccinated.

Jck0sanvCqCNsPyfily28w.zh: 美國今年截至11/29共43州報告1,798例,其中212例住院、3例死亡,並報告46起疫情,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他/亞利桑那/南卡羅來納州。 波蘭東南部喀爾巴阡山脈地區共計4縣市今年截至11/30累計報告18例病例,其中8例住院治療,該國第1及2劑疫苗接種率低於WHO建議之95%,當地社區持續傳播,與鄰國有跨境傳播及發生大規模疫情風險,當局已啟動疫情調查及接觸者監測作業。 非洲疫情更新,剛果民主共和國今年截至8/30報告逾5萬例確定病例,其中794例死亡,無國界醫生組織(MSF)於北基伍省4-11月共計2區報告3,051例病例,其中1,111例出現併發重症,MSF持續進行大規模疫苗接種作業,惟武裝衝突致疫情控制困難;烏干達東北部納帕克區11/19爆發疫情,截至11/28累計報告74例病例,其中11例兒童死亡。
Jck0sanvCqCNsPyfily28w.en: United States: As of 29 November this year, 1,798 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 212 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 46 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated in Utah, Arizona and South Carolina. Poland: In the Carpathian Mountains region of south-eastern Poland, four counties reported a cumulative 18 cases as of 30 November this year, 8 of whom were hospitalized. Poland's first and second dose vaccination coverage is below the 95% recommended by WHO, and local community transmission is ongoing. There is a risk of cross-border spread to neighbouring countries and of large-scale outbreaks, and authorities have launched outbreak investigations and contact monitoring. Africa: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases this year as of 30 August, including 794 deaths. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) reported 3,051 cases in two health zones of North Kivu province from April to November, of which 1,111 developed severe complications. MSF continues large-scale vaccination, but armed conflict makes outbreak control difficult. In north-eastern Uganda, an outbreak began in Napak district on 19 November; as of 28 November, 74 cases had been reported, including 11 child deaths.

K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/28累計142國/地區報告17萬2千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%)。 今年截至第48週累計99國/地區報告5萬1千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬3千餘例、美洲區4,442例、歐洲區2,429例、西太平洋區1,479例、東南亞區154例及東地中海區46例。非洲、歐洲、西太平洋及中東區疫情下降;惟美洲及東南亞區病例數上升。  其他更新: 馬利西部庫利科羅11/24報告首例死亡病例,其餘資訊不明,當局已加強邊境監測並隔離疑病例。 評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 28 November this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 172,000 confirmed cases globally, of which at least 467 died (CFR 0.27%). Year to date as of week 48, 99 countries and areas have reported more than 51,000 confirmed cases: more than 43,000 in the African Region, 4,442 in the Region of the Americas, 2,429 in the European Region, 1,479 in the Western Pacific Region, 154 in the South-East Asia Region and 46 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in the African, European, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, but risen in the Americas and South-East Asia. Other updates: In Koulikoro, western Mali, the first death was reported on 24 November; other information is unknown. Authorities have strengthened border surveillance and isolated suspected cases. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travelers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

MRdvNbYbj1VBqukXOkxF5Q.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週墨西哥新增1例H5N2流感人類感染病例;美國新增1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共25國於2025/11/20-28期間新增654起H5N1 疫情,德國179起、法國140起、英國110起、荷蘭50起、比利時36起、義大利35起、加拿大19起、美國17起、捷克/芬蘭各9起、奧地利/西班牙各8起、波蘭7起、拉脫維亞6起、丹麥/瑞典各4 起、斯洛伐克/斯洛維亞/瑞士/葡萄牙各2起、保加利亞/匈牙利/南韓/愛爾蘭/立陶宛各1起。 挪威2025/11/24新增1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,082 (1)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第46週計383個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(紐澤西州)共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  墨西哥新增1例H5N2流感人類感染病例,病患為墨西哥城23歲女性,近期無旅遊史,9/14開始出現咳嗽、發燒、吞嚥疼痛、胸痛及咳血等症狀,30日經實驗室檢測為H5型,近期經PAHO實驗室確診為H5N2,病患接受奧司他韋(oseltamivir)治療並於10/11出院,當局表示居住環境有鳥類及家禽,且經檢測出H5型;本案為該國及全球第2例H5N2病例,首例為2024年墨西哥州之死亡病例。另該國今年4月曾通報1例H5N1死亡病例,PAHO表示H5 型禽流感散發病例多與直接接觸受感染動物或受污染環境有關,迄無人傳人情形,建議持續加強動物及人類之跨部門監測。 美國佛蒙特州新增1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例,為年齡18歲個案,於第40週(9/28-10/4)發病,經住院後已康復,迄未確認是否曾接觸豬或其他動物,目前尚無人傳人跡象,亦未具人際間傳播能力;當局表示該案為該國今年第2例H1N2v病例,另自2019年迄今累計報告18例H1N2v病例。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計67國家/地區通報4,857起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
MRdvNbYbj1VBqukXOkxF5Q.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week Mexico reported one new human H5N2 influenza infection, and the United States reported one new human H1N2v influenza infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 25 countries reported a total of 654 new H5N1 outbreaks between 20 and 28 November 2025: Germany 179, France 140, United Kingdom 110, Netherlands 50, Belgium 36, Italy 35, Canada 19, United States 17, Czechia and Finland 9 each, Austria and Spain 8 each, Poland 7, Latvia 6, Denmark and Sweden 4 each, Slovakia, Slovenia, Switzerland and Portugal 2 each, and Bulgaria, Hungary, South Korea, Ireland and Lithuania 1 each. Norway reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 24 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 (1) outbreaks have been reported in cattle herds across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 46, 383 sampling sites provided test reports, and one state (New Jersey) had one sampling site detect H5-positive results. Other updates: Mexico reported one new human H5N2 infection, in a 23-year-old woman in Mexico City with no recent travel history. She developed cough, fever, sore throat, chest pain and coughing up blood from 14 September; on the 30th, laboratory testing identified H5 type, and PAHO later confirmed H5N2. She was treated with oseltamivir and discharged on 11 October. Authorities said her residence had birds and poultry, and H5 was detected. This is the second H5N2 human case in the country and globally; the first was a fatal case in Mexico State in 2024. The country also reported one fatal H5N1 case in April this year. PAHO said sporadic human H5 avian influenza cases are mostly associated with direct contact with infected animals or contaminated environments, with no human-to-human transmission to date, and recommended continued cross-sectoral surveillance of animals and humans. The US state of Vermont reported one new human H1N2v infection in an 18-year-old case who fell ill in week 40 (28 September–4 October). The patient was hospitalized and has recovered. It has not been confirmed whether the patient had contact with pigs or other animals; there are no signs of human-to-human transmission, and the virus does not have sustained human-to-human transmission capacity. Authorities said this is the country's second H1N2v case this year, and 18 H1N2v cases have been reported cumulatively since 2019. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 30 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 1 H5N2 influenza (2 cumulative); 1 H5N5 influenza (1 cumulative); 32 H9N2 influenza (162 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 67 countries and areas have reported 4,857 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection, and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

7jdhd52ocTFHJfR7AmTFww.zh: 美國疫情更新,截至11/20累計報告31例嬰兒病例,分布於加州等15個州,病患皆攝食某廠商之全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,抽測奶粉樣本亦檢測出陽性,並經調查,民眾最早於2024年11月食用該產品;當局正回溯調查自8月起通報之107例病例是否與該產品相關,生產商表示所有產品可能都遭受汙染,產品皆已下架。
7jdhd52ocTFHJfR7AmTFww.en: US update: As of 20 November, a cumulative 31 infant cases had been reported across 15 states, including California. All patients consumed a whole-nutrition infant formula from one manufacturer, and samples of that formula also tested positive. Investigation found that consumers may have been using the product as early as November 2024. Authorities are retrospectively investigating whether 107 cases reported since August are linked to this product. The manufacturer said all products may have been contaminated, and all products have been removed from shelves.
