Z6_RT5Q7ff7aSilcCaKDtA.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 influenza infection, and the United States reported one new fatal human H5N5 influenza infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported six new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 14 and 21 November 2025: Belgium 3, China 2, Portugal 1. Twenty-one countries reported 214 new H5N1 outbreaks between 14 and 21 November 2025: United Kingdom 60, Germany 35, Spain 22, Belgium 17, Nigeria 13, United States 9, Canada 8, Denmark and Finland 7 each, South Africa and France 5 each, Austria, Ireland, Latvia and Netherlands 4 each, Czechia, Switzerland, Luxembourg and Lithuania 2 each, and Norway and Portugal 1 each. The United Kingdom reported one new H5N5 outbreak on 21 November 2025. South Korea reported one new H5N9 outbreak on 19 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 46, 383 sampling sites provided test reports, and one state (New Jersey) had one sampling site detect H5-positive results. Other updates: In Grays Harbor County, Washington, a human H5N5 influenza infection was reported in November this year, and the patient died on 21 November. The patient was an elderly resident with chronic illness who kept multiple poultry at home and had been in contact with wild birds. Investigation indicates the infection most likely came from contact with the infected domestic poultry, bird droppings or a contaminated environment. The patient had high fever and breathing difficulties before admission, and after the rare H5N5 virus was confirmed, died from complications. This is the first confirmed human H5N5 infection globally to result in death. All close contacts have been traced and tested, and none tested positive; there is no evidence of human-to-human transmission, and the overall health risk to the general public remains low. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 30 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 1 H5N5 influenza (1 cumulative); 32 H9N2 influenza (162 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 67 countries and areas have reported 4,299 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection, and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

cOGuzF_AA0-UqHx_cHGTLQ.zh: 美國今年截至11/12共43州報告1,723例,其中206例住院、3例死亡,並報告45起疫情,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他州-亞利桑那州交界處和南卡羅來納州北部地區;該國2024年累計報告285例病例。 越南東北部富壽省爆發學校群聚事件,共計報告29例疑病例,4件樣本中,有3例經實驗室確診,當局已實施民眾衛教、疫苗接種及消毒等緊急措施;該國今年1-4月全國63個省份累計報告逾81,000例疑病例,因新冠疫情及疫苗短缺,兒童常規疫苗接種率降至20年來最低點,導致2024-25年疫情尤其嚴峻,媒體報導全國病例數已趨緩,惟目前尚無更新數據資訊。
cOGuzF_AA0-UqHx_cHGTLQ.en: United States: As of 12 November this year, 1,723 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 206 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 45 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated at the Utah–Arizona border area and in northern South Carolina. The country reported 285 cases cumulatively in 2024. Viet Nam: A school cluster outbreak occurred in Phu Tho province in the north-east, with 29 suspected cases reported in total; of 4 specimens, 3 were confirmed by laboratory testing. Authorities have implemented emergency measures including public health education, vaccination and disinfection. From January to April this year, more than 81,000 suspected cases were reported cumulatively across all 63 provinces nationwide. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccine shortages, routine childhood vaccination rates fell to their lowest level in 20 years, which made the 2024–25 outbreaks especially severe. Media reports say national case numbers have slowed, but no updated data are currently available.

Qxh_68bpFe4hJlM9i-QKCg.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日新增912例病例及3例死亡,今年迄今累計80,634例病例及318例死亡,病例數以該國南部巴里薩爾專區18,765例為多,自7月以來每月報告病例數皆逾1萬例。 墨西哥疫情上升,近1週新增992例病例,今年截至10/27累計14,652例確診病例,以東部維拉克魯茲州2,257例為多,主要流行型別為DENV-3。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡近1週報告新增3例本土病例,該州今年迄今累計56例病例,主要分布於布里瓦德郡、希爾斯波羅郡、邁阿密-戴德郡及帕斯科郡,主要檢出型別為DENV-3。
Qxh_68bpFe4hJlM9i-QKCg.en: Bangladesh update: In the past day, 912 new cases and 3 deaths were reported. Year to date, 80,634 cases and 318 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the most cases, 18,765, in Barisal division in the south. Since July, more than 10,000 cases have been reported each month. Mexico: The outbreak is rising. In the past week, 992 new cases were reported. As of 27 October this year, 14,652 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, most in Veracruz state in the east (2,257 cases). The main serotype detected is DENV-3. United States: Miami-Dade County in Florida reported three new local cases in the past week. The state has reported 56 cases cumulatively this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, and the main serotype detected is DENV-3.

hqNk0-usZN81JiN7yNtpHQ.zh: 柬埔寨新增1例H5N1流感死亡病例,為居住於金邊市22歲男性個案,11/15因發燒、咳嗽、呼吸急促/困難等症狀死亡,為該市首例確診病例。迄未公佈流行病學及基因定序相關資訊,感染源仍在調查中。該國今年已累計確診18例感染病例,其中7例死亡。往年病例多集中於南部各省, 惟於今年,31%病例來自北部暹粒省。病例出現症狀前,多有近期疑或已知之患病/死亡鳥類接觸史,迄未發現人際傳播病例。 美國新增1例H5N5流感病例,為居住於華盛頓州雷斯港郡之老年人,患有慢性疾病,11月初因類流感症狀(高燒、意識混亂和呼吸困難)入院治療,迄仍住院中。家中飼養家禽,且家禽可能曾接觸過野生鳥類,推測家禽或野生鳥類很可能是病毒傳播來源,刻正釐清感染源。此為首例人類感染H5N5亞型病毒案例,之前僅在動物中發現。目前尚未報告人傳人病例,所有密切接觸者皆已接受症狀監測,推估對民眾風險較低。
hqNk0-usZN81JiN7yNtpHQ.en: Cambodia reported one new fatal H5N1 influenza case, a 22-year-old man living in Phnom Penh who died on 15 November after fever, cough and rapid or difficult breathing. This is the first confirmed case in the city. Epidemiological and genetic sequencing information has not yet been published, and the source of infection is still under investigation. Cambodia has cumulatively confirmed 18 infection cases this year, 7 of which were fatal. Cases in past years were mostly concentrated in southern provinces, but this year 31% of cases came from northern Siem Reap province. Before symptom onset, most cases had recent suspected or known contact with sick or dead birds, and no human-to-human transmission has been identified. The United States reported one new H5N5 influenza case, an elderly resident of Grays Harbor County, Washington, who has chronic illness and was admitted in early November with influenza-like symptoms (high fever, confusion and breathing difficulties); the patient remains hospitalized. The person kept poultry at home, and the poultry may have had contact with wild birds. Poultry or wild birds are most likely the source of transmission, and the source of infection is being clarified. This is the first human infection case with the H5N5 subtype, which had previously been found only in animals. No human-to-human transmission has been reported, and all close contacts are under symptom monitoring; the risk to the public is estimated to be low.

1CgBVeRg0dcHOmkNx0EqUA.zh: 美國中大西洋地區(mid-Atlantic)9月報告197例病例,東部海岸地區疫情亦上升,疫情多發生於學校及日托中心,病毒型別主要為EVA71型及克沙奇A16。惟因腸病毒非法定通報疾病,且該國公衛監測系統暫停運作,欠缺完整疫情監測資訊。
1CgBVeRg0dcHOmkNx0EqUA.en: The US mid-Atlantic region reported 197 cases in September, and outbreaks have also increased in East Coast areas. Outbreaks mainly occur in schools and daycare centres, and the main virus types are EV-A71 and coxsackievirus A16. However, enterovirus infection is not a notifiable disease, and the country's public health surveillance system has temporarily stopped operating, so complete outbreak surveillance information is lacking.

XD8EPX4TaxDW-IL8RfvMww.zh: 美國疫情更新,截至11/11累計報告15例病例,病患皆為嬰兒,分布於加州等12個州,症狀包含臉部表情少、吞嚥餵食困難及頭部不穩定等;經調查病患皆曾於8-11月期間攝食某公司生產的全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,當局正回溯調查自8月起通報之84例病例是否與該產品相關,並要求生產商下架所有批次產品
XD8EPX4TaxDW-IL8RfvMww.en: US update: As of 11 November, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively. All patients are infants, distributed across 12 states including California. Symptoms include reduced facial expression, difficulty swallowing and feeding, and head instability. Investigation found that all patients had consumed whole-nutrition infant formula produced by one company during August–November. Authorities are retrospectively investigating whether 84 cases reported since August are related to this product, and have required the manufacturer to withdraw all batches of the product.

sJ71HzBEUnqZUMzMzgpq7Q.zh: 美國內華達州萊昂(Lyon)郡報告1例,為50歲男性,病患出現症狀前數週曾於打掃房屋時,吸入或接觸到囓齒動物之糞便、尿液及其築巢材料,相關調查持續進行中,本案為該州今年第3例病例。另該國自1993年全國監測後,迄2022年累計864例確診病例,94%病例發生在密西西比河以西。
sJ71HzBEUnqZUMzMzgpq7Q.en: Lyon County, Nevada, reported one case, a 50-year-old man who, several weeks before symptom onset, inhaled or came into contact with rodent feces, urine and nesting material while cleaning a house. The investigation is ongoing, and this is the state's third case this year. Since national surveillance began in 1993, a cumulative 864 confirmed cases had been reported in the United States through 2022, and 94% of cases occurred west of the Mississippi River.

dAEGylmMjxbtiPA8rEyibg.zh: 美國西維吉亞州今年截至11/6累計報告126例確定病例,主要分布於西部,其中28例須住院治療,病患年齡中位數為12歲,其中23例為12 個月以下嬰兒,當局已公布相關指引,另表示疫情每隔 3-5 年就會出現週期性高峰,流行病例已從嬰兒轉為青少年和成人,評估因其疫苗免疫力減弱所致。 南非今年截至10月累計報告483例確診病例,主要分布於豪登省和西開普省,其中50%為5歲以下兒童,25%為6個月齡以下嬰兒,當局已提醒醫生針對嬰兒及未接種疫苗者提高診斷警覺,並持續監測疫情。
dAEGylmMjxbtiPA8rEyibg.en: West Virginia, US: As of 6 November this year, 126 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the western part of the state, and 28 required hospitalization. The median patient age is 12 years, and 23 cases were infants under 12 months old. Authorities have published relevant guidance and state that outbreaks peak cyclically every three to five years. Epidemic cases have shifted from infants to adolescents and adults, which is assessed to be due to waning vaccine-induced immunity. South Africa: As of October this year, 483 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Gauteng and Western Cape provinces. Of these, 50% were children under 5 years old and 25% were infants under 6 months old. Authorities have reminded doctors to maintain heightened diagnostic vigilance for infants and unvaccinated people, and continue to monitor the outbreak.

ORWxwmlibT3Ddq6zKp3UsQ.zh: 美國11/8報告13例病例,病患皆為嬰兒,分布於加州等10個州;經調查病患皆於8-11月期間攝食某公司生產的全營養嬰兒配方奶粉,當局已下架兩批產品,奶粉樣本檢測中。
ORWxwmlibT3Ddq6zKp3UsQ.en: US update: On 8 November, the US reported 13 cases, all in infants, across 10 states including California. Investigation found that all patients had consumed whole-nutrition infant formula produced by one company during August–November. Authorities have removed two batches of the product from shelves, and formula samples are being tested.

rDuF3EpzermLsNG3jYhZwg.zh: 美國10/31報告11例病例,發病日介於5/12-9/4,病患分布於7個州,疑感染源為某食品商製造的辣木葉粉,當局已要求產品下架。 希臘2024年累積報告1,052例病例,較2023年(936例)為高,疫情多發生於夏季(908例)。
rDuF3EpzermLsNG3jYhZwg.en: US: On 31 October, 11 cases were reported, with onset dates between 12 May and 4 September; patients are distributed across seven states. The suspected source is moringa leaf powder manufactured by a food company, and authorities have requested that the product be removed from shelves. Greece reported 1,052 cumulative cases in 2024, higher than in 2023 (936 cases); most cases occurred in summer (908 cases).

nl5EQOnwQzBGVZgEUiAxcQ.zh: 美國猶他州/亞利桑那州疫情擴大,截至10月下旬累計報告123例確診病例,多集中於猶他州赫利戴爾(Hildale)及亞利桑那州科羅拉多市(Colorado),多數病患為未接種疫苗之學齡兒童,該地區疫苗覆蓋率不到95%,迄今至少8例住院,無死亡案例,此波疫情為該國今年第2大群聚事件。 以色列新增1例併發症之死亡病例,為未接種疫苗之2歲半幼兒,且為該國今年第8例死亡病例,另該國南部報告1例重症個案,為6歲半且未接種疫苗兒童,目前仍使用呼吸器治療中。該國今年累計報告1,778例,其中574例住院,目前當局於疫情地區推展疫苗接種活動,除將第2劑疫苗提前至1歲半接種外(原為6歲),並建議居住或前往疫情地區之6-11個月大嬰兒應額外接種疫苗。
nl5EQOnwQzBGVZgEUiAxcQ.en: United States: The outbreak in Utah and Arizona has expanded. As of late October, 123 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, mostly in Hildale, Utah, and Colorado City, Arizona. Most patients are unvaccinated school-age children, and vaccination coverage in the area is below 95%. At least 8 patients have been hospitalized and there have been no deaths. This outbreak is the country's second-largest cluster this year. Israel: One new death from complications was reported, in an unvaccinated two-and-a-half-year-old child, the country's eighth death this year. In addition, one severe case was reported in southern Israel, an unvaccinated six-and-a-half-year-old child who remains on a ventilator. Israel has reported 1,778 cases this year, including 574 hospitalizations. In the affected areas, authorities are carrying out vaccination activities: in addition to moving the second dose forward to 18 months of age (originally six years), they recommend that infants aged 6–11 months living in or travelling to affected areas receive an additional dose.

is0XbmAc3TKm2ZQm8UHZpQ.zh: 歐洲疾病預防與控制中心(ECDC)公布今年迄今累計14國,通報逾1,000例本土病例,其中,63例死亡,以義大利(714例)最多,其次為希臘。另德國於2019-24年間每年約4-35例本地病例,大部分來自該國東部地區,惟近期於南部巴伐利亞邦亦報告自2019年以來首例病例,當局提醒至當地參加啤酒節活動之旅客應注意防範蚊蟲叮咬措施。 美國洛杉磯郡報告今年首例死亡病例,個案為聖費爾南多谷地區之居民,因感染後引起神經系統疾病住院並死亡,該郡迄今共通報14例病例,50%感染者居住在聖費爾南多谷地區,當地蚊媒高峰期自6月持續到11月。
is0XbmAc3TKm2ZQm8UHZpQ.en: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reports that so far this year, 14 countries have reported more than 1,000 locally acquired cases, of which 63 died, with Italy (714 cases) the most affected, followed by Greece. Germany reported about 4–35 locally acquired cases per year in 2019–24, mostly from the east of the country. Recently, however, it has also reported its first case since 2019 in the southern state of Bavaria, and authorities remind travellers attending beer festival events in the area to take precautions against mosquito bites. United States: Los Angeles County reported its first death of the year, a resident of the San Fernando Valley who was hospitalized and died after developing a neurological disease following infection. The county has reported 14 cases so far, and 50% of those infected live in the San Fernando Valley. The local mosquito peak season runs from June through November.

Ib4bukhQ0ZGZl5zpt_AriA.zh: 韓國於10/17宣布進入流感季,第40週(9/28~10/4)類流感門診就診率為12.1‰,已高於閾9.1‰,且呈上升趨勢,所有年齡層疫情皆為上升,目前病患多為兒童及青少年,檢出型別以H3N2為多。 美國CDC、PAHO及南半球跨國研究顯示,2025年南半球流感季疫苗保護效力(VE)約為50%,研究團隊自澳洲、紐西蘭等8個南半球國家納入2,100餘例類流感(ILI)患者及4.2萬餘例嚴重呼吸道感染(SARI)患者,ILI及SARI患者VE分別為50.4%及49.7%。研究結果顯示,接種疫苗可將需醫療處理的流感相關疾病風險降低約一半,衛生主管機關應推動符合資之人群接種疫苗,以降低流感發生率。
Ib4bukhQ0ZGZl5zpt_AriA.en: South Korea declared the start of its flu season on 17 October. The outpatient visit rate for influenza-like illness in week 40 (28 September–4 October) was 12.1‰, above the threshold of 9.1‰, and rising. Case numbers are rising in all age groups; patients are currently mainly children and adolescents, and H3N2 is the predominant detected type. The US CDC, PAHO and a multinational study in the Southern Hemisphere show that the vaccine effectiveness (VE) of the 2025 Southern Hemisphere flu season was about 50%. The research team included more than 2,100 patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) and more than 42,000 patients with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) from eight Southern Hemisphere countries, including Australia and New Zealand. VE was 50.4% for ILI patients and 49.7% for SARI patients. The findings show that vaccination can reduce the risk of influenza-related conditions requiring medical care by about half, and health authorities should promote vaccination among eligible groups to reduce influenza incidence.

lMI3zgAWyudFC25KJ6KtXQ.zh: 美國加州洛杉磯郡於10/14-17新增3例I型本土病例,為該國首起本土I型病例,病例皆無流行病學關聯及相關旅遊史,當局已啟動疫情及接觸者調查。另該郡自今年截至10/14累計報告118例II型病例。
lMI3zgAWyudFC25KJ6KtXQ.en: Los Angeles County, California, reported three new clade I locally acquired cases between 14 and 17 October, the first locally acquired clade I cases in the country. None of the cases had epidemiological links or related travel history, and authorities have launched an outbreak and contact investigation. The county has also reported 118 clade II cases cumulatively this year as of 14 October.

tk4-DWqyiv4HAIc89eLnhg.zh: 美國紐約市報告1例本土確診病例,個案於8月出現症狀,為該國自2015年以來首次報告本土病例,佛羅里達州及德州於10年前曾分別報告12及1例本土病例,該國於2023-24年分別報告152及199例旅遊相關病例。由於該市目前夜間氣溫較低,評估當地疾病傳播風險為非常低。
tk4-DWqyiv4HAIc89eLnhg.en: New York City reported one locally acquired confirmed case; the patient developed symptoms in August. This is the first locally acquired case reported in the country since 2015. Florida and Texas reported 12 and 1 locally acquired cases, respectively, 10 years ago. The country reported 152 and 199 travel-associated cases in 2023 and 2024, respectively. Because nighttime temperatures in the city are currently low, the assessed risk of local transmission is very low.

fpG84nNCq69h3qYeWPkt5Q.zh: 美國佛羅里達州今年截至9/27報告1,295例,其中1,068確診,較去年同期409例大幅增加超過2倍,亦高於去年全年病例數715例,約63%為9歲以下兒童,該州病例數增加可能與群體免疫下降、疫苗覆蓋率缺口及社區傳播等因素共同影響,惟該州近期取消強制接種疫苗計畫,可能因接種率下降影響該州弱勢族群及兒童。
fpG84nNCq69h3qYeWPkt5Q.en: Florida reported 1,295 cases this year as of 27 September, of which 1,068 were confirmed. This is more than double the 409 cases reported in the same period last year, and higher than last year's full-year total of 715 cases. About 63% of cases are children under 9 years old. The rise in cases may be due to combined factors such as declining population immunity, gaps in vaccination coverage and community transmission. However, the state has recently cancelled its mandatory vaccination programme, which may lower vaccination rates and affect vulnerable groups and children in the state.

-gdP8uVPBhWiBl3wqMvD2Q.zh: 美國疫情上升,今年迄10/7共42州報告1,433例病例,其中,957 例(67%)病例被歸類為較嚴重的神經侵襲性病例。另科羅拉多州報告200餘例病例,伊利諾州報告100餘例病例,加州報告50餘例病例及5例死亡,密蘇里州報告10餘例病例及3例死亡,該國病例數較去年為高。
-gdP8uVPBhWiBl3wqMvD2Q.en: US cases are rising. As of 7 October this year, 42 states had reported 1,433 cases, of which 957 (67%) were classified as more severe neuroinvasive cases. Colorado reported more than 200 cases, Illinois more than 100, and California more than 50 cases and 5 deaths, while Missouri reported more than 10 cases and 3 deaths. The country's case count is higher than last year's.

CaIJOOhpHobgwgSBR7JpWw.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第38週(9/15-21)全球陽性率17.41%,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週(9/22-28)定醫平均報告數5.87,已連續2週下降,住院數呈下降趨勢,病患地理分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高。 西太平區署第36-37週陽性率介於0-31.1%之間,其中,澳洲、柬埔寨、菲律賓及韓國疫情呈上升趨勢。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週陽性率6.7%,已連續5週下降,住院率亦下降,惟死亡率仍處高點,近期變異株以XFG占比最高(85%)。 英國疫情持續上升,惟處低點,第39週實驗監測陽性率8.4%,住院率亦上升,變異株以XFG.3(35%)及XFG(28%)占比為高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
CaIJOOhpHobgwgSBR7JpWw.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 38 of 2025 (15–21 September) was 17.41%, with positivity rising in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 39 (22–28 September), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 5.87, having declined for two consecutive weeks; hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Western Pacific regional office: In weeks 36–37, positivity rates ranged from 0 to 31.1%, and the outbreaks in Australia, Cambodia, the Philippines and South Korea are rising. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 39 was 6.7%, having declined for five consecutive weeks, and hospitalization rates have also declined, but the mortality rate remains high. The variant XFG has the highest share recently (85%). United Kingdom: The outbreak continues to rise but is at a low level. The laboratory surveillance positivity rate in week 39 was 8.4%, and hospitalization rates have also risen. The variants XFG.3 (35%) and XFG (28%) have high shares. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

V4KkBACiNV0p_6zLSUcHUA.en: Mississippi has reported 115 cases this year, more than double last year's 49 cases. The state also reported its third death since 2008, a newborn under two months old who was not yet of vaccination age. Authorities urge people to get vaccinated.

qVY7DcL8-nBWqjCIngSLAg.zh: 美國9/30報告20例病例,其中4例死亡,並有一名孕婦流產,病患分布於15個州;疑感染源包含即時雞肉義大利麵、牛肉丸番茄麵等,當局已要求製造商下架。
qVY7DcL8-nBWqjCIngSLAg.en: The US reported 20 cases on 30 September, including 4 deaths and one miscarriage in a pregnant woman; cases are distributed across 15 states. Suspected sources include ready-to-eat chicken spaghetti and beef meatball tomato noodles, and authorities have requested that the manufacturer withdraw the products from shelves.

QuVdC98S2DNwU5ZPKgOGRg.zh: 以色列疫情持續,近1週報告4例兒童死亡案例,今年迄今已累計報告6例死亡,該國今年4月爆發疫情,截至9月中旬累計報告超過1,200例,病例多集中於該國中/北部地區。 安哥拉今年迄今累計報告逾6,000例,全國所有省分均有通報病例,該國疫苗覆蓋率已超過70%,惟農村地區及郊區覆蓋率仍低,該國仍持續存在社區傳播風險。 美國今年截至9/23共42州報告1,514例,其中185例住院、3例死亡,並報告40起疫情。新墨西哥州宣布疫情結束,該州自今年2/14爆發疫情,累計報告100例,為該州1996年以來首次爆發疫情,亦為數十年以來最大規模疫情。
QuVdC98S2DNwU5ZPKgOGRg.en: Israel: The outbreak continues. In the past week, four child deaths were reported, bringing the cumulative number of deaths this year to six. The outbreak began in April this year, and as of mid-September more than 1,200 cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the central and northern parts of the country. Angola: More than 6,000 cases have been reported so far this year, with cases reported in all provinces of the country. Vaccination coverage has exceeded 70%, but coverage remains low in rural and suburban areas, and the risk of community transmission persists. United States: As of 23 September this year, 1,514 cases had been reported from 42 states, including 185 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 40 outbreaks had been reported. New Mexico has declared its outbreak over. The state's outbreak began on 14 February this year, with 100 cases reported cumulatively; it was the state's first outbreak since 1996 and the largest in decades.

q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年9/26累計141國/地區報告16萬2千餘例確診病例,其中,至少430例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第39週累計96國/地區報告4萬2千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬5,363例、美洲區3,314例、歐洲區2,044例、西太平洋區1,229例、東南亞區95例及東地中海區40例。東地中海與歐洲疫情上升,非洲、美洲、西太平洋、東南亞疫情下降。  其他更新:  美國加州9/15報告新增1例I型病例,為該州第2例、該國第6例I型病例,病患近期具中東旅遊史,與其他病例無流行病學關聯。*加州首例為2024年11月報告。 塞內加爾自今年8月報告首例截至9/23累計4例病例,首例為境外移入Ib型病例,案2確診IIb型,與案1無流行病學關聯,案3、4為案2接觸者,推測感染為IIb型病例,當局已匡列40名接觸者。 愛爾蘭9/18報告3例Ib型確診病例及1例疑病例,首例確診病例與具中東旅遊史之疑病例具流行病關聯,餘2例確診者為首例之密切接觸者,其中有1名兒童,目前病患皆已康復。當局評估該國風險仍低,並呼籲旅外民眾應採取必要公衛措施。 科威特8/10報告該國首例M痘病例,為IIb型,迄今累計3例確診病例,首例具中國旅遊史,當局已疫調並匡列接觸者。 澳大利亞9/9報告新增1例Ib型病例,具中國及菲律賓旅遊史,為該國自2024年1月迄今第3例,當局已疫調並追蹤接觸者,並協助接種暴露後疫苗。 泰國9/9報告新增Ib型病例,病患為成年男性,具阿曼旅遊史。為該國自2024年1月迄今第6例Ib型病例。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5公布經IHR緊急委員會第5次會議討論,建議中止國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),WHO於記者會表示,剛果民主共和國/蒲隆地/獅子山/烏干達等國病例/死亡數持續下降,且對疾病傳播及嚴重度風險因素已逐漸掌握,受影響國家亦建立持續應對能力,不再構成PHEIC,惟提醒PHEIC解除並不代表威脅已經消失,非洲CDC仍持續列為非洲緊急衛生事件。WHO評估全球公共衛生風險為中等,由於不同基因型持續流行、監測及診斷能力不足、資金缺乏及社區參與需更多資源,WHO已將長期建議延長至2026年8月。
q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 26 September this year, 141 countries and areas have reported more than 162,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 430 died (CFR 0.2%). Year to date as of week 39, 96 countries and areas have reported more than 42,000 confirmed cases: 35,363 in the African Region, 3,314 in the Region of the Americas, 2,044 in the European Region, 1,229 in the Western Pacific Region, 95 in the South-East Asia Region and 40 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have risen in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe and declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Other updates: On 15 September, California, United States, reported one new clade I case, the state's second and the country's sixth clade I case. The patient had recent travel history to the Middle East and no epidemiological link to other cases. The state's first case was reported in November 2024. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Case 2 was confirmed as clade IIb and had no epidemiological link to case 1; cases 3 and 4 were contacts of case 2, and their infection is presumed to be clade IIb. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. Kuwait reported its first mpox case on 10 August; it was clade IIb, and 3 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Australia reported one new clade Ib case on 9 September, with travel history to China and the Philippines; it is the country's third case since January 2024. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Thailand reported a new clade Ib case on 9 September; the patient is an adult man with travel history to Oman, and it is the country's sixth clade Ib case since January 2024. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.

LceF6f0ChGv_PqaiXq6k0g.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共11國於 2025/9/19-26 期間報告51起H5N1疫情,西班牙18起、南非10起、美國 9 起、波蘭4起、葡萄牙3起、加拿大2起、匈牙利/韓國/德國/挪威/瓜地馬拉各1起。 美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,080(1)起疫情,近期主要集中於內布拉斯加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第38週計432個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中3州(紐澤西、加州、奧勒岡州)共3個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感28例 (2003年迄今累計991*例),H9N2流感26例(迄今累計156例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計59國家/地區通報2,344起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  其他更新: 美國洛杉磯報告出現同一家庭內2隻家貓因食用生鮮貓食死亡案例,其中一隻檢測出高致病性H5N1病毒,該病毒屬於B3.13基因型,此病毒已在美國乳牛和家禽中傳播;另一隻家貓無法檢測,迄今尚未發現人類感染案例。此為 2024 年12月和2025年1月報告10起(9例確診、1例疑)貓群感染病例以來,洛杉磯縣首次出現貓群感染H5N1病毒病例。 評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
LceF6f0ChGv_PqaiXq6k0g.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 11 countries reported 51 H5N1 outbreaks between 19 and 26 September 2025: Spain 18, South Africa 10, United States 9, Poland 4, Portugal 3, Canada 2, and Hungary, South Korea, Germany, Norway and Guatemala 1 each. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,080 (1) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 1 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 28 H5N1 influenza (991* cumulative since 2003); 26 H9N2 influenza (156 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 59 countries and areas have reported 2,344 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Other updates: In Los Angeles, United States, two domestic cats in the same household died after eating raw cat food. One of them tested positive for highly pathogenic H5N1 virus of genotype B3.13, a virus already spreading among US dairy cattle and poultry; the other could not be tested. No human infection has been found so far. This is the first H5N1 infection cluster in cats in Los Angeles County since 10 cases (9 confirmed and 1 suspected) were reported in December 2024 and January 2025. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第36週(9/1-7)全球陽性率18.98%,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點,第38週(9/15-21)門急診陽性率5.3%,較前一週下降,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點,第38週陽性率下降至0.65%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,第38週報告病例數及死亡數均低,其中,印度及泊爾變異株以XFG占比最高,泰國以NB.1.8.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第37週陽性率9.5%,已連續3週下降,住院率亦呈下降趨勢,惟死亡率仍處高點。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(72%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 36 of 2025 (1–7 September) was 18.98%, with positivity increasing in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. China: The outbreak is at a low point. The outpatient and emergency positivity rate in week 38 (15–21 September) was 5.3%, lower than the previous week, and the hospital positivity rate is also declining. The variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Hong Kong: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate fell to 0.65% in week 38, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 38, reported cases and deaths were low; the variant XFG has the highest share in India and Nepal, and NB.1.8.1 predominates in Thailand. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 37 was 9.5%, having declined for three consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (72%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

8_-lQY_69h-5cx0x0BttRg.zh: 美國伊利諾州報告今年首例病例,病情嚴重,感染來源調查中,當局已針對病患發病前活動地區進行主動蜱蟲監測,並建議民眾應採取預防蜱蟲叮咬之防護措施,另於常見蜱蟲之戶外活動後,倘出現發燒、疲倦或頭痛等症狀,應立即就醫。
8_-lQY_69h-5cx0x0BttRg.en: The US state of Illinois reported its first case of the year. The patient is seriously ill, and the source of infection is under investigation. Authorities have conducted active tick surveillance in the areas the patient visited before symptom onset, and recommend that the public take measures to prevent tick bites. After outdoor activities where common ticks are present, anyone who develops fever, fatigue or headache should seek medical care immediately.

ZudW_DkC77OGhqq7Jp5OXg.zh: 美國今年截至9/17共42州報告1,491例,其中181例住院、3例死亡,病患年齡以5-19歲占大宗。 加拿大近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第36週(8/31-9/6)新增報告53例,今年累計報告4,902例病例,病患多分布於安大略省及亞伯達省,年齡以5-17歲為多。 玻利維亞今年截至9/19累計報告逾1,500例,為南美洲病例數最多國家,分布以東部聖克魯斯省為多(佔85%),病患年齡多為1-9歲,84%病患未接種疫苗或接種情況不明。
ZudW_DkC77OGhqq7Jp5OXg.en: As of 17 September, 42 US states had reported 1,491 cases this year, including 181 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; most patients were aged 5–19 years. Canada's recent outbreak shows a declining trend: 53 new cases were reported in week 36 (31 August–6 September), and 4,902 cases have been reported cumulatively this year. Most cases are in Ontario and Alberta, and most patients are aged 5–17 years. Bolivia reported more than 1,500 cumulative cases as of 19 September, the highest number in South America. Cases are concentrated in eastern Santa Cruz Department (85%); most patients are aged 1–9 years, and 84% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status.

QCD3_Gs3bIuxXZZQTS5sbg.zh: 美國於9/11公布2024-25流感季之累計住院率為每10萬人口127.1人,為2011年以來最高,住院病患以75歲以上為多,32%有接種流感疫苗,84%有使用抗病毒藥劑,16.8%入住重症病房,3%於住院期間死亡,CDC建議所有沒有禁忌症且≥6個月大者應每年接種疫苗,所有住院患者應及時接受抗病毒藥物治療,以降低併發症風險。
QCD3_Gs3bIuxXZZQTS5sbg.en: On 11 September, the United States announced that the cumulative hospitalization rate for the 2024–25 influenza season was 127.1 per 100,000 population, the highest since 2011. Most hospitalized patients were aged over 75. Of hospitalized patients, 32% had received influenza vaccination, 84% had received antiviral treatment, 16.8% were admitted to intensive care units, and 3% died during hospitalization. CDC recommends annual vaccination for everyone aged 6 months and older without contraindications, and timely antiviral treatment for all hospitalized patients to reduce the risk of complications.

7qdpPO0bFw78-rZJOazyOQ.zh: 美國今年截至9/10共42州報告1,454例,其中180例住院、3例死亡,病患以5-19歲族群為主,92%未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明;中國今年截至8月累計報告1,744例病例,無死亡病例,其中8月新增94例,為今年單月最低。
7qdpPO0bFw78-rZJOazyOQ.en: As of 10 September this year, 42 US states had reported 1,454 cases, including 180 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Most patients are aged 5–19 years, and 92% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. China reported a cumulative 1,744 cases this year as of August, with no deaths; 94 new cases were reported in August, the lowest monthly figure this year.

R8HumXA4uGwubhXmmQcGMw.zh: 美國紐約市西徹斯特郡(Westchester)於9/8報告37例病例,其中2例死亡,感染源調查中;該市哈林區在8月亦曾因冷卻水塔汙染爆發疫情,造成至少100例病例,其中7例死亡。
R8HumXA4uGwubhXmmQcGMw.en: Westchester County, New York, USA, reported 37 cases on 8 September, including 2 deaths; the source of infection is under investigation. Earlier in August, an outbreak in the Harlem district of New York City was caused by contamination of a cooling tower, resulting in at least 100 cases, including 7 deaths.

NshTiUbU-65qAzhhIzhLsg.zh: 美國佛蒙特州9/8報告該州首例,病患來自該州東部溫莎郡(Windsor County),經實驗室檢驗後確診,相關流行病學資訊不明。該病毒今年7月首次於該州檢出,病毒透過蚊蟲傳播,多數人出現發燒、疲勞及頭痛等輕微症狀,部分人出現類流感症狀,免疫系統低下或年長者可能出現神經性症狀或頸部僵硬等嚴重症狀。目前尚無疫苗及治療方法。自2002年迄今,該州報告17例西羅河熱及4例東部馬腦炎,當局表示雖然天氣逐漸轉涼,呼籲民眾仍應採取防蚊措施。
NshTiUbU-65qAzhhIzhLsg.en: Vermont State, USA, reported its first case of the state on 8 September. The patient, from Windsor County in the east of the state, was confirmed by laboratory testing; relevant epidemiological information is unknown. The virus was first detected in the state in July this year. It is transmitted by mosquitoes. Most people develop mild symptoms such as fever, fatigue and headache, and some have influenza-like symptoms. People with weakened immune systems or older adults may develop severe symptoms, such as neurological symptoms or neck stiffness. There is currently no vaccine or treatment. Since 2002, the state has reported 17 cases of 西羅河熱 (English name to be verified) and four cases of eastern equine encephalitis. Authorities say that although the weather is gradually cooling, the public should continue to take mosquito-prevention measures.

Qy4fJyUrq-lvedilIMsy7w.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第34週(8/18-24)全球陽性率10.85%,美洲、歐洲及非洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點波動,8月新增約16萬例病例,其中重症187例、死亡7例,陽性率下降8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(95.2%)。 香港疫情下降,第36週陽性率下降至1.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情略降,第35週定醫平均報告數7.46,較前一週(8.8)下降,病患以10歲以下為多,地理分布以大阪、埼玉縣為多。 美國疫情經高點後稍降,第35週陽性率降為10.8%,惟已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),死亡率呈上升,住院率呈下降趨勢,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(64%),其次為NB.1.8.1(27%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
Qy4fJyUrq-lvedilIMsy7w.en: Epidemiological update: in week 34 of 2025 (18–24 August), global test positivity was 10.85%, with increases in the Americas, Europe and Africa regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating at a low level; about 160,000 cases were reported in August, including 187 severe cases and 7 deaths; positivity declined by 8%, and variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (95.2%). Hong Kong's outbreak is declining; positivity fell to 1.1% in week 36, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak has declined slightly: the sentinel average in week 35 was 7.46, down from 8.8 the previous week. Patients are mostly under 10 years old, and cases are geographically concentrated in Osaka and Saitama Prefecture. The US outbreak has declined slightly from its peak: positivity fell to 10.8% in week 35, but remains above this year's early-year peak (6.7%); mortality is rising and hospitalization rates are declining, with XFG the variant with the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward. XFG is the predominant global variant (64%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (27%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

AUwbZML0VdGLyqWtVVnKbA.zh: 美國愛荷華州馬歇爾郡爆發疫情,自8月以來累計報告34例,其中1例死亡,當局確認為群聚事件,惟尚未確定疫情爆發原因。
AUwbZML0VdGLyqWtVVnKbA.en: An outbreak has occurred in Marshall County, Iowa, USA. Since August, 34 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1 death. Authorities have confirmed it as a cluster, but the cause of the outbreak has not yet been determined.

ZprFmFN5WwQ2DWvcID00nA.zh: 英國英蘭地區今年累計報告742例,該地區病例數自4月開始上升,疫情影響倫敦及西北部地區,惟於7月中旬趨緩,超過70%病例為10歲以下兒童,並報告1例兒童死亡案例。該地區去(2024)年報告2,911例,為2012年以來新高。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至9/3共42州報告1,431例,並報告35起疫情 ,其中178例住院及3例死亡,3月為疫情高峰,目前已趨緩;加拿大截至8/30共10省報告4,849例,其中1例死亡,該國此次疫情流行基因型為D8型;墨西哥截至9/9報告9,439例,其中4,482例確診及19例死亡,該國各州皆有報告病例,病例數以契瓦瓦州報告逾4,100例為多。
ZprFmFN5WwQ2DWvcID00nA.en: In England, 742 cases have been reported this year. Case numbers in the region began rising in April, affecting London and the north-west, but slowed in mid-July. More than 70% of cases are children under 10 years old, and one child death has been reported. The region reported 2,911 cases last year (2024), the highest since 2012. North America outbreak update: in the United States, as of 3 September this year, 42 states had reported 1,431 cases and 35 outbreaks, of which 178 were hospitalized and 3 died; March was the peak, and the outbreak has now slowed. In Canada, as of 30 August, 10 provinces had reported 4,849 cases, including one death; the genotype circulating in this outbreak is D8. In Mexico, as of 9 September, 9,439 cases had been reported, of which 4,482 were confirmed and 19 died; cases have been reported in all states, most of them in Chihuahua State, which reported more than 4,100 cases.

aYQYXWyrbEWo61Oh1Fj6JQ.zh: 香港公布中國新增4例H9N2流感人類感染病例,發病時間介於7/28-8/21間,分布於安徽省/重慶市/湖南省/四川省,病患皆為6歲以下男童,其他流病資訊不明。該國今年累計報告22例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 美國CDC於9/8發布風險評估,表示透過食用或飲用受污染食物或飲品可能感染新型A型流感,近期研究顯示季節性流感及新型A型流感可能感染腸胃道,並透過非呼吸道傳播方式傳染其他哺乳動物。CDC評估透過消化系統接觸為人類及其他哺乳動物感染H5N1流感病毒之潛在途徑,雖目前尚無與飲用受汙染牛乳感染相關病例,惟近2年出現部分感染源不明之人類感染病例,並有寵物貓食用受病毒汙染之食品感染並死亡,表示風險雖低,惟仍可能發生,呼籲民眾避免生飲牛乳或生食乳製品。
aYQYXWyrbEWo61Oh1Fj6JQ.en: Hong Kong announced four new human H9N2 infections in China, with onset between 28 July and 21 August, distributed across Anhui Province, Chongqing Municipality, Hunan Province and Sichuan Province. All patients were boys under 6 years old; other epidemiological information is unknown. China has reported 22 human H9N2 infections cumulatively this year. The US CDC issued a risk assessment on 8 September, stating that novel influenza A may be contracted through eating or drinking contaminated food or beverages. Recent studies show that seasonal and novel influenza A can infect the gastrointestinal tract and spread to other mammals through non-respiratory routes. The CDC assesses that digestive-tract exposure is a potential route of H5N1 influenza infection for humans and other mammals. Although no cases have yet been linked to drinking contaminated milk, some human infections of unknown source have emerged in the past two years, and a pet cat died after eating contaminated food. The CDC says the risk is low but still possible, and urges the public to avoid drinking raw milk or eating raw dairy products.

040uF6Qi5xY2f5rrrS6OyA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第33週(8/11-17)全球陽性率8.64%,美洲及歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情下降,第35週定醫門診陽性率下降至8.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情下降,第35週陽性率下降至1.34%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(76%)。 日本疫情處高點,第33週定醫平均報告數8.76,較前一週(6.3)上升,病患以50-59歲為多,地理分布以愛知縣、大阪為多。 美國疫情持續上升,第34週陽性率11.2%,已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),新增134例死亡,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲及歐洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(67%),其次為NB.1.8.1(23%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
040uF6Qi5xY2f5rrrS6OyA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 33 of 2025 (11–17 August), global test positivity was 8.64%, with increases in the Americas and European regions. China's outbreak has declined: sentinel outpatient positivity fell to 8.5% in week 35, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak has declined: positivity fell to 1.34% in week 35, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (76%). Japan's outbreak is at its peak: the sentinel average in week 33 was 8.76, up from 6.3 the previous week. Patients are mostly aged 50–59, and cases are geographically concentrated in Aichi Prefecture and Osaka. The US outbreak continues to rise: positivity was 11.2% in week 34, exceeding this year's early-year peak (6.7%), with 134 new deaths; XFG is the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas and European regions rising. XFG is the predominant global variant (67%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

fqODVIqq1Umse-iKbKsK1w.zh: 美國紐約市哈林區群聚事件已完成調查,截至8/29累計報告114例,其中90例住院及7例死亡,調查顯示感染源為冷卻水塔,當局已要求擴大水塔檢查並要求物業業主增加檢測頻率等措施。
fqODVIqq1Umse-iKbKsK1w.en: The investigation of the cluster in the Harlem district of New York City has been completed. As of 29 August, 114 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 90 hospitalized and 7 deaths. The investigation found that the source of infection was a cooling tower. Authorities have requested expanded cooling-tower inspections and asked property owners to increase testing frequency, among other measures.

UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共3國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告16起H5N1疫情,西班牙10起、保加利亞/挪威各3起。 共2國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,挪威/法國各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第34週計431個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,204起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported 16 H5N1 outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, including Spain (10), and Bulgaria and Norway (3 each). Two countries reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, Norway and France (1 each). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 34, 431 sampling sites provided results; two sampling sites in one state (Oregon) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,204 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

AOAc-JqQlAQBv5h6qy3naQ.zh: 美國CDC公布,2024-25流感季累計報告275例與流感相關的兒童死亡病例,為2004年以來最高,超過90%的死亡病例未接種流感疫苗。
AOAc-JqQlAQBv5h6qy3naQ.en: The US CDC reported that the 2024–25 influenza season recorded 275 influenza-associated pediatric deaths cumulatively, the highest since 2004. More than 90% of the deceased children had not been vaccinated against influenza.

e0marffHh199wWCktRh9Pg.zh: 美國馬里蘭州報告首例人類感染新世界螺旋蠅(New world screwworm)病例,個案具中美洲旅遊史,當局評估對美國公共衛生風險極低。
e0marffHh199wWCktRh9Pg.en: Maryland State, USA, reported the first human case of New World screwworm, in a patient with a travel history to Central America. Authorities assess the public health risk to the United States as extremely low.

90I48yF5zc0w8PEyPGhTCw.zh: 美國加州埃爾多拉多郡8/19報告新增1例病例,為該區2020年以來首例,據調查病患在南太浩湖露營時被跳蚤咬傷,已接受治療,當局指出該州多地區都有鼠疫,呼籲民眾在戶外須避免與囓齒動物接觸,並做好防蟲措施,避免跳蚤叮咬。該郡於2020年報告1例,感染源疑為南太浩湖地區,另2015年報告2例,為優勝美地國家公園感染,3例病患皆接受治療並康復。美國每年平均報告7例,亞利桑那州於今年7月報告1例肺鼠疫死亡病例,評估目前公共風險為低。
90I48yF5zc0w8PEyPGhTCw.en: El Dorado County, California, USA, reported one new case on 19 August, the first in the area since 2020. Investigation found that the patient was bitten by fleas while camping at South Lake Tahoe, and the patient has received treatment. Authorities noted that plague is present in many areas of the state, and urged the public to avoid contact with rodents outdoors and to take insect-prevention measures to avoid flea bites. The county reported one case in 2020, with the suspected source in the South Lake Tahoe area, and two cases in 2015 infected in Yosemite National Park; all three patients were treated and recovered. The US reports an average of seven cases per year. Arizona reported one fatal pneumonic plague case in July this year. Authorities assess the current public risk as low.

jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.zh: 日本今年截至7/27累計報告4例,分別為千葉縣3例及東京都1例,該病原體不存在於該國自然環境,主要發生於前往流行區之旅客,該國2012-23共計報告34例病例,其中33例為境外感染,分別自美國31例(亞利桑那州19例/加州8例)、墨西哥1例、加拉瓜1例,1例為本土病例,其曾接觸過球孢子菌樣本。病例主要以20多歲為主,並以男性為多(男性22例/女性12例);球黴菌症屬該國第四類感染症,病例必須在診斷後立即通報。 美洲之美國西南部、墨西哥北部、中美洲和南美洲部分地區為地方性流行區,除美國外,其他國家未列入正式全國監測或法定通報疾病。墨西哥感染盛行率與美國西南部相近,於2000-19年報告766例,北部乾旱州份(如索諾拉、下加州)為主要流行區;巴西與阿根廷病例逐年增加,甚至擴展至過去之非流行區,巴西於1978-2021年共計報告292例,主要來自東北部巴西皮奧伊州(Piauí )和馬拉昂州(Maranhão)。
jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.en: Japan has cumulatively reported four cases this year as of 27 July: three in Chiba Prefecture and one in Tokyo Metropolis. The pathogen does not exist in Japan's natural environment, and cases occur mainly in travellers who visit endemic areas. From 2012 to 2023, Japan reported 34 cases in total, 33 of them acquired abroad: 31 from the United States (19 in Arizona and 8 in California), one from Mexico and one from Nicaragua. One case was locally acquired, in a person who had been exposed to Coccidioides specimens. Most cases are in patients in their 20s and are predominantly male (22 men and 12 women). Coccidioidomycosis is a Category IV notifiable infectious disease in Japan, and cases must be reported immediately upon diagnosis. In the Americas, the south-western United States, northern Mexico, Central America and parts of South America are endemic areas. Apart from the United States, other countries do not include the disease in formal national surveillance or statutory notification. Mexico's infection prevalence is similar to that of the south-western United States; Mexico reported 766 cases in 2000–2019, mainly in arid northern states such as Sonora and Baja California. Cases in Brazil and Argentina are increasing year by year and have even spread into previously non-endemic areas. Brazil reported 292 cases in 1978–2021, mainly from the north-eastern Brazilian states of Piauí and Maranhão.

eK64ZuDCnkOAgqmooVah5g.zh: 日本疫情處高點,近1週(8/4-10)通報3,211例,較前1週3,599例下降388例,以東京都(276)為多,其次為琦玉縣(222)及群馬縣(210)。今年迄今已逾6.4萬例,多地發現抗藥性菌株,並有嬰幼兒重症及死亡病例。 美國夏威夷州疫情上升,今年截至7/31累計報告203例,為去(2024)年全年病例數(84例)2倍以上,該州所有郡皆報告病例,其中考艾島/茂宜島/夏威夷島發病率最高,以1歲以下嬰兒族群受影響最嚴重,未成年族群發病率亦高。 萬那杜宣布該國南部塔菲亞省塔納島爆發疫情,截至8/17報告37例疑,其中3例嬰兒死亡。
eK64ZuDCnkOAgqmooVah5g.en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In the past week (4–10 August), 3,211 cases were reported, 388 fewer than the previous week's 3,599. Tokyo Metropolis had the most (276), followed by Saitama Prefecture (222) and Gunma Prefecture (210). So far this year, more than 64,000 cases have been reported. Drug-resistant strains have been found in many areas, and there have been severe and fatal cases among infants and young children. In the United States, Hawaii State's outbreak is rising: as of 31 July this year, 203 cases had been cumulatively reported, more than twice the full-year total of 84 cases last year (2024). All counties in the state have reported cases. Kauai, Maui and Hawaii islands have the highest incidence, and infants under one year are the most affected, with high incidence also among minors. Vanuatu announced an outbreak on Tanna Island in Tafea Province in the south of the country; as of 17 August, 37 suspected cases had been reported, including three infant deaths.

NSJf-m2mRJ6cIcgTUYIpPA.zh: 美國今年截至8/9共22州累計報告15,792例,病例數以亞利桑那州(8,480例)及加州(6,741例)為多,該國每年平均報告2萬例,去(2024)年報告逾2.6萬例,地方性流行於亞利桑那州/加州/內華達州/新墨西哥州,病例多為60歲以上族群,其中,亞利桑那州鳳凰城及土桑(Tucson)都會區,約有15-30%之社區型肺炎患者與球黴菌症相關,該病原體主要分布於該國西南部、墨西哥及中/南美洲之荒漠地帶。本疾病是全國性法定傳染病,惟各州可選擇是否強制通報,評估報告病例數較實際病例數為低。
NSJf-m2mRJ6cIcgTUYIpPA.en: As of 9 August this year, 22 US states had cumulatively reported 15,792 cases, mainly in Arizona (8,480) and California (6,741). The US reports an average of 20,000 cases per year, and more than 26,000 cases were reported last year (2024). The disease is endemic in Arizona, California, Nevada and New Mexico. Most cases are in people aged over 60. In the Phoenix and Tucson metropolitan areas of Arizona, about 15–30% of community-acquired pneumonia patients have coccidioidomycosis. The pathogen is mainly distributed in the deserts of the south-western US, Mexico, and Central and South America. It is a nationally notifiable disease, but each state may choose whether to require reporting; the reported case count is assessed to be lower than the actual number of cases.

CKVqFmusbcJ8ujFKOv4Wgw.zh: 美國加州今年截至7/31累計報告6,761例病例,較10年同期平均數3,833例大幅增加,且高於去(2024)年同期6,189例,聖華金谷(San Joaquin Valley)和該州南部為流行區,另中央谷(Central Valley)北部和該州中部海岸沿線病例數也持續上升,專家推測氣候變遷影響乾旱及降雨模式促使病原體擴散。該州去年報告近12,500例病例,為歷年最高,當局表示多數感染者為每年夏末秋初吸入含真菌之灰塵,於1至3週後發病,呼籲出現症狀者主動就醫。另建議旅客於該國西南部及聖華金谷旅行,遭遇刮風時,應停留於室內並關閉門/車窗且使用循環空氣;挖掘及翻動土壤前,應將土壤弄濕;倘無法避免戶外活動,應佩戴合適之N95口罩。
CKVqFmusbcJ8ujFKOv4Wgw.en: As of 31 July this year, California had cumulatively reported 6,761 cases, far above the 10-year same-period average of 3,833 and higher than the 6,189 cases in the same period last year. San Joaquin Valley and southern California are endemic areas, and case numbers are also continuing to rise in the northern Central Valley and along the central coast of the state. Experts suspect that climate change, affecting drought and rainfall patterns, is helping the pathogen spread. The state reported nearly 12,500 cases last year, the highest on record. Authorities say most infections occur from inhaling fungus-laden dust in late summer and early autumn, with symptoms appearing one to three weeks later, and urge people with symptoms to seek medical care promptly. Travellers in the south-western US and San Joaquin Valley are advised that, when it is windy, they should stay indoors, keep doors and windows closed and use recirculated air; soil should be wetted before digging or turning it over; and if outdoor activities cannot be avoided, a properly fitted N95 mask should be worn.

xSWZfJeyQOJyrDDzBL615Q.zh: 美國密蘇里州報告1例病例,成年病患於發病前幾日曾於奧札克湖(Ozarks)滑水,感染源調查中,該國於1962-2024年期間共報告167例,當局建議在溫暖之淡水中進行游泳或活動時,應採取相關預防措施。 印度喀拉拉邦報告3例病例,其中1例死亡,2例住院中,病患分別為3個月大嬰兒、9歲女童及1名青年,當局已啟動疫情調查、家庭篩檢及衛教宣導工作。該邦於2016-22年報告8例死亡病例,惟於2023病例數急遽增加,共計報告36例死亡病例。
xSWZfJeyQOJyrDDzBL615Q.en: Missouri State, USA, reported one case. The adult patient had been waterskiing on Lake of the Ozarks a few days before onset. The source of infection is under investigation. The US reported 167 cases in total during 1962–2024. Authorities recommend taking preventive measures when swimming or engaging in activities in warm fresh water. Kerala State, India, reported three cases, one of them fatal. Two patients are currently hospitalized: a three-month-old infant, a nine-year-old girl and a young man. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation, household screening and health education. The state reported eight deaths during 2016–22, but case numbers rose sharply in 2023, and 36 deaths have been reported in total.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

KDbIvzSioJYkUNEqIbxQlQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第30週(7/21-27)全球陽性率5.31%,創今年新高,除西太平洋區以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情持續下降,第32週(8/4-10)定醫門急診陽性率10.8%,較前週下降3.5%,住院陽性率亦下降,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第32週陽性率1.23%,已連續12週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(81.1%)。 日本疫情快速上升,第31週新增約2.1萬例病例,較前1週增加34%,定醫平均病例數增至5.53,病患以東京都、神奈川縣為多,年齡以50-59歲及10歲以下為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 美國疫情持續攀升,第31週陽性率8.6%,創今年新高,新增71例死亡,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,以XFG占比最高(54%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30%)及LP.8.1(7%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
KDbIvzSioJYkUNEqIbxQlQ.en: Epidemiological update: in week 30 of 2025 (21–27 July), global test positivity was 5.31%, the highest this year, with increases in all regions except the Western Pacific. China's outbreak continues to decline: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity was 10.8% in week 32 (4–10 August), down 3.5% from the previous week, and inpatient positivity also declined, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak is declining: positivity was 1.23% in week 32, down for 12 consecutive weeks; sentinel visit rates have also declined, and wastewater surveillance data show NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (81.1%). Japan's outbreak is rising rapidly: about 21,000 new cases were reported in week 31, up 34% from the previous week; the sentinel average increased to 5.53. Patients are mainly in Tokyo Metropolis and Kanagawa Prefecture, with the largest age groups being 50–59 years and under 10 years; NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. The US outbreak continues to climb: positivity was 8.6% in week 31, a record high this year, with 71 new deaths; NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with XFG the predominant variant (54%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30%) and LP.8.1 (7%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

yZHZwl-zr84w-PfPrVManw.zh: 美國麻薩諸塞州瑪莎葡萄園島新增1例疑病例,為該島20年來首例,病患為5週大嬰兒,據調查該嬰兒與母親於戶外散步時,疑被蜱蟲叮咬,病患於一週後出現癲癇、腦腫脹等症狀,目前於醫院治療中,5至7月為蜱蟲活躍季節,該州其他區今年迄今已累計3例病例。美國全國今年已累計7州24例病例,以威斯康辛州11例為多,近9成(22例)為神經侵襲性病例,該國去年全年累計57例,當局呼籲民眾於戶外須防範蜱蟲叮咬。
yZHZwl-zr84w-PfPrVManw.en: A new suspected case has been reported on Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts, USA, the first on the island in 20 years. The patient is a five-week-old infant. Investigation found that the infant and mother were walking outdoors when the infant was suspected of being bitten by a tick; one week later the infant developed seizures and cerebral swelling and is being treated in hospital. May to July is the active tick season. Other areas of the state have reported three cases so far this year. Nationally, the US has reported 24 cases in seven states this year, most in Wisconsin (11); nearly 90% (22 cases) were neuroinvasive. The US reported 57 cases in total last year. Authorities urge people outdoors to guard against tick bites.

8cYA8VC363_dFJhbJ-oXwg.zh: 美國紐約市自7月下旬截至8/4累計報告58例,其中2例死亡,病例主要集中於該市北部哈林區,調查顯示冷卻水塔為感染源。
8cYA8VC363_dFJhbJ-oXwg.en: New York City has reported 58 cases since late July through 4 August, including two deaths. Cases are mainly concentrated in the Harlem district in the north of the city. Investigation shows that cooling towers are the source of infection.

9iun_wZr6VbRB6pQrX8IwA.zh: 美國緬因州報告今年首例病例,為居住漢考克郡(Hancock)之成年病患,感染後出現神經系統症狀並住院治療,該病重症患者致死率約10%,康復後仍有長期後遺症,目前尚無特效治療方法。當局建議民眾外出,應採取預防蜱蟲叮咬之防護措施。
9iun_wZr6VbRB6pQrX8IwA.en: Maine State, USA, reported its first case this year, an adult resident of Hancock County. The patient developed neurological symptoms after infection and was hospitalized. Severe cases of this disease have a fatality rate of about 10%, and survivors may have long-term sequelae; there is currently no specific treatment. Authorities advise people going outdoors to take measures to prevent tick bites.

SCbDmT5JWXOQp_MNZaLz7Q.zh: 美國明蘇達州今年迄今報告5例病例,病患分別於蜱蟲叮咬、流浪貓咬傷後,以及修剪草坪時感染,該州每年平均報告達6例,專家提醒民眾留意寵物是否有罹病情形及提供寵物避免被蜱蟲叮咬之防治措施。
SCbDmT5JWXOQp_MNZaLz7Q.en: Minnesota has reported 5 tularemia cases so far this year. Patients were infected after a tick bite, after a stray cat bite, and while mowing the lawn. The state reports an average of 6 cases per year. Experts remind the public to watch whether pets show signs of illness and to use tick-bite prevention measures for pets.

pLU1sv6G84fY3w0q3-123g.zh: 美國南卡羅萊納州報告1例死亡病例,為12歲男童,病患於哥倫比亞市之默里湖水庫游泳後感染,於7/17死亡,為該州自2016年以來首例。該國於1962-2024年期間共報告167例,其中163例死亡(CFR:97.6%),每年報告約10例以下,當局建議在溫暖之淡水中進行游泳或活動時,應採取相關預防措施。
pLU1sv6G84fY3w0q3-123g.en: South Carolina reported one death, a 12-year-old boy who was infected after swimming in the Murray Lake reservoir in Columbia and died on 17 July. It is the state's first such death since 2016. From 1962 to 2024, the country reported 167 cases, 163 of which were fatal (CFR 97.6%), with about 10 or fewer cases reported per year. Authorities recommend precautions when swimming or engaging in other activities in warm freshwater.

QUNnz_4491c4HG5sIhJ6IQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第27週(6/30-7/6)全球陽性率4.19%,美洲、東地中海、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情小幅度反彈,第29週(7/14-20)定醫門診陽性率14%,較第27週11.9%上升,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方,惟住院陽性率仍呈下降趨勢,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第29週陽性率2.3%,已連續9週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(88.1%),另XFG占1.7%。 美國疫情上升,第28週(7/6-12)陽性率4.8%,已連續6週上升,新增63例死亡,近期變異株以NB.1.8.1為主,其次為LP.8.1及XFG。 歐洲疫情上升,第28週(7/6-12)定醫門診陽性率16.7%,創今年新高,以變異株XFG占比最高(52%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、東地中海、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;XFG為全球主要流行變異株,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
QUNnz_4491c4HG5sIhJ6IQ.en: Epidemic update: Globally, the positivity rate in week 27 of 2025 (30 June–6 July) was 4.19%, with increases in the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. China: a slight rebound. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 29 (14–20 July) was 14%, up from 11.9% in week 27. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, while hospital positivity continues to decline. The dominant variant is NB.1.8.1. Hong Kong: the epidemic is declining. Positivity in week 29 was 2.3%, down for 9 consecutive weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share (88.1%), with XFG at 1.7%. United States: the epidemic is rising. Positivity in week 28 (6–12 July) was 4.8%, up for 6 consecutive weeks, with 63 new deaths reported. The main variants are NB.1.8.1, followed by LP.8.1 and XFG. Europe: the epidemic is rising. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 28 (6–12 July) was 16.7%, the highest this year, with XFG the dominant variant (52%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. XFG is the main variant circulating globally, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

KZ9QpPEB3WJTY1krNMkmuw.zh: 美國佛羅里達州今年截至7/11累計報告11例病例,其中4例死亡(CFR: 36%),該州去年因受海倫/米爾頓颶風災情,報告82例病例,其中19例死亡(CFR: 23%);美國全國每年平均報告150至200例病例,因創傷弧菌需要於鹹水環境生存,當局呼籲民眾避免接觸汙水、海水及生食海鮮。
KZ9QpPEB3WJTY1krNMkmuw.en: Florida has reported 11 cases so far this year as of 11 July, including 4 deaths (CFR 36%). Last year, the state reported 82 cases, including 19 deaths (CFR 23%), following damage from Hurricanes Helene and Milton. Nationally, the United States reports an average of 150 to 200 cases per year. Because Vibrio vulnificus needs a saltwater environment to survive, authorities urge people to avoid contact with sewage, seawater and raw seafood.

4Cy8AvSqkI_yaJWCtsQVZQ.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/21共10省報告3,977例,病患有86%未接種疫苗,年齡以5-17歲為多,主要分布於安大略省及亞伯達省;該國今年病例數排名全球第9名,另病例數前3名為葉門、巴基斯坦及印度。 美國今年截至7/15共40州報告1,309例,已報告29起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有34%病例為20歲以上,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明。
4Cy8AvSqkI_yaJWCtsQVZQ.en: Canada has reported 3,977 cases in 10 provinces as of 21 July this year. 86% of patients were unvaccinated, most were aged 5–17 years, and cases are mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Canada ranks 9th globally by case count this year; the top three countries by case count are Yemen, Pakistan and India. The United States has reported 1,309 cases in 40 states as of 15 July this year, with 29 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. 34% of cases are aged 20 and over, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.

rusT9jd9tzzMnSbuZbIsIA.zh: 美國亞利桑那州北部可可諾郡報告1例肺鼠疫死亡病例,係因鼠疫桿菌造成嚴重肺部感染,為該郡2007年以後首次報告肺鼠疫死亡病例,感染源與野生動物有關。該國每年約有7例病例,公共風險為低。
rusT9jd9tzzMnSbuZbIsIA.en: Coconino County in northern Arizona has reported one death from pneumonic plague, caused by a severe lung infection from the plague bacterium (Yersinia pestis). It is the county's first pneumonic plague death since 2007, and the source of infection is linked to wildlife. The country records about 7 cases a year, and public risk is assessed as low.

LBR7MqSlzIduoUi12uNY-g.zh: 美國肯塔基州霍普金斯郡於6月報告23例病例,感染源尚未釐清,當局呼籲民眾確保飲水前煮沸消毒,避免接觸動物糞便,並注意個人飲食衛生。
LBR7MqSlzIduoUi12uNY-g.en: Hopkins County, Kentucky, USA, reported 23 cases in June. The source of infection has not yet been identified. Authorities urge residents to boil drinking water to disinfect it, avoid contact with animal feces, and maintain personal food hygiene.

iDm0jHC-G2fsTQAaC0zT2Q.zh: 美洲地區疫情持續,截至今年6月中旬報告逾7,100例及13例死亡,與去(2024)年同期244例,上升29倍,其中以加拿大(3,170例,1例死亡)為多,其次為墨西哥(2,597例,9例死亡)及美國(1,227例,3例死亡),餘有6國病例數介於1-60例間,多數病例為境外移入,受影響族群以5歲以下兒童及10-19歲青少年最為嚴重。病例數增加顯示免疫接種缺口,PAHO呼籲各國維持95%兩劑疫苗覆蓋率。WHO表示今年截至6/6,全球報告逾18萬例疑病例及8.8萬例確診。 吉爾吉斯今年截至6/17累計報告超過8,200例,其中9例死亡,病例數以首都比什凱克、南部奧什州及北部楚伊州為多,近期西部賈拉拉巴德州病例數亦持續增加,惟該國尚未宣布爆發疫情,疫情主因與大量兒童未接種疫苗有關。 日本神奈川縣報告1例10多歲青少年,該病患曾於6/21參訪大阪萬國博覽會,於會場停留約6小時,並於當日出現症狀,7/3確診,患者近期無海外旅遊史,接觸史不明。當局及主辦單位呼籲當日前往參觀人員留意自身健康情形。
iDm0jHC-G2fsTQAaC0zT2Q.en: Measles activity in the Americas continues. As of mid-June this year, more than 7,100 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, 29 times the 244 cases reported in the same period of 2024. Canada reports the most (3,170 cases, 1 death), followed by Mexico (2,597 cases, 9 deaths) and the United States (1,227 cases, 3 deaths). Six other countries have between 1 and 60 cases each. Most cases are imported. The most affected groups are children under 5 and adolescents aged 10–19. The rise in cases indicates gaps in immunization, and PAHO calls on countries to maintain 95% coverage with two doses of vaccine. WHO reports that as of 6 June this year, more than 180,000 suspected and 88,000 confirmed cases have been reported globally. Kyrgyzstan has reported more than 8,200 cumulative cases so far this year as of 17 June, including 9 deaths. Cases are mainly in the capital, Bishkek, Osh Region in the south and Chui Region in the north, and recently cases have also continued to rise in Jalal-Abad Region in the west. The country has not declared an outbreak; the main cause is that many children are unvaccinated. In Japan, Kanagawa Prefecture reported one teenager, who visited Expo 2025 Osaka on 21 June and stayed at the venue for about 6 hours, developed symptoms that day, and was confirmed on 3 July. The patient had no recent overseas travel, and the contact history is unknown. Authorities and the organizers urge those who visited on that day to monitor their health.

UVvIGCq3sH-ISLMO-A5SYw.zh: 美國威斯康辛州今年迄今報告3例病例,病患皆住院治療,其中1例死亡,該州去(2024)年報告12例,僅次於明蘇達州(14例),該國中西/東北部為高風險地區,該病致死率約為 10%,目前尚無特效治療方法或疫苗。當局呼籲醫療院所針對疑病例進行檢測,以及戶外活動族群應採取預防蜱蟲叮咬之防護措施。
UVvIGCq3sH-ISLMO-A5SYw.en: Wisconsin has reported 3 cases so far this year, all hospitalized, and one patient died. The state reported 12 cases last year, second only to Minnesota (14 cases). In the United States, the Midwest and Northeast are high-risk areas. The fatality rate of the disease is about 10%, and there is currently no specific treatment or vaccine. Authorities urge healthcare facilities to test suspected cases, and urge people who engage in outdoor activities to take measures to prevent tick bites.

dGiTC-Xc334Dmthz0Ichew.zh: 北美疫情更新,美國截至6/19共36州報告1,214例及3例死亡,並報告23起疫情;加拿大截至6/23共9省3,381例,其中1例死亡,病例數以安大略省逾2,100例為多,其次為亞伯達省960餘例,該國近期呈下降趨勢,今年病例數為1998年以來最高;墨西哥今年截至6/7累計報告5,584例,其中2,153例確診及4例死亡,病例數以赤瓦瓦州逾2,000例為多。
dGiTC-Xc334Dmthz0Ichew.en: North American measles update: As of 19 June, the United States has reported 1,214 cases in 36 states, including 3 deaths, and 23 outbreaks. As of 23 June, Canada has reported 3,381 cases in 9 provinces, including 1 death. Ontario has the most, with more than 2,100 cases, followed by Alberta with more than 960. Cases in Canada have recently trended downward, but this year's case count is the highest since 1998. As of 7 June this year, Mexico has cumulatively reported 5,584 cases, of which 2,153 were confirmed and 4 died. Chihuahua State has the most, with more than 2,000 cases.

O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山報告自今年初截至6/17累計4,098例確診病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:0.6%),該國已為非洲病例數第三多之國家,僅次剛果民主共和國及烏干達;迦納疫情上升,自今年截至6/18累計117例確診,7成病例分布於該國西部;賴比瑞亞報告今年截至5/31累計69例確診病例,包含IIa及IIb型病例,當局已發布警報,以防止社區及跨境傳播。 美國麻薩諸塞州6/17報告該州首例I型且為該國第5例病例,曾有中非旅遊史,當局研判該國與該州的傳播風險為低。
O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.en: Africa update: Sierra Leone has reported 4,098 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 17 June, including 25 deaths (CFR 0.6%), making it the third highest in Africa, after the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Ghana's outbreak is rising: 117 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 18 June, with 70% in the west of the country. Liberia has reported 69 confirmed cases this year to 31 May, including clade IIa and IIb cases, and authorities have issued an alert to prevent community and cross-border transmission. United States: on 17 June Massachusetts reported the state's first clade I case, the fifth case in the country, in a person with a history of travel to Central Africa. Authorities assess the transmission risk for the country and the state as low.

v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第22週(5/26-6/1)全球陽性率3.5%,除非洲、西太平洋及東地中海區以外,餘區域陽性率皆上升。 馬來西亞疫情上升,5月下旬每日新增300例病例,較去年12月高峰為高,住院數亦上升,陽性率達68%;韓國疫情經4月高峰後,呈波動下降趨勢,第24週(6/8-14)新增93例病例,為第10週以來最低,陽性率為9.9%,以NB.1.8.1為主;日本第24週(6/9-15)定點平均報告數0.90例,較前一週0.92例下降,自年初以來,疫情持續下降;越南胡志明市疫情經4-5月高峰後,呈下降趨勢,第24週(6/9-15)報告32例,較前2週下降66%;香港第24週(6/8-14)陽性率4.89%,陽性率及定醫就診率持續呈下降趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,以NB.1.8.1為主要流行變異株。 美國疫情下降,自1月初每週1,000例死亡,下降至5月每週200例,第20週(5/11-17)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比最高,預測NB.1.8.1將成為主流變異株;加拿大疫情處低點,病例數自1月之每週近4,000例,下降至5月每週約500例,第22週(5/25-31)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比為高。  歐洲11國處疫情高點,第23週(6/1-7)門診陽性率10.2%,較前週高峰(10.9%)稍低,惟住院陽性率達5.9%,為今年新高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢;以NB.1.8.1變異株占比最高,LP.8.1占比次高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.en: Epidemic update: In week 22 of 2025 (26 May–1 June), global positivity was 3.5%, with increases in all regions except Africa, the Western Pacific and the Eastern Mediterranean. Malaysia: the epidemic is rising. Daily new cases were about 300 in late May, higher than the December peak; hospitalizations are also rising, and positivity reached 68%. South Korea: after a peak in April, the epidemic has fluctuated and declined. In week 24 (8–14 June), 93 new cases were reported, the lowest since week 10, with positivity of 9.9%, mainly NB.1.8.1. Japan: in week 24 (9–15 June) the sentinel average was 0.90, down from 0.92 the previous week, and the epidemic has continued to decline since the beginning of the year. Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: after a peak in April–May, the epidemic is declining; 32 cases were reported in week 24 (9–15 June), down 66% over the previous two weeks. Hong Kong: in week 24 (8–14 June), positivity was 4.89%. Positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continue to decline, and wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 as the main circulating variant. United States: the epidemic is declining. Deaths fell from about 1,000 per week in early January to about 200 per week in May. Positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest shares; NB.1.8.1 is predicted to become the dominant variant. Canada: the epidemic is at a low point. Weekly cases fell from nearly 4,000 in January to about 500 in May. Positivity in week 22 (25–31 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for high shares. Europe: 11 countries are at the epidemic peak. Outpatient positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 10.2%, slightly lower than the previous peak of 10.9%, but hospital positivity reached 5.9%, the highest this year. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest share and LP.8.1 the second highest. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

4pNvMqivkGYKbD5TIm023w.zh: 美國於6/18報告累計13州17例病例,其中3例死亡,經調查疑感染源為冷藏雞肉寬麵產品,廠商已召回產品。
4pNvMqivkGYKbD5TIm023w.en: As of 18 June, the United States has reported 17 cumulative cases in 13 states, including 3 deaths. Investigation suggests the source of infection is refrigerated chicken and wide-noodle products. The manufacturer has recalled the products.

pwfW1zb8a9AiNKvBaUHFBA.zh: 剛果民主共和國東北部伊圖里省於去年報告1.3萬例,其中343例死亡;美國堪薩斯州爆發疫情,自去年以來累計68例活動性結核和100例潛伏性結核感染,多數病例為去年5-8月間發現,持續有病例報告,惟對一般民眾風險仍為低。
pwfW1zb8a9AiNKvBaUHFBA.en: Ituri Province in the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 13,000 cases last year, including 343 deaths. In Kansas, USA, an outbreak has occurred: since last year, 68 active tuberculosis cases and 100 latent tuberculosis infections have been reported cumulatively. Most were identified between May and August last year, and cases continue to be reported, but the risk to the general public remains low.

FAbqNgLPt-7DziaUW6B5qg.zh: WHO於6/10公布風險評估報告,主要病媒為帕拉森斯庫蠓(Culicoides paraensis),其廣泛分布於美洲,疫情主要發生於亞馬遜雨林地區,2024年病例數明顯上升且持續傳播至原流行區以外地區,並首次於古巴發生疫情,且美國及歐洲部分國家亦報告境外移入病例,另巴西報告多起垂直傳染致新生兒小頭症等不良妊娠案例。人類病例主要透過病媒叮咬感染,目前尚未報告人際傳播病例,惟近期發生疑垂直感染案例,持續對其傳播機制進行研究。WHO評估於主要病媒活躍地區風險為中,存在次要病媒地區風險為低,主要病媒已知不存在地區風險為非常低。
FAbqNgLPt-7DziaUW6B5qg.en: WHO published a risk assessment on 10 June. The main vector is Culicoides paraensis, which is widely distributed in the Americas. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in the Amazon rainforest region. Case numbers rose markedly in 2024, and transmission has spread beyond the original endemic areas. An outbreak has occurred in Cuba for the first time, and some countries in the United States and Europe have reported imported cases. Brazil has reported several cases of vertical transmission leading to adverse pregnancy outcomes, including microcephaly in newborns.
