Human cases are mainly infected through vector bites, and no person-to-person transmission has been reported so far; recent suspected vertical transmission cases are being studied to clarify the transmission mechanism. WHO assesses the risk as moderate in areas where the main vector is active, low in areas with secondary vectors, and very low in areas where the main vector is known to be absent.

3lcMxf8DIVDHh51clm8YSQ.zh: 美國內布拉斯加州西南部地區於5月份新增3例,該地區過去10年僅報告6例,當局表示病例數異常增加,該州之去年病例數高於平均,其中9月份新增7例,超過半數為嚴重度高之肺部型感染疾病。
3lcMxf8DIVDHh51clm8YSQ.en: In southwestern Nebraska, 3 cases were reported in May. The area had reported only 6 cases in the past 10 years, and authorities say case numbers have risen abnormally. Nebraska's case count last year was above average, with 7 cases added in September, more than half of them severe pulmonary infections.

0hNoS2UKJUQYsfQ0Cwy8pQ.zh: 美國肯塔基州報告2例嬰兒死亡案例,嬰兒及母親皆未接種疫苗,該案為該州2018年以來首起百日咳死亡病例,當局表示該州發病率呈上升趨勢,於去(2024)年報告543例,為2012年以來最高,今年迄今已報告247例。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/26-6/1)通報2,329例,較前1週2,660例下降331例,病例數以東京都(120)為多,其次為千葉縣/兵庫縣(109)。今年迄今已累計逾2.5萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例。
0hNoS2UKJUQYsfQ0Cwy8pQ.en: In Kentucky, USA, 2 infant deaths were reported, with neither the infants nor their mothers vaccinated. This is the state's first pertussis death since 2018. Authorities say incidence in the state is rising: 543 cases were reported last year, the highest since 2012, and 247 cases have been reported so far this year. Japan's epidemic continues: in the most recent week (26 May–1 June), 2,329 cases were reported, down 331 from 2,660 the previous week. Tokyo Metropolis (120) reported the most, followed by Chiba and Hyogo prefectures (109). So far this year, more than 25,000 cumulative cases have been reported, and severe infant cases and deaths have been reported.

56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦爆發疫情,共報告18例,病例皆與當地5月初舉行之國際活動相關,其中12例為來自波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國之民眾;玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省報告7例,指標病例為22歲男性,具傳染力期間曾參加大型宗教集會,因具社區傳播風險,當局發布衛生警示。隨北半球夏季即將到來,預期旅遊及大型活動增加,將提升疾病傳播及跨境感染風險。 美國亞利桑納州報告該州今年首起疫情,4例病患來自該州東部納瓦荷郡,皆未接種疫苗,近期有境外旅遊史,均來自同一感染源;該國截至6/5共34州報告17起疫情,累計1,168例病例,其中137例住院及3例死亡。
56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.en: An outbreak in Bavaria, Germany, has reported 18 cases, all linked to an international event held locally in early May; 12 of the cases were people from Poland, Italy, the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. In Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia, 7 cases have been reported. The index case was a 22-year-old man who attended a large religious gathering during his infectious period. Because of the risk of community transmission, authorities have issued a health alert. As the northern hemisphere summer approaches, travel and large events are expected to increase, raising the risk of disease spread and cross-border infection. In the United States, Arizona reported the state's first outbreak this year: 4 patients from Navajo County in the east of the state, all unvaccinated, with recent overseas travel, all from the same source. As of 5 June, 34 states have reported 17 outbreaks in the country, with 1,168 cumulative cases, including 137 hospitalized and 3 deaths.

GdvlVIAMiJXbHzzbj4q4oQ.zh: 美國今年截至5/19累計35州報告104例病例,其中1例死亡,25例住院,發病日介於2/9-5/3;當局已啟動與自養家禽者之相關調查及防治措施,並呼籲民眾應於接觸自養家禽後,加強個人衛生。
GdvlVIAMiJXbHzzbj4q4oQ.en: As of 19 May this year, 35 US states have reported 104 cases cumulatively, including 1 death and 25 hospitalizations; onset dates ranged from 9 February to 3 May. Authorities have launched investigations and control measures related to backyard poultry, and urge the public to strengthen personal hygiene after contact with backyard poultry.

k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.zh: PAHO於5/31發布百日咳流病警報,美洲7國病例數呈上升趨勢,其中,以美國逾1萬例病例及5例死亡最為嚴峻,餘有巴西/墨西哥/厄瓜多/祕魯/哥倫比亞/巴拉圭,病例數在37-1,634例間。該地區於2012年病例數達高峰後,持續下降,惟於2023年開始上升,去年報告4.4萬例,病例數增加與新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下降相關,PAHO呼籲各國加強監測及加強疫苗接種等措施。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/19-25)通報2,660例,較前1週2,299例增加360餘例,持續創2018年以來新高,新增病例數以新潟縣(148)為多,其次為兵庫縣(139)。今年迄今已累計逾2.2萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,專家表示此次疫情嚴峻與易感性族群增加相關,由於疫情期間防護措施,導致對多種呼吸道傳染病免疫力下降,且抗藥性菌株於去年秋天以來持續傳播。今年報告2例未達接種月齡之新生兒死亡病例,且此次疫情集中於10多歲青少年族群,建議常與家中嬰幼兒接觸之家庭成員接種疫苗。
k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.zh: 美洲:美國今年截至5/29報告14起疫情,累計33州1,088例,其中133例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾740例為多,近期德州地區疫情已趨緩,惟其他州仍持續報告零星病例,南達科他州報告今年首例;墨西哥今年截至5/12報告逾 4,200例,其中1,520例確診及4例死亡,以奇瓦瓦州(1,434)為多。 亞洲:吉爾吉斯今年截至5/27累計報告逾7,300例,主要分布於首都比斯凱克,另北部楚河州及南部奧什州病例數亦較高,疫情分布廣泛,遍及都會及農村地區,94%病例未接種疫苗;蒙古今年迄今報告3,100餘例,病例主要集中於校園,當局呼籲學生、教職員及與學齡族群密切接觸人員接種疫苗。 非洲:摩洛哥今年累計報告超過40,000例,其中79例死亡(CFR:0.2%),目前當局持續進行全國性疫苗接種。
eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.en: Americas: as of 29 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,088 cases cumulatively across 33 states, including 133 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 740 cases. The Texas outbreak has recently slowed, but other states continue to report sporadic cases, and South Dakota reported its first case this year. As of 12 May, Mexico had reported over 4,200 cases this year, including 1,520 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, mainly in Chihuahua State (1,434). Asia: as of 27 May this year, Kyrgyzstan has reported over 7,300 cases cumulatively, mainly in the capital Bishkek, with high numbers also in the northern Chui Region and the southern Osh Region. The outbreak is widespread across urban and rural areas, and 94% of cases were unvaccinated. Mongolia has reported over 3,100 cases so far this year, concentrated in schools, and authorities urge students, school staff and people in close contact with school-age children to be vaccinated. Africa: Morocco has reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively this year, including 79 deaths (CFR 0.2%), and nationwide vaccination is ongoing.

eXVX_6Fv882eSYVxhMkOjw.zh: 美國於5/29報告德州1例死亡病例,為71歲女性,無潛在病史,病患使用露營車供水系統之自來水進行鼻腔沖洗後,4日內出現發燒、頭痛及精神意識改變等嚴重神經症狀,經治療出現癲癇症狀,並於發病後8日死亡。CDC於病患腦脊髓液中檢出福氏內里阿米巴原蟲,惟於露營車採樣之自來水檢體並未檢出,該自來水未消毒完全。該國於1962-2023年期間報告164例,其中160例死亡(CFR:97.5%),每年報告約10例以下。當局建議使用蒸餾水、消毒水等進行鼻腔沖洗,另訂定露營車用水安全使用及儲存建議文件。
eXVX_6Fv882eSYVxhMkOjw.en: The United States reported one death in Texas on 29 May: a 71-year-old woman with no underlying conditions who had used tap water from a camper van's water supply system for nasal rinsing. Within 4 days she developed fever, headache and altered consciousness, and other severe neurological symptoms. Under treatment she had seizures, and she died 8 days after onset. CDC detected Naegleria fowleri in her cerebrospinal fluid, but it was not detected in the tap water samples collected from the camper van, which had not been fully disinfected. The country reported 164 cases between 1962 and 2023, of which 160 were fatal (CFR 97.5%), with about 10 or fewer cases reported each year. Authorities recommend rinsing the nose with distilled water or disinfected water, and have issued guidance on the safe use and storage of water in camper vans.

GNS44HmrlOVnh9NimOJ1Dw.zh: 美國密西根州於2024年報告1,215例病例,為2020年452例之 2.7倍,疫情呈上升趨勢,萊姆病主要是由肩板硬蜱 (Ixodes scapularis)傳播,其分布範圍逐漸擴大,當局建議民眾採取預防措施,以避免蜱蟲叮咬。
GNS44HmrlOVnh9NimOJ1Dw.en: Michigan reported 1,215 cases in 2024, 2.7 times the 452 cases reported in 2020, showing a rising trend. Lyme disease is mainly transmitted by the blacklegged tick (Ixodes scapularis), whose distribution range is gradually expanding. Authorities recommend that the public take preventive measures to avoid tick bites.

Oojk9Z_tkTBNje6N3ECG9w.zh: 美國CDC於5/15報告1起與洞穴旅遊相關案例,來自同一家庭之12名病患於去(2024)年12月下旬前往哥斯大黎加北部一處洞穴旅遊,回國後出現頭痛、發燒、呼吸道及腸胃道等症狀,初期因未詢問旅遊史,導致誤診。其後採檢4名成員進行真菌抗原檢測,其中2名莢膜組織漿菌陽性,開始抗真菌藥物治療,目前均已康復。該處洞穴於1998-99年亦曾爆發組織漿菌症疫情,與蝙蝠糞便相關,故懷疑為此事件可能感染源,哥國已將此地點列入旅遊排除名單,美國亦發布旅遊警示,提醒民眾洞穴旅遊感染風險。
Oojk9Z_tkTBNje6N3ECG9w.en: The US CDC reported on 15 May one case linked to cave tourism. Twelve patients from the same family had visited a cave in northern Costa Rica in late December 2024. After returning home they developed headache, fever, and respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms. The illness was initially misdiagnosed because their travel history was not asked about. Four family members were then tested with fungal antigen testing, and 2 of them were positive for Histoplasma capsulatum; antifungal treatment was started, and all have now recovered. The cave also had a histoplasmosis outbreak in 1998–99 linked to bat droppings, so it is suspected to be a possible source of this infection. Costa Rica has placed the site on its tourism exclusion list, and the United States has issued a travel alert reminding travelers of the infection risk from cave tourism.

1kovSZBbxd8mSzsk34XkiA.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/22報告14起疫情,累計31州1,046例,其中127例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,惟近期疫情已趨緩,然其他州仍持續報告零星病例,愛荷華州及內布拉斯加州報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至5/17共9省2,515例,以安大略省(1,848)為多,其次為亞伯達省(509),近期中部曼托巴省/薩斯喀徹溫省病例數亦快速增加,預估疫情將持續至夏季。 阿富汗疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告5.5萬餘例及357例死亡(CFR : 0.6%),自年初以來病例數呈穩定上升趨勢,於第16週達最高峰,疫情高於前3年(2022-24年)平均,發病率以該國南部赫爾曼德省最高,由於該國政局不穩及醫療基礎設施不足,嚴重影響疫苗接種及疫情控制等措施之推動。
1kovSZBbxd8mSzsk34XkiA.en: North America update: as of 22 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,046 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 127 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. Although the outbreak in Texas has recently slowed, other states continue to report sporadic cases, and Iowa and Nebraska reported their first cases this year. As of 17 May, Canada had 2,515 cases across 9 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,848), followed by Alberta (509). Case numbers have also risen rapidly recently in the central provinces of Manitoba and Saskatchewan, and the outbreak is expected to continue into the summer. Afghanistan's outbreak is severe: this year more than 55,000 cases and 357 deaths (CFR 0.6%) have been reported. Cases have risen steadily since the beginning of the year and peaked in week 16, higher than the average for the previous three years (2022–24). Incidence is highest in Helmand Province in the south of the country. Political instability and insufficient medical infrastructure have seriously hampered vaccination and outbreak control efforts.

pObejbypR7heGrMPm-ohkQ.zh: 美國於5/19累計15州報告26例病例,其中9例住院,經調查疑感染源為生產自佛羅里達州某廠商之小黃瓜,當局已通知廠商下架4/29-5/19期間批發之產品。
pObejbypR7heGrMPm-ohkQ.en: As of 19 May, 15 US states have reported 26 cases cumulatively, 9 of them hospitalized. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is cucumbers produced by a manufacturer in Florida. Authorities have notified the manufacturer to withdraw products wholesaled between 29 April and 19 May.

nFeo82kGjRxr9VYN439q5g.zh: 玻利維亞今年迄今已報告超過20例,其中7例死亡,以該國北部拉巴斯省報告20例為多,另南部塔里哈省報告4例及首例死亡病例,病毒於該國多個省份持續流行,每年皆有報告病例。 美國內華達州瓦肖郡(Washoe County)報告1例,為90多歲女性,病患出現症狀前數週曾直接或間接接觸囓齒動物排遺,或於施作木工時接觸到動物巢穴,相關調查持續進行中,本案為該郡2023年8月以來首例。
nFeo82kGjRxr9VYN439q5g.en: Bolivia has reported more than 20 cases so far this year, 7 of them fatal. The largest number, 20 cases, were reported in La Paz Department in the north of the country, while Tarija Department in the south reported 4 cases and its first death. The virus continues to circulate in several provinces of the country, and cases are reported every year. In Washoe County, Nevada, USA, one case was reported in a woman in her 90s. In the weeks before symptoms began, she had direct or indirect contact with rodent droppings, or came into contact with animal nests while doing woodwork. The investigation is ongoing. This is the county's first case since August 2023.

Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/15報告14起疫情,累計31州1,024例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多;加拿大今年截至5/3共7省1,846例,以安大略省(1,460)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告1,300餘例。 烏克蘭疫情上升,今年至3月報告472例,較去(2024)年增加20.5倍,並報告2例兒童死亡,病例集中於西部地區之外喀爾巴阡/車夫契/敖得薩州,由於當地戰事持續使公共衛生服務受到干擾,降低疫苗接種率,且人口流動加劇疾病傳播風險。
Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.en: North America update: as of 15 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,024 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. As of 3 May, Canada had 1,846 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,460), and case numbers in Alberta have also risen rapidly. In northern Mexico, the outbreak in Chihuahua State is severe, with more than 1,300 cases reported so far this year. Ukraine's outbreak is rising: 472 cases were reported through March this year, a 20.5-fold increase compared with last year, and 2 child deaths have been reported. Cases are concentrated in the western oblasts of Zakarpattia, Chernivtsi and Odesa. Ongoing conflict in the area is disrupting public health services and lowering vaccination rates, and population movement is increasing the risk of spread.

emBGk8iZpP3P1DygnwN99g.zh: 美國於5/10報告10例病例,病患皆住院,分布於加州及內華達州,經調查疑感染源為三明治及蛋白棒等即食產品,當局已通知廠商召回有效期限介於4/22-5/19間之產品。
emBGk8iZpP3P1DygnwN99g.en: The United States reported 10 cases on 10 May, all hospitalized, distributed in California and Nevada. Investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is ready-to-eat products such as sandwiches and protein bars. Authorities have notified the manufacturer to recall products with expiry dates between 22 April and 19 May.

JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.zh: 摩洛哥自2023年10月爆發疫情以來,截至今年4/13全國共12個地區報告2.5萬餘例疑病例,其中1.3萬餘例確診及184例死亡,該國於今年1月下旬達高峰後,已連續10週呈下降趨勢,經基因定序顯示多為B3基因型,該基因型於非洲地區流行,亦與全球疫情相關。目前疫情已受控制,惟部分地區仍持續傳播,惟該國麻疹-德國麻疹(MR)疫苗接種率僅73.6%,WHO評估該國未接種疫苗/未完全接種疫苗者與免疫功能低下者風險為「中」,由於處非/歐洲交接處,人員流動頻繁,評估區域及全球風險為「中」。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/8報告14起疫情,累計31州1,001例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,今年僅4個多月,病例數已接近2019年全年病例數(1,274),其為1992年以來病例數最高峰;加拿大今年截至4/26共7省1,506例,以安大略省(1,249)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/12累計報告362例;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告954例,其中1例死亡,該國今年迄今累計1,003例。 澳大利亞爆發近6年來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計報告72例,超過去(2024)年全年病例數(57例),分布以維多利亞州27例為多,其次為新南威爾斯州(21)及西澳大利亞州(18),超過6成病例為29歲以下族群。
JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.en: Morocco: since its outbreak began in October 2023, as of 13 April this year, 12 regions nationwide have reported more than 25,000 suspected cases, of which more than 13,000 were confirmed and 184 died. The country peaked in late January this year and has since declined for 10 consecutive weeks. Genetic sequencing shows that most cases are genotype B3, which circulates in Africa and is also linked to the global outbreak. The outbreak is now under control, but transmission continues in some areas. Morocco's measles-rubella (MR) vaccination coverage is only 73.6%. WHO assesses the risk for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people and immunocompromised people in the country as moderate. Because the country sits at the junction of Africa and Europe with frequent population movement, the regional and global risk is also assessed as moderate. North America update: as of 8 May, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,001 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. In just over four months this year, case numbers are close to the 2019 full-year total (1,274), the highest since 1992. As of 26 April, Canada had 1,506 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,249); Alberta's case numbers have risen rapidly, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 12 May. The outbreak in Chihuahua State in northern Mexico is severe, with 954 cases reported this year so far, including 1 death; the country has reported 1,003 cases so far this year. Australia is experiencing its most severe outbreak in nearly six years, with 72 cases reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (57 cases). Victoria had the most (27 cases), followed by New South Wales (21) and Western Australia (18). More than 60% of cases were aged 29 years or younger.

iPMlW6QuC64gMffbzjrSFQ.zh: 美國CDC報告7例病例,病患發病日介於2/9-3/24,分布於佛羅里達等6州,推測實際患病人數可能遠高於報告人數,經調查感染源疑為家禽;另FDA公告於2家廠商生產之番茄疑受到汙染,要求召回已於14個州販售之產品。
iPMlW6QuC64gMffbzjrSFQ.en: The US CDC reported 7 cases, with onset dates between 9 February and 24 March, distributed across 6 states including Florida. It estimates that the actual number of people ill may be much higher than the number reported. The investigation suspected poultry as the source of infection. In addition, the FDA announced that tomatoes produced by 2 manufacturers were suspected to be contaminated, and requested the recall of products already sold in 14 states.

gMIRLzui02Pe-GCKVDUkzA.zh: 日本今年截至5/7累計報告47例病例,高於去年同期(43例);韓國今年截至4/26累計報告399例病例,與去年同期(422例)相當。 美國加州洛杉磯郡今年截至3月累計報告29例病例,為去年同期2倍;此波疫情自2024年開始,累計165例病例,其中7例死亡,為10年來最高紀錄。
gMIRLzui02Pe-GCKVDUkzA.en: Japan reported 47 cases cumulatively this year as of 7 May, higher than the 43 cases in the same period last year. South Korea reported 399 cases cumulatively this year as of 26 April, comparable to the 422 cases in the same period last year. Los Angeles County, California, reported 29 cases cumulatively as of March this year, twice the number in the same period last year. This outbreak began in 2024 and has reported 165 cases cumulatively, including 7 deaths, the highest figure in 10 years.

ggoC3K9EDhIo3IEVq600WQ.zh: 美國CDC公布2024-25年流感季累計兒童死亡病例數為216例,逾上一流感季之207例,亦為2009-10年流感季以來最高,本流感季迄今累計報告至少4,700萬例,其中,61萬例住院、2.6萬例死亡,為2017-18年流感季以來最高,近期流感活動度呈下降趨勢。
ggoC3K9EDhIo3IEVq600WQ.en: The US CDC reported that the cumulative number of paediatric deaths in the 2024–25 influenza season is 216, exceeding the 207 in the previous season and the highest since the 2009–10 season. So far this season, at least 47 million cases have been reported cumulatively, including 610,000 hospitalizations and 26,000 deaths, the highest since the 2017–18 season. Recent influenza activity is declining.

dNS1TfLxgqA9ygusWOjFjQ.zh: 日本疫情更新,近1週(4/21-27)通報2,176例,高於前1週1,884例,已連續5週達2018年以來單週最高紀錄,新增病例數以東京都/福岡縣(142)、新潟縣(132)及兵庫縣(110)為多。今年迄今已累計近1.2萬例,為去年全年病例數2倍以上,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡案例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗。 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至5/2共31州報告835例,其中49例死亡,病例/死亡數皆高於去年全年總數(463/32),該國於疫情前之2016-19年間,每年報告約900例確診。 美國今年截至4/26累計報告逾9,000例,為去年同期之2倍,以西岸地區為多,華盛頓州報告逾1,000例,另俄勒岡(663)及加州(590)病例數亦高,該國近期疫情上升原因可能為接種率下降影響。
dNS1TfLxgqA9ygusWOjFjQ.en: Japan update: in the most recent week (21–27 April), 2,176 cases were reported, up from 1,884 the previous week, marking five consecutive weeks at the highest weekly level since 2018. The largest numbers of new cases were in Tokyo Metropolis / Fukuoka Prefecture (142), Niigata Prefecture (132) and Hyogo Prefecture (110). So far this year, nearly 12,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, more than double the full-year total for last year. Severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible. Mexico's outbreak is rising: as of 2 May this year, 835 cases had been reported across 31 states, 49 of them fatal, exceeding last year's full-year totals (463 cases and 32 deaths). In 2016–19, before the outbreak, about 900 confirmed cases were reported each year. The United States reported more than 9,000 cases cumulatively as of 26 April this year, twice the same period last year, mainly on the West Coast. Washington State reported more than 1,000 cases, and Oregon (663) and California (590) also had high numbers. The recent rise may be linked to declining vaccination coverage.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共8國於2025/2/17-4/28期間新增52起H5N1疫情,美國17起、韓國12起、英國11起、德國/波蘭各4起、匈牙利2起、孟加拉/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2025/3/17-4/11期間新增2起H5N5疫情,挪威/英國各1起。 日本於2025/4/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,048 (17)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第17週計407個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於5月2日更新流感風險評估工具(IRAT),將兩種新H5N1病毒列入評估名單:A/California/147/2024(基因型B3.13)及A/Washington/239/2024(基因型D1.1),兩病毒均屬H5N1 2.3.4.4b群,並被評為「中度風險」,近於先前被評估之其他 H5N1病毒。 期刊於4/28評論,來自40多國專家呼籲各國應加強監測、增強生物安全及新興傳染病整備計畫,以應對H5N1流感威脅,美國自2024年迄今超過995起乳牛場疫情及至少70例人類病例,並包含多起重症及該國首例死亡病例,部分人類病例未曾接觸感染動物,顯示病毒可能發生適應,並具有人際傳播潛力,另病毒持續於野鳥、家禽及被狩獵候鳥中傳播,亦增加人類及家畜風險。持續投入人畜監測資源,即時分享現地異常資訊及病毒基因學資料,對於掌握病毒動態至關重要。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,656起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.zh: WHO於4/28公布美洲今年截至4/18疫情概況,共6國報告超過2,300例,其中3例死亡,較去(2024)年同期上升11倍,以加拿大報告1,069例為多,其次為美國(800例,2例死亡)、墨西哥(421例,1例死亡),阿根廷/巴西/貝里斯報告2-21例間。因境外病例持續輸入導致疫情爆發,傳播鏈延長,影響範圍擴大,且美洲區疫苗覆蓋率不佳,僅約30%國家第一劑MMR疫苗覆蓋率超過95%目標,另新冠疫情、疫苗猶豫及醫療保健資源限制,致疫苗覆蓋率偏低,易感人群數上升。WHO評估該地區風險為高。其他區署疫情持續,且因資源限制、及公衛系統薄弱等因素,評估全球風險為中。
J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.en: WHO published on 28 April an overview of the Americas as of 18 April this year: 6 countries reported more than 2,300 cases, including 3 deaths, 11 times the figure for the same period last year. Canada reported the most, with 1,069 cases, followed by the United States (800 cases, 2 deaths) and Mexico (421 cases, 1 death); Argentina, Brazil and Belize reported between 2 and 21 cases each. Continuing imported cases have led to outbreaks, lengthening transmission chains and expanding the affected area. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. WHO assesses the risk in the region as high. Outbreaks in other regions continue, and due to resource constraints and weak public health systems, the global risk is assessed as moderate.

Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. OZWF_6Awucwbnw2NZkfr7Q.zh: 越南近1週(4/12-4/17)新增4,100餘例疑病例,較前1週4,500餘例下降8.8%,另有2例死亡,今年迄今累計63省市報告7.6萬例,其中超過8,600例確診及10例死亡。當局表示病例數於近期呈下降趨勢,新增病例多位於北部地區,其他地區已趨緩,經大規模疫苗接種後,10歲以下病例數已趨緩,惟10歲以上仍上升。目前該國已有52個省市接種率達95%以上接種目標,然偏遠地區及都會地區接種率仍偏低,部分民眾存在疫苗猶豫及基層醫事人員不足,致疫情控制仍面臨挑戰。 吉爾吉斯疫情嚴峻,今年迄4/10報告逾5,100例,病例數遽增,當局表示民眾因宗教因素及疫苗猶豫未接種疫苗,目前依法限制未接種疫苗者進入教育機構,並呼籲民眾接種疫苗。 美國今年截至4/17共25州報告800例及3例死亡,並報告10起疫情,其中德州報告逾600例,另有3州(路易斯安那/密蘇里/維吉亞)報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至4/5共6省報告880例,以安大略省804例為多,多數病例與去年10月新布藍茲維省所爆發疫情相關,該國病例數已達1998年以來最高。
OZWF_6Awucwbnw2NZkfr7Q.en: Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (12–17 April), more than 4,100 suspected cases were reported, down 8.8% from more than 4,500 the previous week, with 2 deaths. So far this year, 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively across 63 provinces and cities, of which more than 8,600 were confirmed and 10 died. Authorities say case numbers have declined recently; new cases are mostly in the north, and other areas have eased. After large-scale vaccination, cases among children under 10 have slowed, but cases among those over 10 are still rising. Currently 52 provinces and cities have reached the target of more than 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. Kyrgyzstan's outbreak is severe: as of 10 April this year, more than 5,100 cases had been reported, and case numbers have risen rapidly. Authorities say some people have not been vaccinated for religious reasons or due to vaccine hesitancy; unvaccinated people are now legally restricted from entering educational institutions, and the public is urged to get vaccinated. The United States reported 800 cases and 3 deaths in 25 states as of 17 April this year, with 10 outbreaks reported; more than 600 cases were in Texas, and 3 other states (Louisiana, Missouri and Virginia) reported their first cases this year. As of 5 April, Canada had reported 880 cases across 6 provinces this year, 804 of them in Ontario; most cases are linked to the outbreak that broke out in New Brunswick last October, and the country's case count has reached its highest level since 1998.

uBF54TMT_LKMsXdL4R1MVQ.zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(4/7-13)通報1,222例,高於前1週722例,已連續3週達2018年以來單週最高紀錄,病例數以新潟縣(99)、東京都(89)及兵庫縣(86)為多。今年迄今已累計7,084例,較去年全年病例數多3,000餘例,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡案例。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上之嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗,另建議兒童接種追加劑,以避免衍生重症。 美國今年迄今累計超過8,000例,較去年同期3,800餘例顯著上升,已有多個州陸續報告嬰幼兒及兒童死亡案例,該國去年病例數達10年以來新高,迄今持續上升,由於新冠疫情影響及對疫苗猶豫之家長數增加皆使疫苗接種率下降。
uBF54TMT_LKMsXdL4R1MVQ.en: Japan's outbreak is severe. In the most recent week (7–13 April), 1,222 cases were reported, up from 722 the previous week, marking three consecutive weeks at the highest weekly level since 2018. The largest numbers of cases were in Niigata Prefecture (99), Tokyo Metropolis (89) and Hyogo Prefecture (86). So far this year, 7,084 cases have been reported cumulatively, more than 3,000 above last year's full-year total, and there have been severe cases and deaths among infants. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children to avoid severe illness. The United States has reported more than 8,000 cases cumulatively so far this year, significantly higher than the more than 3,800 cases in the same period last year. Several states have reported deaths among infants and children. The US reached a 10-year high in cases last year, and numbers continue to rise; declining vaccination coverage is attributed to the COVID-19 pandemic and a growing number of parents hesitant about vaccines.

5TD4QziM87NVr-lQwXJGdw.zh: 美國威斯康辛州於2024年報告3.1萬餘例性傳染病,超過一半以上感染者年齡介於15-24歲,雖然整體感染率下降,惟梅毒病例數較2019年上升14.5倍,且高於全國平均水準。另先天性梅毒於2023-24年分別報告25例及31例,當局將密切注意先天性梅毒病例數增加之問題。
5TD4QziM87NVr-lQwXJGdw.en: Wisconsin reported more than 31,000 sexually transmitted infections in 2024, more than half of those infected aged 15–24. Although the overall infection rate has declined, syphilis cases are 14.5 times the 2019 level and higher than the national average. Congenital syphilis cases were 25 in 2023 and 31 in 2024; authorities will closely monitor the rise in congenital syphilis cases.

G5DmPGc_pb_CrTDvEiWOBg.zh: 美國明蘇達州於去(2024)年報告5例,病患皆住院,其中4例具肺炎感染症狀,相較2000-23年間之32例確定病例,僅2例出現肺炎感染。所有病患皆以抗生素作暴露後預防,出院後無併發症,據調查,2名感染者曾接觸過動物屍體。該州過去平均每年僅報告1-2例人類/動物感染病例,惟於2023年報告20例動物病例,2024年報告5例人類及27例動物病例。另美國每年報告200-300例人類感染病例,大多數發生於中部地區。
G5DmPGc_pb_CrTDvEiWOBg.en: Minnesota reported 5 cases in 2024, all hospitalized, 4 of them with pneumonia symptoms. By comparison, of 32 confirmed cases in 2000–23, only 2 had pneumonia. All patients received antibiotics as post-exposure prophylaxis and had no complications after discharge. According to investigation, 2 of the infected people had handled animal carcasses. The state reported only 1–2 human or animal infections per year on average in the past, but reported 20 animal cases in 2023, and 5 human and 27 animal cases in 2024. In addition, the US reports 200–300 human infections each year, most of them in the central region.

7H_pBrWPlRW4QvCprk1Fhg.zh: 美國CDC針對10個州進行長期監測,於2013-22年期間該國發病率增加1倍以上,由每10萬人3.6例上升至8.2例,其中原住民族群顯著高於其他族裔,另街友、毒品使用者及長照機構住民發病率亦偏高,抗藥性菌株比例由12.7%上升至45.1%。
7H_pBrWPlRW4QvCprk1Fhg.en: The US CDC conducted long-term surveillance in 10 states. From 2013 to 2022, the incidence in the country more than doubled, rising from 3.6 to 8.2 cases per 100,000 population. Indigenous populations had significantly higher rates than other ethnic groups, and incidence was also high among people experiencing homelessness, people who use drugs and residents of long-term care facilities. The proportion of drug-resistant strains rose from 12.7% to 45.1%.

a32pq-Bk9tgvue_cDDSm-w.zh: 美國德州報告該州第2例死亡案例,病患為未曾接種疫苗及無潛在病史之女童,於4/3因麻疹併發肺衰竭死亡。該國今年迄今病例數逾600例,為2024年全年之2倍以上,病例多與德州疫情相關,其中,已累計3例死亡病例,包含2例兒童及1例成人。
a32pq-Bk9tgvue_cDDSm-w.en: Texas has reported the state's second measles death: an unvaccinated girl with no underlying medical conditions, who died on 3 April of respiratory failure caused by measles complications. The United States has recorded more than 600 cases so far this year, more than double the total for all of 2024. Most cases are linked to the Texas outbreak. Three deaths have been reported cumulatively, including two children and one adult.

lBxlxQDeeeMcvvIJbiifBQ.zh: 美國CDC公布瑪麗皇后2號郵輪(Queen Mary 2)發生諾羅病毒群聚事件,該航程係於今年3/8 - 4/6自英國至東加勒比海,全船共3,770人,其中241人出現腹瀉及嘔吐症狀,CDC公布今年迄今報告12起郵輪腹瀉群聚疫情,其中10起病原為諾羅病毒,另有大腸桿菌/雪卡毒素各1起。
lBxlxQDeeeMcvvIJbiifBQ.en: The US CDC has reported a norovirus outbreak on the cruise ship Queen Mary 2. The voyage ran from the United Kingdom to the Eastern Caribbean from 8 March to 6 April this year, with 3,770 people on board, of whom 241 had diarrhoea and vomiting. The CDC says it has received reports of 12 cruise ship gastrointestinal outbreaks so far this year, 10 caused by norovirus, and one each caused by E. coli and ciguatoxin.

HU38cvHvbvOvM2hjbm8EPg.zh: 北美疫情擴大,美國今年截至4/3累計6(新增3起)起疫情,至少22州報告逾600例,為2019年以來新高,97%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明;德州疫情最為嚴峻,主要發生於蓋恩斯郡及西部地區,迄已累計19個郡報告逾480例,其中56例住院;加拿大今年截至3/22累計報告615例疑,其中514例確診,病例以安大略省(548例)為多。
HU38cvHvbvOvM2hjbm8EPg.en: The outbreak in North America is expanding. As of 3 April this year, the United States has recorded six outbreaks cumulatively (three new), with more than 600 cases reported in at least 22 states, the highest since 2019. 97% of cases were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Texas is the most severely affected, mainly in Gaines County and western areas; 19 counties have reported more than 480 cases cumulatively, 56 of whom were hospitalized. As of 22 March this year, Canada has reported 615 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 514 were confirmed; cases are concentrated in Ontario (548 cases).

WORRDks7gxZS4JzQn7cEIQ.zh: WHO公布美國疫情,今年截至3/20共17州報告378例,其中2例死亡,約90%病例與今年報告之3起疫情相關,病例集中於德州(259例)及新墨西哥州(35例)。目前基因序列資料顯示,共報告19種D8 序列,其中,新墨西哥州及堪薩斯州之部分序列與德州之D8基因型序列相同,另有8個州報告5種不同之B3基因型序列。目前疫情源頭仍不明,迄無證據顯示疫苗有效性下降或病毒改變致疾病嚴重度增加。因境外移入個案使病毒於美洲地區持續流行,疫苗覆蓋率持續偏低,導致易感人群增加,美洲地區公共衛生風險仍高。
WORRDks7gxZS4JzQn7cEIQ.en: WHO has published an update on the US outbreak. As of 20 March this year, 378 cases and 2 deaths have been reported from 17 states. About 90% of cases are linked to the three outbreaks reported this year, concentrated in Texas (259 cases) and New Mexico (35 cases). Genetic sequence data show 19 D8 sequences in total. Some sequences in New Mexico and Kansas are identical to the Texas D8 genotype sequences, and 8 states have reported five different B3 genotype sequences. The source of the outbreak remains unknown. There is no evidence that vaccine effectiveness has declined or that the virus has changed in a way that increases disease severity. Because imported cases keep the virus circulating in the Americas and vaccination coverage remains low, the number of susceptible people is rising, and public health risk in the Americas remains high.

mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.zh: 越南3/21公布今年迄今共63省市報告4.2萬餘例疑病例,其中逾4,000例確診及5例死亡,以南部(54%)為多,次為中部(20%),多數病例為9個月至15歲以下孩童,占比超過70%,其中超過95%未接種疫苗。目前病例集中於都會地區,惟山區省分病例數呈增加趨勢,目前預期疫情將下降,惟全國各地仍將持續發生病例,尤其是山區及疫苗覆蓋率低之省分。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/25累計報告379例(德州327例/新墨西哥州43例/奧克拉荷馬州9例),其中42例住院,2例死亡,該國公布今年截至3/20已有18州報告378例,其中64例住院。 PAHO於3/24發布美洲地區風險評估,截至3/15共4國報告507例,分別為美國301例(含2例死亡)、加拿大173例、墨西哥22例及阿根廷11例,病例數較去年同期91例上升5.5倍。因病毒於該區持續流行,多數國家疫苗覆蓋率未達95%目標,且新冠疫情期間疫苗接種中斷,疫苗猶豫情形增加及弱勢族群醫療可近性有限等因素,評估整體風險為高,評估信心水準為高。 吉爾吉斯今年迄今報告4,055例,其中,8例兒童死亡,首都比斯凱克、北部楚河州與南部奧什州病例數大幅上升,超過95%病例未接種疫苗;該國去年報告1.4萬餘例及6例死亡,疫情上升主要為疫苗覆蓋率低所致,比斯凱克覆蓋率僅63%。
mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.en: Viet Nam announced on 21 March that 63 provinces and cities have reported over 42,000 suspected cases so far this year, of which over 4,000 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south (54%), followed by the central region (20%). Most cases are children aged from 9 months to under 15 years, accounting for over 70%, and over 95% were unvaccinated. Cases are currently concentrated in urban areas, but numbers are rising in mountainous provinces. Although the outbreak is expected to decline, cases will continue to occur across the country, especially in mountainous areas and provinces with low vaccination coverage. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 25 March, 379 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 327, New Mexico 43, Oklahoma 9), of which 42 were hospitalized and 2 died. The United States reported that as of 20 March, 378 cases had been reported from 18 states, of which 64 were hospitalized. PAHO issued a risk assessment for the Americas on 24 March. As of 15 March, 4 countries had reported 507 cases: the United States 301 (including 2 deaths), Canada 173, Mexico 22 and Argentina 11. This is 5.5 times the 91 cases reported in the same period last year. Because the virus continues to circulate in the region, most countries have not reached the 95% vaccination coverage target, vaccination was disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy has increased and access to healthcare for vulnerable groups is limited, the overall risk is assessed as high, with high confidence. Kyrgyzstan has reported 4,055 cases so far this year, including 8 child deaths. Case numbers have risen sharply in the capital Bishkek, northern Chuy Region and southern Osh Region, and over 95% of cases were unvaccinated. Kyrgyzstan reported over 14,000 cases and 6 deaths last year. The increase is mainly due to low vaccination coverage; coverage in Bishkek is only 63%.

ASO3PA8nPqCh_ukedr5v4w.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情: 本週無人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共16國於2024/9/12~2025/3/20間新增138起H5N1疫情,英國70起、波蘭15起、匈牙利13起、美國10起、德國8起、荷蘭6起、愛爾蘭/丹麥各3起、法國/多哥各2起、羅馬亞/聖赫勒拿島/保加利亞/芬蘭/奈及利亞/印度各1例。 祕魯/多哥於2025/2/20~2/25各新增1起H5(N untyped)疫情。 美國於2025/3/8新增1起H7N9疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告989(4)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,100例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第11週計443個採檢點提供檢測報告,7州12個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC更新H5N1流感調查資訊:  今年1月加州舊金山1例兒童感染病例檢出H5N1抗體,其密切接觸者皆未檢出,目前排除人際傳播可能。 俄亥俄州禽場工人其檢體定序結果顯示為2.4.4.4b(D1.3),該基因型與D1.1基因型均源於2022年進入北美之A3基因型與當地野鳥禽流感病毒重組演化而來,該基因型目前尚未發現對抗病毒藥物或現有候選疫苗病毒效力的突變。  美國FDA與各州政府合作檢驗經巴氏消毒乳製品之H5N1病毒汙染情形,目前初步結果皆為陰性,另與康乃爾大學合作研究發現未經巴氏消毒處理之起司病毒可存活達60日以上。 美國密西西比州於禽場檢出HPAI H7N9,為2017年以來首次於家禽中檢出,動植物衛生檢驗署(APHIS)表示北美地區LPAI H7病毒與此次HPAI密切相關,顯示病毒可能源於野鳥的LPAI病毒病原溢出突變為HPAI,鑑於野鳥禽流感病毒可能傳播至家禽,APHIS將加強監測LPAI H5及H7病毒。H7N9流感人類感染病例自2013年迄今報告1,568例,其中616例死亡(CFR: 39%)。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計969例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(備註:依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計47國家/地區通報1,226起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
ASO3PA8nPqCh_ukedr5v4w.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 16 countries reported 138 new H5N1 outbreaks between 12 September 2024 and 20 March 2025: the UK 70, Poland 15, Hungary 13, the USA 10, Germany 8, the Netherlands 6, Ireland and Denmark 3 each, France and Togo 2 each, and Romania, Saint Helena, Bulgaria, Finland, Nigeria and India 1 each. Peru and Togo each reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak between 20 and 25 February 2025. The USA reported one new H7N9 outbreak on 8 March 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 989 outbreaks cumulatively (4 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada and Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,100 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 11, 443 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 12 sites in 7 states. Other updates: US CDC has updated its H5N1 investigation information. In January, a child in San Francisco, California, was found to have H5N1 antibodies; none of the close contacts tested positive, so person-to-person transmission is currently ruled out. Sequencing of samples from a poultry worker in Ohio shows genotype 2.4.4.4b (D1.3). This genotype and D1.1 both arose from recombination between the A3 genotype that entered North America in 2022 and local wild bird avian influenza viruses. No mutations conferring resistance to antivirals or reduced effectiveness of existing candidate vaccine viruses have yet been found in this genotype. The US FDA, working with state governments, is testing pasteurized dairy products for H5N1 contamination; preliminary results are all negative. In collaboration with Cornell University, it found that cheese made from unpasteurized milk can keep the virus alive for more than 60 days. Mississippi detected HPAI H7N9 on a poultry farm, the first detection in poultry since 2017. APHIS said that LPAI H7 viruses in North America are closely related to this HPAI virus, suggesting that it may have originated from LPAI viruses in wild birds that spilled over and mutated into HPAI. Because wild bird avian influenza viruses can spread to poultry, APHIS will strengthen surveillance of LPAI H5 and H7 viruses. Since 2013, 1,568 human H7N9 infections have been reported, of which 616 were fatal (CFR: 39%). Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (969 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. (Note: following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases.) Avian and animal cases: 47 countries and territories have reported 1,226 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

fv-Mc-_b8e27JT5ZglOjPw.zh: 美國報告2014-2022年共累計6,618起食源性疾病事件,每年約有800起食源性事件,致約15,000人罹病、800人住院、20人死亡。分析其中2,677起疫情,以每三年為一期,比較第一期與第三期發現細菌性感染比例上升,病毒性感染比例下降。另每期均有約17%的疫情與自製食品相關,當局呼籲應落實食品加工時的溫度控制及適當烹調時間以確保食品安全。
fv-Mc-_b8e27JT5ZglOjPw.en: The US reported 6,618 cumulative foodborne disease outbreaks for 2014–2022. About 800 foodborne outbreaks occur each year, causing about 15,000 illnesses, 800 hospitalizations and 20 deaths. An analysis of 2,677 of these outbreaks, comparing three-year periods, found that the proportion of bacterial infections rose and the proportion of viral infections fell between the first and third periods. In each period, about 17% of outbreaks were linked to home-made food. Authorities urge strict temperature control during food processing and appropriate cooking times to ensure food safety.

4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.zh: 多國疫情持續:  韓國自去年12月迄今報告18例,其中13例為境外移入,病例皆來自越南;香港報告今年首例,為越南境外移入個案;日本第10週(3/6-12)新增12例,新增病例數為今年以來新高,累計報告22例,其中15例為境外移入,感染國家以越南(10例)為多,近期發現數例未有境外旅遊史個案,該國將於4月舉行大型博覽會,海外遊客眾多,呼籲加強相關防疫措施。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/18累計報告317例(德州279例/新墨西哥州38例),其中38例住院,2例死亡,另鄰近奧克拉荷馬州報告4例與此次疫情相關病例,該國今年截至3/13共15州報告301例,並於3/7發布麻疹疫情健康警示。 澳洲今年迄今報告29例,病例多來自維多利亞州及新南威爾斯州,兩州各報告13例,病例多為境外移入,感染國包含越南、印等國,該國2023-24年分別報告26及57例。
4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.en: Measles continues in several countries. South Korea has reported 18 cases since last December, 13 of them imported, all from Viet Nam. Hong Kong reported its first case this year, an imported case from Viet Nam. Japan added 12 cases in week 10 (6–12 March), the highest weekly number this year, bringing the cumulative total to 22, of which 15 were imported. Viet Nam is the most common source country, with 10 cases. Several recent cases had no overseas travel history. Japan will host a large expo in April with many overseas visitors, and authorities call for strengthened preventive measures. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 18 March, 317 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 279, New Mexico 38), of which 38 were hospitalized and 2 died. Neighbouring Oklahoma reported 4 cases related to this outbreak. As of 13 March, 15 states had reported 301 cases this year, and on 7 March the US issued a health alert on measles. Australia has reported 29 cases so far this year, mostly from Victoria and New South Wales, with 13 cases in each. Most cases are imported, from countries including Viet Nam and India. Australia reported 26 cases in 2023 and 57 in 2024.

rQvsM8rzUk_CVNXxyoL-QA.zh: 美國新墨西哥州今年報告首例,為聖塔菲郡65歲女性,病患因感染死亡,該州於1975年至2023年累計129例,致死率43%;另加州莫諾郡及華盛頓州惠特曼郡於2月下旬各報告1例死亡病例。該國病例多發生於西部各州。
rQvsM8rzUk_CVNXxyoL-QA.en: New Mexico has reported its first case of the year: a 65-year-old woman from Santa Fe County who died of the infection. From 1975 to 2023, the state recorded 129 cases cumulatively, with a case fatality rate of 43%. In addition, Mono County in California and Whitman County in Washington State each reported one death in late February. Most US cases occur in western states.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.zh: 全球疫情嚴峻:  非洲:今年迄今累計7國報告2.1萬餘例疑病例,其中確診3,600餘例及54例死亡,病例集中於摩洛哥,今年迄今報告超過2萬例及37例死亡。 歐洲:ECDC更新2025年1月麻疹資訊,17國報告1,033例,其中以羅馬亞663例為多,其次為義大利74例及西班牙70例,餘14國報告病例數為1-67例。歐盟多國仍持續發生疫情,去年病例數遽增,全年報告3.2萬餘例,其中19例死亡,ECDC表示依據疾病季節模式,評估今年春季病例數將持續增加。因歐洲多數國家皆未達到完整接種之水準,呼籲各國應積極接種。荷蘭今年迄2月累計報告63例,多數病例為境外移入及其接觸者,境外移入病例多來自摩洛哥及羅馬亞。 亞洲:越南河內市近1週(2/28-3/7)新增120例,今年迄今累計報告745例,去年同期則無報告病例;日本第9週(2/27-3/5)新增4例,為今年以來新高,該國累計報告9例,多為境外移入,近期千葉縣及埼玉縣各報告1例自越南移入個案。 美洲:美國德州及新墨西哥州疫情持續,今年截至3/11累計報告256例(德州223例),其中30例住院,2例死亡;加州洛杉磯郡報告今年首例,病患具臺灣旅遊史,於3/5返國,目前相關單位調查中。美洲地區今年截至2/21,共4國報告268例,顯著高於去年同期之60例。
7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

Fh-HAoGfs7HdKEXpjpnkpQ.zh: 美國奧克拉荷馬州自去年10月以來,病例數持續上升,今年迄今累計報告77例,該州去(2024)年報告469例,2020年僅20例;賓州匹茲堡地區於去年報告338例,較2023年7例顯著上升;愛達荷州中部地區報告今年首例死亡病例,為成年個案,當地於2024年1月起迄今已報告574例,遠高於2022-23年之每年不到10例。
Fh-HAoGfs7HdKEXpjpnkpQ.en: In Oklahoma, case numbers have risen steadily since last October; 77 cases have been reported so far this year. The state reported 469 cases in 2024, compared with only 20 in 2020. The Pittsburgh area of Pennsylvania reported 338 cases last year, a marked rise from 7 in 2023. In central Idaho, the first death of the year was reported, in an adult. The area has reported 574 cases since January 2024, far above the fewer than 10 per year seen in 2022–23.

Tx0L-kcZBZ2PewUA_suUbw.zh: 越南河內市今年迄今累計報告625例,去年同期則無報告病例,該市疫情自年初迅速蔓延,多數病患未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,其中1歲以下幼兒病例持續增加,評估疫情將持續,尤其該地區近期連續降雨,增加傳播風險,當局已進行疫苗接種工作。 日本橫濱市於2/26-27新增2例,為20多歲女性及40多歲男性,2人分別自泰國及越南返國,個案無流行病學關聯;該國今年截至2/26累計報告6例,其中1例本土病例,5例為境外移入,多來自越南。 美國德州疫情更新,截至3/4,累計報告159例,其中22例住院,1例死亡;鄰近新墨西哥州利郡累計報告9例。該國今年截至2/27報告3起疫情,共9州報告164例,其中32例住院,多數病例未接種疫苗。
Tx0L-kcZBZ2PewUA_suUbw.en: Hanoi, Viet Nam, has reported 625 cumulative cases so far this year, with no cases reported in the same period last year. The outbreak in the city has spread rapidly since the start of the year. Most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated, and cases among children under one year old continue to rise. Authorities expect the outbreak to continue, especially as recent continuous rain in the area increases transmission risk. Vaccination work is under way. In Yokohama City, Japan, 2 cases were added on 26–27 February: a woman in her 20s and a man in his 40s, who had returned from Thailand and Viet Nam respectively, with no epidemiological link between them. Japan has reported 6 cases this year as of 26 February, 1 of them locally acquired and 5 imported, mostly from Viet Nam. In Texas, USA, as of 4 March, 159 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 22 were hospitalized and 1 died. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. The United States reported 3 outbreaks this year as of 27 February, with 164 cases in 9 states, of which 32 were hospitalized; most cases were unvaccinated.

rcZCK6bwb5uSjk1_HB2O3g.zh: 美國德州報告1例未接種疫苗的兒童死亡病例,病患於2/25晚間住院後死亡,為該國2015年以來首例。自1月下旬爆發疫情以來,共9郡報告124例,其中18例住院,多數病例為兒童,為該州近30年以來最大的疫情。
rcZCK6bwb5uSjk1_HB2O3g.en: Texas has reported the death of an unvaccinated child, who died after being admitted to hospital on the evening of 25 February. This is the first measles death in the United States since 2015. Since the outbreak began in late January, 124 cases have been reported across 9 counties, of which 18 were hospitalized. Most cases are children, and this is the largest outbreak in the state in nearly 30 years.

gYPIZchdh6adZRMNWcJmMQ.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:美國/柬埔寨於本週各新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共15國於2024/11/9~2025/2/27間新增166起H5N1疫情,分別為美國93起、德國15起、荷蘭14起、波蘭11起、韓國9起、匈牙利7起、捷克6起、丹麥3起、比利時2起、墨西哥/義大利/瑞典/柬埔寨/保加利亞/加拿大各1起。 澳大利亞於2025/02/22新增1起H7N8疫情。 秘魯於2025/1/16-2/13新增12起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告976(3)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,900例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。C 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第8週計389個採檢點提供檢測報告,4州10個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國更新近期3例H5N1流感人類感染病例資訊,內華達州乳牛場工人僅出現結膜炎症狀,目前已康復;俄亥俄州禽場工作人員曾參與禽流感禽場撲殺作業,而懷俄明州病患為接觸家中病死家禽,2名病患皆曾因病情嚴重住院治療,目前皆已出院。內華達州及懷俄明州病患檢體經基因檢測皆為2.3.4.4b(基因型D1.1),該基因型已於野鳥及家禽廣泛傳播,近期於內華達州及亞利桑那州乳牛中檢出,2名病患檢體皆發現於PB2蛋白中發生突變,該突變與病毒於哺乳動物細胞中有效複製相關;CDC表示目前尚未發現會影響抗病毒藥物及H5候選疫苗有效性之基因變化。 加拿大食品檢驗局(CFIA)於2月發布研究報告,去(2024)年10月於卑詩省8個禽場發現對奧司他韋(Tamiflu)具抗藥性之H5N1禽流感變異株,該變異株於NA蛋白帶有H275Y突變,該突變於2.3.4.4b分支中極為罕見;研究團隊表示病毒可能於去年9月底出現於該國,美國農業部(USDA)已將病毒指定為基因型D1.1。現有證據顯示突變可能降低病毒適應性,惟該病毒仍於15天內迅速傳播至8個禽場,研究團隊建議可能需重新評估流感治療策略。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計914例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計44國家/地區通報907起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
gYPIZchdh6adZRMNWcJmMQ.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: the USA and Cambodia each reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 15 countries reported 166 new H5N1 outbreaks between 9 November 2024 and 27 February 2025: the USA 93, Germany 15, the Netherlands 14, Poland 11, South Korea 9, Hungary 7, Czechia 6, Denmark 3, Belgium 2, and Mexico, Italy, Sweden, Cambodia, Bulgaria and Canada 1 each. Australia reported one new H7N8 outbreak on 22 February 2025. Peru reported 12 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 January and 13 February 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 976 outbreaks cumulatively (3 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada and Arizona. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,900 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 8, 389 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 10 sites in 4 states. Other updates: the US has updated information on three recent human H5N1 infections. A dairy farm worker in Nevada had only conjunctivitis and has recovered. A worker at an Ohio poultry farm had taken part in culling operations at an avian influenza farm, and a patient in Wyoming had been exposed to poultry that died at home. Both of the latter patients were hospitalized with serious illness and have since been discharged. Specimens from the Nevada and Wyoming patients were genotyped as clade 2.3.4.4b (genotype D1.1), a genotype that has spread widely among wild birds and poultry and was recently detected in dairy cattle in Nevada and Arizona. Both patients' specimens showed a mutation in the PB2 protein associated with efficient replication in mammalian cells. The CDC says it has not yet found genetic changes affecting the effectiveness of antivirals or H5 candidate vaccines. Canada's Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) published a research report in February: in October last year, an H5N1 avian influenza variant resistant to oseltamivir (Tamiflu) was found on 8 poultry farms in British Columbia. The variant carries the H275Y mutation in the NA protein, which is very rare in clade 2.3.4.4b. The research team said the virus may have appeared in the country in late September last year. The USDA has designated the virus as genotype D1.1. Current evidence suggests the mutation may reduce viral fitness, yet the virus still spread rapidly to 8 poultry farms within 15 days. The research team recommends that influenza treatment strategies may need to be reassessed. Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (914 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 44 countries and territories have reported 907 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

z7UFQ_w1WyP7B04paDqCjw.zh: 美國德州疫情持續擴大,截至2/25共9郡報告124例,其中18例住院,多數病例均未接種疫苗或接種情形不明,目前以蓋恩斯郡80例為多,另鄰近該郡的新墨西哥州利郡(Lea County)累計報告9例。 加拿大東南部疫情高於往年,安大略省今年累計報告57例確診及6例疑病例,魁北克省自去年12月以來迄今累計報告27例,該國新布藍茲維省自去年10月以來爆發疫情,此波疫情影響周邊地區迄今,該國近10年年度病例數介於0至418例間,歷史最高為2011年之751例,今年截至2月中旬已累計70例以上。 英國英蘭今年迄今報告91例確診,病例多分布於約克郡、亨伯郡及西南地區。2024年英蘭報告超過2,900例,為2012年以來新高,伯明罕及倫敦於去年爆發大規模疫情,其他地區亦有小型群聚事件,疫情於去年7月後漸趨緩,惟部分地區持續有小規模疫情;另蘇蘭今年截至2/19累計報告17例,該地於2023-24年全年分別報告1例及24例。
z7UFQ_w1WyP7B04paDqCjw.en: Texas, USA: the outbreak continues to expand. As of 25 February, 124 cases had been reported in 9 counties, of which 18 were hospitalized. Most patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Gaines County currently has the most cases, with 80. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. Canada: southeastern Canada has more cases than usual. Ontario has reported 57 confirmed and 6 suspected cases cumulatively this year, and Quebec has reported 27 cases cumulatively since December last year. New Brunswick has had an outbreak since October last year, which has affected surrounding areas to date. Canada's annual case numbers over the past decade have ranged from 0 to 418; the historical high was 751 in 2011, and more than 70 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of mid-February. England, UK: 91 confirmed cases have been reported this year, mainly in Yorkshire and the Humber and the South West. England reported over 2,900 cases in 2024, the highest since 2012. Large outbreaks occurred in Birmingham and London last year, with small clusters elsewhere. The outbreak has eased since July last year, although small-scale outbreaks continue in some areas. Scotland has reported 17 cases this year as of 19 February; it reported 1 case in 2023 and 24 in 2024.

XRwu0zm_hAfWaGurw4BuiQ.zh: 美國於去年11/25接獲通報疫情,回溯自2018年截至今年2/24已累計21州38例病例、其中12例死亡,多為醫療或長照機構住民(34例),年齡分布為43-101歲,感染源與機構提供的冷凍補充奶昔相關,多提供予軟食需求者,當局於該產品工廠環境採檢樣本,其反應為陽性,已於22日召回其產品,並呼應民眾切勿食用。
XRwu0zm_hAfWaGurw4BuiQ.en: The US received a report of an outbreak on 25 November last year. Retrospectively from 2018 to 24 February this year, 38 cases have been reported cumulatively in 21 states, of which 12 died. Most cases (34) were residents of healthcare or long-term care facilities. Ages ranged from 43 to 101. The source was linked to frozen supplementary milkshakes provided by facilities, which are mostly given to people who need soft foods. Environmental samples taken at the product's manufacturing plant tested positive. The product was recalled on 22 February, and the public was urged not to eat it.

aQWl2exshRw8TdEyBtDoEg.zh: 美國CDC公布懷俄明州首例H5N1確診(前已掌握),該國去年迄今累計報告69例,其中1例死亡,CDC評估對公共衛生風險為低。
aQWl2exshRw8TdEyBtDoEg.en: The US CDC announced Wyoming's first confirmed H5N1 case (already known). The country has reported 69 cases cumulatively since last year, including 1 death. The CDC assesses the public health risk as low.

CF_wJ6E_niOIMX7PoMJ9Lw.zh: 美國德州疫情更新,今年截至2/14累計報告48例,其中13例住院,所有病例均未接種疫苗或接種情形不明,目前以蓋恩斯郡42例為多,另鄰近該郡的新墨西哥州利郡(Lea County)報告3例,惟關聯性尚待釐清。
CF_wJ6E_niOIMX7PoMJ9Lw.en: Texas update: as of 14 February this year, 48 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 13 were hospitalized. All cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Gaines County has the most cases, with 42. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 3 cases; the link between the two outbreaks is yet to be clarified.

Xaz6UYKjN8EsdLeUM7gG8w.zh: 美國流感活動於第6週(2/2-2/8)接近本流感季高峰,住院及死亡數皆上升,為2017-18年流感季以來,CDC首次將所有年齡層皆提升為最嚴重程度,其中,以24歲(含)以下族群最為嚴重。近2週住院數達2010-11年流感季以來最高,近一週死亡人數中,因流感死亡占比為2.6%,高於新冠的1.5%;第6週新增11例兒童因流感死亡報告,本流感季迄今累計68例。類流感門診就診率已連續11週高於閾,該國共計46個州之流感活動度為高及非常高。 泰國衛生部報告今年迄今已累計報告超過9.9萬例,其中9例死亡,病例數高於過去5年中位數,其中以該國東北部地區疫情最為嚴峻,當局呼籲高風險民眾儘速接種疫苗。
Xaz6UYKjN8EsdLeUM7gG8w.en: US influenza activity approached this season's peak in week 6 (2–8 February), with both hospitalizations and deaths rising. For the first time since the 2017–18 season, the CDC has raised the severity level for all age groups, with those aged 24 and under most severely affected. Hospitalizations over the past two weeks reached their highest level since the 2010–11 season. Among deaths reported in the past week, the share attributed to influenza was 2.6%, higher than the 1.5% attributed to COVID-19. In week 6, 11 new paediatric influenza deaths were reported, bringing the season's total to 68. Influenza-like illness outpatient visit rates have been above the threshold for 11 consecutive weeks. Influenza activity is high or very high in 46 states. Thailand's Ministry of Public Health reported over 99,000 cases so far this year, including 9 deaths; case numbers are above the five-year median. The outbreak is most severe in the northeast, and authorities urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

nUHEhyX9jvXXqfbiEX9_Sg.zh: 美國CDC公布荷美郵輪鹿特丹號(Rotterdam)腹瀉群聚事件,航程介於2/2-14,全船3,583人,其中119人(含12名船員)出現嘔吐及腹瀉症狀。 韓國公布今年第4週單週報告病例數469例病例,為近10年最高,逾半數為0-6歲嬰幼兒(51.4%),7-18歲族群佔2成,自去年第43週開始迄今,GII.17型之檢出率最高,而自今年1月起,GII.4型的檢出率也呈上升趨勢。
nUHEhyX9jvXXqfbiEX9_Sg.en: The US CDC reported a diarrhoea outbreak on the Holland America Line cruise ship Rotterdam, sailing from 2 to 14 February. A total of 3,583 people were on board, and 119 people, including 12 crew members, developed vomiting and diarrhoea. South Korea reported 469 cases in week 4 of this year, the highest weekly figure in 10 years. Over half were infants and young children aged 0–6 (51.4%), and 20% were aged 7–18. From week 43 of last year to date, genotype GII.17 has had the highest detection rate, and since January this year the detection rate of GII.4 has also been rising.

YGA5OaFmhP2e7DmGzM6TwA.zh: 美國紐約州2/12新增該州首例及該國第4例Ib型病例,具非洲旅遊史,刻正隔離治療中,與前3例病例為獨立事件,迄未於社區中發現其他感染者,當局評估一般大眾傳播風險仍為低,MSM族群為低至中,呼籲民眾及醫護人員對於相關症狀應有警覺性。
YGA5OaFmhP2e7DmGzM6TwA.en: New York State reported on 12 February its first clade Ib case, which is also the country's fourth clade Ib case. The patient has an African travel history and is isolated for treatment. This case is independent of the first three cases, and no other infected persons have been found in the community. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low, and low to moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM). The public and healthcare workers are urged to be alert to relevant symptoms.

G3v8_rRHemtXNeSMgyoeFA.zh: 美國德州西部蓋恩斯郡(Gaines County)爆發疫情,累計報告24例,其中9例住院,多數病例為學齡兒童,此波疫情可能與當地學校群聚相關,目前仍調查中。另該郡因某些因素,兒童接種率較低,且當地有許多自學學童,實際未接種數可能更高,當局已推動疫苗接種活動。 越南於去年報告45,550例疑病例,其中超過7,500例確診及16例死亡,約25%確診病例為9個月以下嬰幼兒,WHO已將該國疫情風險評估為非常高,該國已展開全國疫苗接種活動。 韓國濟州島報告5年來首例病例,病患於1/22入境該國前具越南旅遊史,目前相關接觸者無症狀,該國今年累計報告3例,皆為境外移入。
G3v8_rRHemtXNeSMgyoeFA.en: Gaines County in West Texas, USA, has an outbreak with 24 cumulative cases, of which 9 were hospitalized. Most patients are school-age children. The outbreak may be linked to school clusters locally, and the investigation is ongoing. Child vaccination coverage in the county is low for several reasons, and there are many homeschooled children, so the actual number of unvaccinated children may be higher. Authorities have promoted vaccination campaigns. Viet Nam reported 45,550 suspected cases last year, of which over 7,500 were confirmed and 16 died. About 25% of confirmed cases were infants under 9 months old. WHO has assessed the outbreak risk in Viet Nam as very high, and the country has launched a nationwide vaccination campaign. South Korea's Jeju Island reported its first case in five years. The patient had a travel history to Viet Nam before entering South Korea on 22 January. Contacts are currently asymptomatic. South Korea has reported 3 cases this year, all imported.

sIFMHubafwwqLRSeLdZ05A.zh: 美國內華達州邱吉爾郡(Churchill County)報告該州首例H5N1人類感染病例,病患為乳牛場工人,曾接觸受感染乳牛,患者出現結膜炎症狀,未通報其他症狀,目前恢復狀況良好。該國自去年迄今累計68例H5N1人類感染病例,其中41例與乳牛相關。該地區近期報告乳牛感染D1.1基因型,現有資訊顯示該基因型感染人類可能有較嚴重症狀。
sIFMHubafwwqLRSeLdZ05A.en: Churchill County in Nevada has reported the state's first human H5N1 infection: a dairy farm worker who had been exposed to infected dairy cattle. The patient developed conjunctivitis and reported no other symptoms, and is recovering well. Since last year, the country has reported 68 cumulative human H5N1 infections, 41 of them linked to dairy cattle. The area has recently reported cattle infections with the D1.1 genotype, and current information suggests that human infection with this genotype may cause more severe symptoms.

SUbzF8aWQXSkpTUfB8dfFg.zh: 美國分別於1及2月新增報告第2、3例I型病例,案2位於喬治亞州,案3為新罕布夏州,皆自疫區返國後就診確認感染,此2例並無關聯,當局已展開疫調,並建議高風險者接受疫苗,評估一般民眾風險仍為低,有高風險性行為者風險為低至中。 香港報告新增1例病例,37歲男子患有慢性病且有高風險暴露,1/28出現症狀,並於2/4就診,刻正接受隔離,感染源仍在調查中。 UNICEF公布剛果民主共和國於2024年累計64,173例疑病例、14,053例確診、1,341例死亡(CFR:2.08%),自2024年10月中旬通報病例數有下降趨勢,惟確診數仍在波動中,12月單週平均通報病例數降至2,500例以下,顯著下降。各年齡層病例數分布因省份而異,其中,金夏沙省20歲以上的族群最為嚴重,南基伍/北基伍省逾50%病例數為10歲以下族群。UNICEF已於赤道/北基伍/南基伍省等6省展開第2次疫苗接種活動。
SUbzF8aWQXSkpTUfB8dfFg.en: The US reported its second and third clade I cases in January and February respectively. Case 2 was in Georgia and case 3 in New Hampshire, and both were confirmed after returning from affected areas; the two cases are not linked. Authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation and recommend vaccination for high-risk people. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, and low to moderate for people with high-risk sexual behaviour. Hong Kong reported one new case, a 37-year-old man with a chronic illness and high-risk exposure. He developed symptoms on 28 January, sought care on 4 February, and is in isolation; the source of infection is still under investigation. UNICEF reported that the Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded 64,173 suspected cases, 14,053 confirmed cases and 1,341 deaths in 2024 (CFR: 2.08%). Reported cases have trended downward since mid-October 2024, although confirmed numbers are still fluctuating, and weekly average reports fell below 2,500 in December. Age distribution varies by province: in Kinshasa, people aged over 20 are most affected, while in South Kivu and North Kivu more than 50% of cases are under 10. UNICEF has launched a second round of vaccination in six provinces, including Équateur, North Kivu and South Kivu.

kd9sz7ooUAkwJSXynUM1kw.zh: 美國佛羅里達州去年全年累計83例病例、18例死亡,超越2022年之74例病例、17例死亡紀錄,兩次皆因颶風侵襲造成感染人數上升。
kd9sz7ooUAkwJSXynUM1kw.en: Florida, United States, reported 83 cases and 18 deaths for the whole of 2024, surpassing the 74 cases and 17 deaths recorded in 2022. Infections rose in both years because of hurricanes.

fI39vUFjANwTw1aqQQ3JvQ.zh: 美國堪薩斯州於去年報告79例活動性病例(2例死亡),其中,堪薩斯城自去年初迄今報告67例病例,大多數病例分布於懷恩多特郡;阿拉斯加州發生率於去年亦上升,為每10萬人12.8例,高於2023年10.5例,為近30年來第3高,該州發生率亦明顯高於全國(約2.9例)。該國結核病疫情於近年呈上升趨勢,2023年報告9,600餘例,為2013年以來最高。
fI39vUFjANwTw1aqQQ3JvQ.en: Kansas, United States, reported 79 active tuberculosis cases (2 deaths) last year. Kansas City reported 67 cases from the beginning of last year to date, with most cases in Wyandotte County. Alaska's incidence also rose last year, to 12.8 per 100,000 population, up from 10.5 in 2023; this is the third highest in nearly 30 years and is markedly higher than the national rate (about 2.9). Tuberculosis has been rising in the country in recent years, with over 9,600 cases reported in 2023, the highest since 2013.

Mck9OPdi7gxOWwoEzOgO2g.zh: 美國內華達州於去(2024)年累計27例病例,較往年劇幅增加,最後兩季之病例數達24例,尤其於12月爆發疫情,其中街友佔71.4%,因有症狀者才會就醫,故可能低估病例數,當局已於收容機構進行感染管控並加強衛教。
Mck9OPdi7gxOWwoEzOgO2g.en: Nevada, United States, reported 27 cases last year (2024), a considerable increase over previous years. Cases in the last two quarters totalled 24, with an outbreak in December in particular; homeless people accounted for 71.4% of cases. Because only people with symptoms seek medical care, the number of cases may be underestimated. Authorities have implemented infection control measures in shelters and strengthened health education.

YLdaOLAH8kkeOVKOhabYYA.zh: 日本第2週(1/6-1/12)累計報告17.2萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數35.02例,全國超過警報標準,近期已出現醫療量能不足之情形。 美國類流感門診就診率由6.1%下降至5.4%,第2週(1/5-1/11)流感陽性率為18.8%,較前1週18.6%略升,惟死亡數上升,美國CDC表示本週較上週相關指標持平或下降可能受假期影響,評估疫情尚未達到高峰,未來數週疫情可能加劇。
YLdaOLAH8kkeOVKOhabYYA.en: Japan: In week 2 (6–12 January), 172,000+ cases were reported cumulatively, with an average of 35.02 cases per sentinel clinic, exceeding the national alert standard; medical capacity has recently become insufficient in some areas. United States: The influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate fell from 6.1% to 5.4%. Influenza test positivity in week 2 (5–11 January) was 18.8%, slightly up from 18.6% the previous week, while deaths rose. The US CDC said that this week's indicators were flat or lower than the previous week, which may be affected by holidays. It assessed that the outbreak has not yet reached its peak and may intensify over the coming weeks.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

Rmpc9LCyvw2hrMI6llvYdA.zh: 美國舊金山於1/10報告1例疑H5N1流感人類感染病例,病患為兒童,出現發燒及結膜炎症狀,症狀輕微,現已康復;當地衛生單位檢出A型流感陽性,將由CDC進行後續檢驗。當局表示目前病毒仍未具人際間之傳播能力,對一般民眾風險為低,呼籲民眾避免接觸生病及死亡禽鳥,並避免食用未經消毒之乳製品。美國舊金山於1/10報告1例疑H5N1流感人類感染病例,病患為兒童,出現發燒及結膜炎症狀,症狀輕微,現已康復;當地衛生單位檢出A型流感陽性,將由CDC進行後續檢驗。當局表示目前病毒仍未具人際間之傳播能力,對一般民眾風險為低,呼籲民眾避免接觸生病及死亡禽鳥,並避免食用未經消毒之乳製品。
Rmpc9LCyvw2hrMI6llvYdA.en: On 10 January, San Francisco, United States, reported one suspected human H5N1 influenza infection in a child, who presented with fever and conjunctivitis with mild symptoms and has recovered. The local health unit detected influenza A positivity, and the CDC will carry out follow-up testing. Authorities state that the virus does not yet have human-to-human transmission capability and that the risk to the general public is low. They urge people to avoid contact with sick and dead birds and to avoid consuming unpasteurised dairy products.

dheCPiAhVSnMqj0tfFIhFA.zh: 美國類流感門診就診率由4.9%上升至6.8%,第52週(12/22-12/28)流感陽性率為18.7%,較前1週12.0%上升,其中,全國有42州疫情處高點,各年齡層之流感住院數皆呈上升趨勢。
dheCPiAhVSnMqj0tfFIhFA.en: In the United States, the influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate rose from 4.9% to 6.8%. Influenza test positivity in week 52 (22–28 December) was 18.7%, up from 12.0% the previous week. Forty-two states are at high levels of activity, and influenza hospitalisations are rising in all age groups.

sBTcz4Ey3gz9qRV6oBxdMA.zh: 美國路易斯安那州1/6公布先前報告之H5N1病例死亡,病患65歲以上(原僅公布為18歲以上),具慢性病史,迄無相關接觸者發病;本案為該國首例H5N1感染死亡案例。
sBTcz4Ey3gz9qRV6oBxdMA.en: On 6 January, Louisiana State, United States, announced that a previously reported H5N1 case had died. The patient was aged 65 or older (previously announced only as 18 or older) and had a history of chronic disease; no related contacts have fallen ill. This is the first H5N1 infection death in the country.

dV2lT3VKHWOpflY3JOPkhQ.zh: 美國佛羅里達州於 2024 年病例數達自 2015 年來最高,截至 12/13 累計報告 83 例,其中 17 例死亡,病例數為去年 1.8 倍,該州於 9 月下旬受海倫颶風影響,病例數顯著上升。
dV2lT3VKHWOpflY3JOPkhQ.en: Florida, United States, reached its highest number of cases since 2015 in 2024: as of 13 December, 83 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths, 1.8 times last year's count. In late September the state was affected by Hurricane Helene, and case numbers rose significantly.

FJJs2g1a6Ba9pKBK5RVO-g.zh: 美國 2024 年諾羅病毒疫情高於往年同期,11/29-12/5 單週新增 91 起諾羅群聚事件,另實驗室監測資料顯示 12/15-12/21 當週陽性率為 22%,為 2018 年以來新高。另該國郵輪群聚事件於 2024 年全年達 16 起,為 2012 年以來新高,案件多為諾羅病毒所引起。
FJJs2g1a6Ba9pKBK5RVO-g.en: US norovirus activity in 2024 was higher than in the same period of previous years: in the single week of 29 November–5 December, 91 norovirus cluster events were newly reported. Laboratory surveillance data show that the positivity rate for the week of 15–21 December was 22%, the highest since 2018. The country recorded 16 cruise ship cluster events in 2024 as a whole, the highest since 2012, and most were caused by norovirus.

G1sgfVTzvfOWWQhMzwF1vA.zh: 香港12/13新增報告1例病例,為63歲具慢性病史男性,居住於深水埗,11/30發病,12/4死亡,感染源仍在調查中;當地今年累計報告23例病例,較去年17例為高。 美國波多黎各今年7至11月間新增報告6例病例,其中4例死亡,死者均為60歲以上老年族群,當局表示近幾月持續發生大雨及淹水,可能為疫情上升主因。 泰國今年截至12月中旬累計75省報告3,935例病例,其中127例死亡,病患多為男性,年齡層以65歲以上族群最多。
G1sgfVTzvfOWWQhMzwF1vA.en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 13 December: a 63-year-old man with a chronic illness, living in Sham Shui Po, who developed symptoms on 30 November and died on 4 December. The source of infection is still under investigation. Hong Kong has reported 23 cases cumulatively in 2024, higher than the 17 cases in 2023. In the United States, Puerto Rico reported six new cases between July and November 2024, four of which were fatal, all in people over 60; authorities say that heavy rain and flooding over recent months are the main reason for the rise. Thailand reported 3,935 cases cumulatively in 2024 up to mid-December across 75 provinces, with 127 deaths; patients are mostly male, and the largest age group is those aged 65 and over.

XBGABtUyVqa9ScuqaMINdA.zh: 美國12/26公布路易斯安那州病例病毒基因測序結果,該病毒仍屬禽類病毒,與該州鳥類D1.1疫情之病毒相關,亦與現行HPAI A(H5N1) CVV相關,因出現NP A134V、N182K及E186D變異,導致與人類上呼吸道受體結合力增加,尚未發現與已知或疑抗病毒藥物敏感性降低的突變有關。 美國加州洛杉磯郡、聖塔芭芭拉郡及奧勒岡州陸續報告家貓感染禽流感死亡案例,受感染貓隻多出現神經系統或呼吸窘迫症狀,當局研判係因食用受汙染禽肉或生乳感染,該受汙染寵物食品之公司已宣布召回商品。
XBGABtUyVqa9ScuqaMINdA.en: On 26 December, the United States released gene sequencing results for the Louisiana case. The virus is still an avian virus and is related both to the D1.1 virus causing bird outbreaks in that state and to the current HPAI A(H5N1) candidate vaccine virus (CVV). Because of the NP A134V, N182K and E186D mutations, its binding to human upper-respiratory receptors has increased. No mutations associated with reduced susceptibility to known or suspected antiviral drugs have been found. Domestic cats in Los Angeles County, Santa Barbara County in California, and Oregon State have successively reported fatal avian influenza cases in cats; infected cats mostly showed neurological or respiratory distress symptoms. Authorities believe the infection came from eating contaminated poultry meat or raw milk, and the company that produced the contaminated pet food has announced a product recall.

SWU-KfeEBX0yY6eNv62fLA.zh: 美國12/23公布愛荷華州新增1例禽場相關H5病例,已知為輕症,其他流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布65例病例,其中39例與乳牛場相關,23例與禽場相關,1例具動物暴露史,2例不明,分布於10州,以加州(36)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)最多。
SWU-KfeEBX0yY6eNv62fLA.en: On 23 December, the United States announced one new H5 case linked to a poultry farm in Iowa State; the case is known to be mild, and other epidemiological information was not specified. In total in 2024, the United States has announced 65 cases: 39 linked to dairy farms, 23 to poultry farms, 1 with animal exposure and 2 unknown, spread across 10 states, with the most in California (36), Washington (11) and Colorado (10).

fEj5F3cYxItDp5zKbFdDzA.zh: 美國12/20公布加州新增2例乳牛場相關、威斯康辛州新增1例禽場相關病例,其他流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布64例病例,其中39例與乳牛業相關,22例與家禽養殖業相關,1例具動物暴露史,2例不明,分布於加州(36)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、奧勒岡州、德州、密蘇里州、路易斯安那州及威斯康辛州(各1)。 美國加州洛杉磯郡12/18表示,除先前2起家貓感染H5禽流感案例外,又新增3件來自不同家庭案之家貓疑案例,感染源推測為生乳或生肉,相關接觸者已匡列追蹤並預先投藥;該國自2022年迄今已報告56例家貓感染H5N1案例。 美國自10月底起每週廢水檢測之陽性站點數量持續上升,自10月底之14站上升至12月初之60站,其中佛羅里達州、德拉瓦州、緬因州和紐澤西州廢水檢出陽性,惟未曾報告禽場或牛隻疫情。
fEj5F3cYxItDp5zKbFdDzA.en: On 20 December, the United States announced two new dairy-cattle-related cases in California and one poultry-related case in Wisconsin; other epidemiological information was not specified.
