This year the United States has cumulatively announced 64 cases: 39 linked to dairy cattle farming, 22 to poultry farming, 1 with animal exposure and 2 unknown, spread across California (36), Washington (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Oregon, Texas, Missouri, Louisiana and Wisconsin (1 each). On 18 December, Los Angeles County, California, reported that in addition to two earlier domestic cat H5 avian influenza cases, three new suspected cases had been identified in cats from different households. The likely source is raw milk or raw meat; close contacts have been traced and given preventive medication. The country has reported 56 H5N1 cases in domestic cats since 2022. Since late October, the number of wastewater sampling sites testing positive each week in the United States has continued to rise, from 14 at the end of October to 60 in early December. Wastewater in Florida, Delaware, Maine and New Jersey tested positive, but no poultry or cattle outbreaks have been reported in those states.

51WeH2Gtnqxm40E6DvjdVg.zh: 美國疫情更新:  路易斯安那州病例為美國首例重症病例,目前住院中,已知係因接觸後院家禽感染,病毒屬D1.1分支,當局表示整體風險不變,惟呼籲有飼養禽畜者、獵人或鳥類愛好者等,均應採取預防措施。 加州宣布,由於乳牛感染區域已自中央谷地區向外擴散至南加州,故自12/18起進入緊急狀態,以確保擁有快速應對疫情所需資源和靈活性,並以最大檢測和監測系統為基礎,保護公眾健康,支援農業,包括提供禽畜業者足夠防護設備,並確保民眾能夠獲得準確及最新的資訊。另評估對一般民眾風險仍然很低。
51WeH2Gtnqxm40E6DvjdVg.en: US epidemic update: The Louisiana case, the first severe case in the United States, is currently hospitalised; it is known to have been caused by contact with backyard poultry, and the virus belongs to clade D1.1. Authorities state that the overall risk is unchanged, but urge people who keep poultry or livestock, hunters and bird enthusiasts to take preventive measures. California announced that because the cattle infection has spread from the Central Valley to southern California, it entered a state of emergency from 18 December, to secure the resources and flexibility needed to respond rapidly. Based on maximum testing and surveillance, the state aims to protect public health and support agriculture, including providing adequate protective equipment to poultry and livestock producers and ensuring the public has access to accurate, up-to-date information. The risk to the general public is still assessed as very low.

UHxueEd_J7PxmgLXIFNcmw.zh: 美國12/17公布路易斯安納州新增1例病例,病患具患病動物接觸史,型別及其他流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布61例病例,其中37例與乳牛業相關,21例與家禽養殖業相關,1例具動物暴露史,2例不明,分布於加州(34)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、奧勒岡州、德州、密蘇里州及路易斯安那州(各1)。
UHxueEd_J7PxmgLXIFNcmw.en: On 17 December, the United States announced one new case in Louisiana State with exposure to sick animals; the type and other epidemiological information were not specified. This year the United States has cumulatively announced 61 cases: 37 linked to dairy cattle, 21 to poultry, 1 with animal exposure and 2 unknown, spread across California (34), Washington (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Oregon, Texas, Missouri and Louisiana (1 each).

nw5dG7u1G2Pto8TVVXKHiw.zh: 美國緬因州疫情更新,今年截至12/3累計報告3,035例病例,高於去年全年共2,943例,當局表示暖冬氣候造成病例數上升。
nw5dG7u1G2Pto8TVVXKHiw.en: Maine State, United States, has updated its epidemic information: as of 3 December this year, 3,035 cases had been reported cumulatively, higher than the 2,943 cases reported in the whole of last year. Authorities say that a warm winter climate has contributed to the increase in cases.

aYTVFezm8Q1htlvpY4IQ4A.zh: 美國佛州疫情更新,於12月第1週新增4例本土病例,今年迄今累計74例,主要分布於邁阿密-戴德郡,以第3型血清型為多;該國今年迄今累計90例本土病例。 古巴疫情正於13個省份迅速蔓延,大量患者住院治療,其中,已發現6例重症病例,同時,奧羅普切熱亦在該國15個省份流行,大多數病例皆居家治療,惟登革熱和奧羅普切熱的臨床表現非常相,致民眾誤解其感染之疾病,而衍生重症。
aYTVFezm8Q1htlvpY4IQ4A.en: Florida State, United States: In the first week of December, four new local cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total for 2024 to 74, mainly in Miami-Dade County, predominantly serotype 3. The country has reported 90 local cases cumulatively in 2024. Cuba: The outbreak is spreading rapidly across 13 provinces, with many patients hospitalised, and six severe cases have been identified. Oropouche fever is also circulating in 15 provinces of the country. Most of these cases are treated at home. However, the clinical presentations of dengue and Oropouche fever are very similar, which leads people to misidentify their infection and can result in severe illness.

uQPETe0qbQ7cxtFhJyTttA.zh: 美國12/13公布加州新增2例與牛隻相關病例,型別及流病相關資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布60例病例,其中37例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,2例不明,分布於加州(34)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。 美國路易斯安那州衛生部於12/13公告,發現該州首例H5N1人類(推定)個案,目前住院中,感染源為疑接觸感染之禽鳥。
uQPETe0qbQ7cxtFhJyTttA.en: On 13 December, the United States announced two new cattle-related cases in California; the type and other epidemiological information were not specified. This year the United States has cumulatively announced 60 cases: 37 linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 2 unknown, spread across California (34), Washington (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each). The Louisiana Department of Health announced on 13 December the state's first presumptive human H5N1 case; the patient is hospitalised, and the source of infection is suspected to be contact with infected birds.

RPMpS9LgK0G_ZVwvsad2zA.zh: 香港公布中國新增2例人類感染H9N2病例,為貴州省及廣西壯族自治區1歲女童,分別於10/28及11/18發病,其餘資訊不明,該國今年累計9省市報告17例H9N2病例*。*9省17例為本署監測資訊,與CIDRAP統計不同。 美國12/10公布加州兒童病例(11/22報告)之基因定序結果,因病毒量不足,目前僅知該病毒屬2.3.4.4b分支,基因片段與加州流行之B3.13分支相,且無其他具威脅性之位點變異,亦與加拿大病例之病毒無關,評估對一般民眾風險仍然維持為低。
RPMpS9LgK0G_ZVwvsad2zA.en:
Hong Kong authorities reported two new human H9N2 infections in mainland China, in two 1-year-old girls from Guizhou Province and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, with onset on 28 October and 18 November respectively. Other information is unavailable. China has reported 17 H9N2 cases from 9 provinces/municipalities this year.* *The 17 cases from 9 provinces are from Taiwan CDC surveillance information and differ from CIDRAP statistics.

On 10 December the United States released genetic sequencing results for a California child case (reported 22 November). Because the viral load was insufficient, it is currently only known that the virus belongs to clade 2.3.4.4b, that its gene segments are consistent with the B3.13 genotype circulating in California, and that there are no other threatening site mutations. It is also unrelated to the virus in the Canadian case. The risk assessment for the general public remains low.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.

RVTjRTBmdeFqI4LvoRSRBw.zh: 美國12/5公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關病例,型別及流病相關資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計公布58例病例,其中35例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,2例不明,分布於加州(32)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。 美國亞利桑那州12/6公布新增2例H5人類感染病例,皆曾於工作時接觸受感染家禽,症狀輕微且已康復,目前病毒尚無人際傳播能力,評估對一般民眾風險為低。
RVTjRTBmdeFqI4LvoRSRBw.en:
The United States announced on 5 December one new case in California linked to cattle; the subtype and epidemiological details were not stated. The country has announced 58 cases so far this year, of which 35 were linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 2 were unknown. Cases are distributed across California (32), Washington State (11), Colorado (10) and Michigan (2), and in Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each).

On 6 December, Arizona announced 2 new human H5 infections. All had been exposed to infected poultry at work. Symptoms were mild and they have recovered. The virus currently has no human-to-human transmission ability, and the risk to the general public is assessed as low.

7GH1Mv8iI8wddT98mFTlnQ.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,第47週單週新增破500例,明顯持續升高,該國今年截至11/23累計報告27,036例病例,為去年同期之4.8倍,其中以賓州、威斯康辛州、伊利諾州、加州及華盛頓州等地最為嚴峻。
7GH1Mv8iI8wddT98mFTlnQ.en: Pertussis continues to rise in the United States. Weekly new cases exceeded 500 in week 47, a clear and sustained increase. The country has reported 27,036 cases as of 23 November this year, 4.8 times the same period last year. The most severely affected areas include Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Illinois, California and Washington State.

6p-uy7JC3mA_JUGio5_8kw.zh: 美國加州佛雷斯諾郡11/27新增報告1例病例,為近30餘年來首例,病患10月中旬曾於美熹德郡經蝙蝠咬傷,並於11/22死亡,當局呼籲民眾避免接觸蝙蝠。 中國湖南省長沙縣11/18報告1例死亡病例,病患係經自養家犬咬傷感染,當局表示該省犬隻免疫接種率約30%,且抗體會隨時間下降,呼籲飼主確保寵物具足夠之抗體保護力。
6p-uy7JC3mA_JUGio5_8kw.en:
In Fresno County, California, a new case was reported on 27 November. It is the first case in more than 30 years. The patient had been bitten by a bat in Mariposa County in mid-October and died on 22 November. Authorities urge people to avoid contact with bats.

In Changsha County, Hunan Province, China, one death was reported on 18 November. The patient was infected through a bite from a dog raised at home. Authorities say the dog vaccination rate in the province is about 30%, and antibodies decline over time. They urge pet owners to ensure their pets have sufficient antibody protection.

NHUaw9IYspSHN5WwMc50vg.zh: 美國12/2公布加州新增2例與牛隻相關病例,型別及流病相關資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告57例病例,其中34例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,2例不明,分布於加州(31)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
NHUaw9IYspSHN5WwMc50vg.en: On 2 December the United States announced 2 new cases in California linked to cattle; the subtype and epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 57 cases so far this year, of which 34 were linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 2 were unknown. Cases are distributed across California (31), Washington State (11), Colorado (10) and Michigan (2), and in Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each).

UG46HStFncH5nvBtSzQCfw.zh: 美國加州於11/24、27分別宣布於零售生乳中檢出禽流感病毒,商品均來自同一廠商,當局已公布產品批號、要求廠商下架召回,並呼籲民眾立即將剩餘產品退回並避免食用。該國目前禁止跨州銷售未經消毒之生乳,惟多數州別之州內銷售仍屬合法。 美國目前H5N1 2.3.4.4b病毒之細分支流行情形如下:  A3:夏威夷州禽類疫情; B3.13:乳牛相關疫情、猶他州家禽疫情,乳牛相關人類疫情; D1.1:華盛頓州家/野禽、人類疫情(加拿大BC省人類疫情); D1.2:奧勒岡州家/野禽與豬隻疫情。

yQIwKbr0aJFOr2-VdomZjA.zh: 美國公布熟食店肉品疫情結束,截至11/19共19州報告61例,其中60例住院及10例死亡,並包含1名孕婦,此疫情實際病例數可能高於報告人數,經調查多數病患曾食用熟食肉品。 美國公布即食產品疫情更新,截至11/22共4州報告11例,其中1例死亡,病人樣本採集時間介於2021/10至2024/7間,經調查顯示感染源為某公司所生產之即食肉類產品。
yQIwKbr0aJFOr2-VdomZjA.en:
The United States announced the end of an outbreak linked to deli meat products. As of 19 November, 61 cases had been reported from 19 states, of whom 60 were hospitalized and 10 died, including 1 pregnant woman. The actual number of cases in this outbreak may be higher than the number reported. Investigations found that most patients had eaten deli meat products.

The United States also announced an update on an outbreak linked to ready-to-eat products. As of 22 November, 11 cases had been reported from 4 states, including 1 death. Patient specimens were collected between October 2021 and July 2024. Investigations showed that the source of infection was a ready-to-eat meat product produced by a company.

gvyQnRbqHO1vXGGzJyvdIQ.zh: 美國今年疫情上升,截至11/16累計報告22,244例,為去年同期之1.3倍,逾半數病例發生於亞利桑那州,該州今年疫情嚴峻,迄今累計報告12,522例,已高於過去6年之全年病例數。
gvyQnRbqHO1vXGGzJyvdIQ.en: Cases are rising in the United States this year. As of 16 November, 22,244 cases have been cumulatively reported, 1.3 times the same period last year. More than half of the cases occurred in Arizona, where the outbreak is severe this year. Arizona has cumulatively reported 12,522 cases to date, already exceeding its full-year case count for each of the past 6 years.

LePLGBRTZe3NzEMCxjV6zA.zh: 美國11/22公布加州新增1例H5N1兒童感染病例,症狀輕微,感染源調查中,並進行接觸者追蹤,評估病毒尚無人際傳播能力。
LePLGBRTZe3NzEMCxjV6zA.en: On 22 November the United States announced one new H5N1 infection in a child in California. Symptoms were mild, the source of infection is under investigation, and contacts are being traced. The virus is assessed as not yet capable of human-to-human transmission.

tpGe1ONN45k7jBbmeSRfIA.zh: 2024年第43週(10/28-11/3)全球陽性率約16.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(17.8%)、美洲區(12.6%)及非洲區(3.7%)為高。 美國近期處低點,近1週(11/3-11/9)陽性率3.6%,近期廢水樣本病毒量、陽性率、急診就診率及住院率持續下降,死亡數處低點,變異株以KP.3.1.1占比52%為多,其次為XEC變異株。 日本第46週(11/11-11/17)新增9,406例,病例數較前1週(11/4-11/10) 的7,246例上升,住院數亦較前1週增加,該國以KP.3.3及其衍生變異株為主流株。
tpGe1ONN45k7jBbmeSRfIA.en:
Situation update: In week 43 of 2024 (28 October–3 November), the global positivity rate was about 16.2%, highest in the European Region (17.8%), the Region of the Americas (12.6%) and the African Region (3.7%).

The United States is at low levels recently: positivity was 3.6% in the most recent week (3–9 November). Viral load in wastewater samples, positivity, emergency department visit rates and hospitalization rates have continued to decline, and deaths are at a low level. KP.3.1.1 accounts for the largest share of variants at 52%, followed by XEC variants.

Japan reported 9,406 new cases in week 46 (11–17 November), up from 7,246 in the previous week (4–10 November). Hospital admissions also rose compared with the previous week. KP.3.3 and its derived variants are the main circulating strains in the country.

zVqwO6ra7CzHBFH3jp6L3A.zh: 美國爆發大腸桿菌O121:H19疫情,截至11/17共18州累計報告39例,其中15例住院及1例死亡。發病日期介於9/6-10/28,多數病例於發病前曾食用胡蘿蔔,當局已召回疑受汙染之產品。 美國多地爆發O157疫情,明蘇達州自10/31以來報告10例,其中2例住院,發病日期介於11/4-11/9,多數病例曾食用漢堡及碎牛肉製品;密蘇里州聖路易郡報告至少97例,多數病例為某高中學生,感染源疑為學校活動提供之餐點。 愛爾蘭報告13例 O157:H7病例,無HUS病例及死亡病例;冰島報告23例,病例皆為某幼教機構學童;兩案感染源疑為食源性,惟感染源尚待調查。
zVqwO6ra7CzHBFH3jp6L3A.en:
The United States has an outbreak of E. coli O121:H19: as of 17 November, 39 cases had been reported from 18 states, of whom 15 were hospitalized and 1 died. Onset dates range from 6 September to 28 October. Most patients had eaten carrots before becoming ill, and authorities have recalled suspected contaminated products.

Multiple US locations have E. coli O157 outbreaks. Minnesota has reported 10 cases since 31 October, 2 of whom were hospitalized, with onset dates between 4 and 9 November; most patients had eaten hamburgers and ground beef products. St. Louis County, Missouri, has reported at least 97 cases; most are students at a high school, and the suspected source is meals provided at a school activity.

Ireland reported 13 E. coli O157:H7 cases, with no HUS or deaths. Iceland reported 23 cases, all among children at an early childhood education centre. In both cases the source is suspected to be foodborne, but the source is still under investigation.

o6BXgcX0MeSfMDRQgJ8jRQ.zh: 美國11/18公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關病例,型別及其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告53例病例,其中31例與牛隻相關,21例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(27)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2),奧勒岡州、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
o6BXgcX0MeSfMDRQgJ8jRQ.en: On 18 November the United States announced one new case in California linked to cattle; the subtype and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 53 cases so far this year, of which 31 were linked to cattle, 21 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (27), Washington State (11), Colorado (10) and Michigan (2), and in Oregon, Texas and Missouri (1 each).

8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.zh: 美國加州11/16報告首例第I型病例,病患具非洲旅遊史,目前於家中隔離,當局已追蹤相關接觸者,迄無持續傳播跡象。 非洲Ib型疫情持續,其中剛果民主共和國、蒲隆地原多係透過年輕人性接觸傳播,惟隨感染族群擴大,已轉為家庭及社區傳播,幼兒感染比例亦上升;烏干達近期疫情明顯上升,多係透過性接觸感染。 ACDC 11/6已與生技公司合作,啟動天花藥物 brincidofovir (TEMBEXA)用於治療M痘之相關試驗。
8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.en:
California, United States, reported its first clade I case on 16 November. The patient had travel history to Africa and is isolated at home. Authorities have traced related contacts, and there are no signs of ongoing transmission so far.

Clade Ib outbreaks continue in Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Burundi, transmission was originally mostly through sexual contact among young people; as the affected population has expanded, transmission has shifted to household and community spread, and the proportion of young children infected has also risen. In Uganda, the outbreak has risen markedly recently, with infection mostly through sexual contact.

Africa CDC, on 6 November, worked with a biotechnology company to launch trials of the smallpox drug brincidofovir (TEMBEXA) for treating Mpox.

O7uAafSTGChalBFqc04CiQ.zh: 美國大腸桿菌O157:H7疫情更新,截至11/13共14州累計報告104例,其中34例住院,4例HUS病例,1例死亡。目前調查顯示可能感染源為洋蔥,當局已召回可能受汙染之原料,評估對民眾健康風險為低。
O7uAafSTGChalBFqc04CiQ.en: United States update on E. coli O157:H7: As of 13 November, 104 cases have been cumulatively reported from 14 states, including 34 hospitalized, 4 HUS (haemolytic uraemic syndrome) cases and 1 death. Investigations currently indicate that the possible source is onions. Authorities have recalled raw materials that may be contaminated and assess the health risk to the public as low.

lZ9WaUXZ15Lwob0Kffvwkw.zh: 美國科羅拉多州圓石郡11/1新增報告1例病例,病患於10/2發病,出現發燒、精神狀態改變及肺積水等症狀,曾有犬貓接觸史,惟犬貓未有生病跡象,研判可能係經昆蟲叮咬感染;該國今年累計報告193例。
lZ9WaUXZ15Lwob0Kffvwkw.en: In Yuanshi County (圓石郡), Colorado, United States, 1 new case was reported on 1 November. The patient developed symptoms on 2 October, including fever, altered mental status and pulmonary oedema. The patient had contact with dogs and cats, but the animals showed no signs of illness, so infection is presumed to have been acquired through an insect bite. The country has reported 193 cases this year.

RnuveXmJ6TMV73DKP69FAg.zh: 美國11/6公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關之型別不明病例、華盛頓州新增1例與家禽相關之H5病例,其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告46例病例,其中25例與牛隻相關,20例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(21)、華盛頓州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。*先前管轄權不明案例已歸入華盛頓州。 美國奧勒岡州11/6公布再新增1件豬隻感染H5N1流感案例,為前案同農場豬隻,定序結果顯示感染病毒屬D1.2基因型,與該農場禽類疫情相同,並與該地區之候鳥樣本相。
RnuveXmJ6TMV73DKP69FAg.en:
On 6 November the United States announced one new California case linked to cattle, of unidentified type, and one new Washington State H5 case linked to poultry; other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 46 cases so far this year, of which 25 were linked to cattle, 20 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (21), Washington State (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each). *A previously unclear-jurisdiction case has been attributed to Washington State.

On 6 November, Oregon announced one additional H5N1 influenza case in a swine. It was from the same farm as the previous case; sequencing shows the virus belongs to genotype D1.2, the same as the poultry outbreaks on that farm, and it is related to migratory bird samples from the area.

Rxd5WcJBhWoNOOdxOVSlFA.zh: 美國疫情上升,第43週單週新增462例,明顯較前2週之246、348例為高,今年截至10/26累計報告20,824例病例,為去年同期之4.5倍,其中以賓州、威斯康辛州、伊利諾州、紐約州及加州等地最為嚴峻。 南太平洋法屬波里西亞疫情上升,10月下旬單週新增30餘例病例,自6月爆發疫情迄今累計報告191例,其中10例兒童住院治療;新喀里多亞今年截至10月中旬累計報告79例病例,其中44%為14歲以下兒童,分布以南部省佔近6成最多。 捷克疫情持續嚴峻,今年截至11/3累計報告34,423例病例,其中2.4%住院,12例死亡,以15至19歲年齡層發病率最高,分布以該國東北部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州4,125例最多。
Rxd5WcJBhWoNOOdxOVSlFA.en:
United States: Pertussis is rising. Weekly new cases reached 462 in week 43, clearly higher than the 246 and 348 in the previous two weeks. As of 26 October this year, 20,824 cases have been cumulatively reported, 4.5 times the same period last year. The most severely affected areas include Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Illinois, New York State and California.

French Polynesia in the South Pacific: Cases are rising. Weekly new cases exceeded 30 in late October. Since the outbreak began in June, 191 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 10 children hospitalized for treatment. New Caledonia: As of mid-October this year, 79 cases have been cumulatively reported, 44% of whom are children under 14. Cases are concentrated in the Southern Province, which accounts for nearly 60%.

Czechia: The outbreak remains severe. As of 3 November this year, 34,423 cases have been cumulatively reported, 2.4% of whom were hospitalized, with 12 deaths. The highest incidence is in the 15–19 age group. Most cases are in the Moravian-Silesian Region in the northeast, with 4,125 cases.

J46iQ4TxFR2xY3Q_JDjCsQ.zh: 美國10/31公布今年4至7月間新增4例病例,均為30至39歲男性,出現臉部、四肢及臀部皮疹,所有病患均曾與其他男性發生性接觸,其中2例彼此相關,鑑於症狀容易誤診,當局呼籲醫療人員提高警覺。鬚癬毛癬菌VII型為新型皮癬菌,多透過性接觸傳播。
J46iQ4TxFR2xY3Q_JDjCsQ.en: On 31 October the United States announced 4 new cases between April and July this year. All were men aged 30 to 39 with rashes on the face, limbs and buttocks. All patients had had sexual contact with other men, and 2 of the cases were linked to each other. Because the symptoms are easily misdiagnosed, authorities urge healthcare workers to remain alert. Trichophyton mentagrophytes genotype VII is an emerging dermatophyte, mostly transmitted through sexual contact.

KISKubBMJWJ0raiU0Wn3-Q.zh: 美國CDC 11/4公布加州新增3例與牛隻相關病例,型別及其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告44例病例,其中24例與牛隻相關,19例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(20)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(9)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1),另有1例管轄權待定。
KISKubBMJWJ0raiU0Wn3-Q.en: The US CDC announced on 4 November three new cattle-linked cases in California; the subtype and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 44 cases so far this year, of which 24 were linked to cattle, 19 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (20), Colorado (10), Washington State (9), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each); 1 case is pending jurisdiction.

Q08d50ft4ZMWNEm3ePPnjg.zh: 美國CDC 11/1公布加州新增1例與牛隻相關病例,另新增1例管轄權待定之家禽相關病例,型別及其餘流病資訊均未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告41例病例,其中21例與牛隻相關,19例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(17)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(9)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1),另有1例管轄權待定。 美國10/30公布首次於豬隻身上檢出H5N1病毒,案件發生於奧勒岡州一禽畜混合農場,其於10/25爆發H5N1禽類疫情,因農場牲畜與禽類共用生活空間,故擴大檢驗範圍,進而發現本案;該豬隻未進入食品供應鏈,當局已隔離該農場並加速基因定序,目前家禽之基因定序顯示病毒尚未發生基因變異。 10/28研究表示,美國德州H5N1人類感染案例雖症狀輕微,惟自其睛中分離出之病毒,除能於人類肺泡中有效複製,亦可於小鼠及雪貂全身中傳播,並具致命性。
Q08d50ft4ZMWNEm3ePPnjg.en:
On 1 November the US CDC announced one new cattle-linked case in California and one new poultry-linked case whose jurisdiction is pending; the subtype and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 41 cases so far this year, of which 21 were linked to cattle, 19 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (17), Colorado (10), Washington State (9), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each); 1 case is pending jurisdiction.

On 30 October the US announced the first detection of H5N1 virus in a pig, at a mixed poultry and livestock farm in Oregon. The farm had an H5N1 poultry outbreak on 25 October. Because livestock and poultry share living space, testing was expanded, which led to this detection. The pig did not enter the food supply chain. Authorities have quarantined the farm and accelerated genetic sequencing; sequencing of the poultry so far shows the virus has not undergone genetic changes.

A study reported on 28 October that although symptoms in the Texas US human H5N1 case were mild, the virus isolated from the patient's eye can replicate effectively in human alveolar cells and spread systemically in mice and ferrets, and is lethal.

veNZr8hW2j89cB2g1ptSYA.zh: 2024年第42週(10/14-10/20)全球陽性率約18.9%,陽性率以歐洲區(20.1%)、美洲區(13.5%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 歐洲XEC病例數呈上升趨勢,愛爾蘭最近5週XEC變異株占比約7.1%。 美國主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比持續上升。 墨西哥今年迄今累計13,000例病例,其中638例死亡,病例分布以墨西哥城、克雷塔羅州、新萊昂州及普埃布拉州為多。
veNZr8hW2j89cB2g1ptSYA.en:
Situation update: In week 42 of 2024 (14–20 October), the global positivity rate was about 18.9%, highest in the European Region (20.1%), the Region of the Americas (13.5%) and the African Region (4.4%).

XEC cases are rising in Europe; in Ireland, the XEC variant accounted for about 7.1% over the past 5 weeks.

The main circulating variant in the United States is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants continues to rise.

Mexico has cumulatively reported 13,000 cases this year, including 638 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Mexico City, Querétaro State, Nuevo León State and Puebla State.

QFg8x0xEoJzvZR4jIUBK1A.zh: 美國CDC 10/30公布華盛頓州新增3例H5病例,均與家禽相關,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告39例病例,其中20例與牛隻相關,18例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(16)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(9)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
QFg8x0xEoJzvZR4jIUBK1A.en: On 30 October the US CDC announced 3 new H5 cases in Washington State, all linked to poultry; other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 39 cases so far this year, of which 20 were linked to cattle, 18 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (16), Colorado (10), Washington State (9), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each).

alml793ovjlfkloTnTzSlw.zh: 美國佛羅里達州颶風後疫情持續,截至10/15累計報告70例病例,為去年全年之1.5倍,其中11例死亡,病例分布以皮拉斯郡13例為多。
alml793ovjlfkloTnTzSlw.en: In Florida, United States, outbreaks have continued after the hurricane. As of 15 October, 70 cases had been cumulatively reported, 1.5 times last year's full-year total, including 11 deaths. Cases are most concentrated in Pinellas County, with 13 cases.

QgRX45jh5pJZfg3qgxYRoQ.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至10/18累計3國報告9,829例病例,其中1,075例確診,186例死亡(CFR:17.3%),以奈及利亞報告9,604例、174例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告198例(10例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中,其中賴比瑞亞近期疫情有上升趨勢。 美國愛荷華州10/28公布新增1例死亡病例,研判係自西非移入,當局已加強監測密切接觸者;該國近55年內累計報告8例病例,均具旅遊史,多數症狀輕微。
QgRX45jh5pJZfg3qgxYRoQ.en:
Africa update: As of 18 October this year, 3 countries have cumulatively reported 9,829 cases, including 1,075 confirmed cases and 186 deaths (CFR: 17.3%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 9,604 cases and 174 deaths. Liberia and Guinea reported 198 cases (10 deaths) and 27 cases (2 deaths), respectively. The outbreak continues, and the recent outbreak in Liberia shows an upward trend.

United States update: On 28 October, Iowa announced 1 new fatal case, presumed to have been imported from West Africa, and authorities have strengthened monitoring of close contacts. Over the past 55 years, the country has cumulatively reported 8 cases, all with travel history, and most with mild symptoms.

okx0Y6G--oAAZ31snPg3qQ.zh: 美國CDC 10/28公布華盛頓州及加州各新增1例病例,分別與家禽及牛隻相關,前者已確認屬H5,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該國今年迄今累計報告36例病例,其中20例與牛隻相關,15例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(16)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(6)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
okx0Y6G--oAAZ31snPg3qQ.en: On 28 October the US CDC announced one new case each in Washington State and California, linked to poultry and cattle respectively; the Washington case has been confirmed as H5, and other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 36 cases so far this year, of which 20 were linked to cattle, 15 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (16), Colorado (10), Washington State (6), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each).

WyRZsT8vQnowg1vmZRSW5Q.zh: 美國CDC 10/25公布華盛頓州新增3例病例,均曾接觸家禽,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該國今年累計報告34例病例,其中19例與牛隻相關,14例與家禽相關,1例不明,分布於加州(15)、科羅拉多州(10)、華盛頓州(5)、密西根州(2)、德州及密蘇里州(各1)。
WyRZsT8vQnowg1vmZRSW5Q.en: On 25 October the US CDC announced 3 new cases in Washington State, all with poultry exposure; other epidemiological details were not stated. The country has reported 34 cases so far this year, of which 19 were linked to cattle, 14 to poultry and 1 was unknown. Cases are distributed across California (15), Colorado (10), Washington State (5), Michigan (2), and Texas and Missouri (1 each).

zxD4YD_0Zsasy0t1RTA88A.zh: 美國華盛頓州10/24新增2例H5人類感染案例,均為禽場工人,病原屬2.3.4.4b(D1.1)分支,其餘流病資訊未敘明;該分支與乳牛中流行之B1.13分支不同,主要流行於野禽中,惟引起之症狀與B1.13相。該國今年迄今累計報告31例,其中19例與牛隻相關,11例與家禽相關,1例不明。 美國密蘇里州前於9/6報告1例感染源不明病例,當局針對其6例接觸者(5例醫療人員及1例家庭接觸者)進行血清檢測,檢驗結果均為陰性,排除人傳人之可能性;其中,家庭接觸者於H5中和抗體檢出微弱反應(未達閾),又曾與病患同時出現症狀,顯示可能曾共同接觸病原,惟感染源仍不明。
zxD4YD_0Zsasy0t1RTA88A.en:
On 24 October, Washington State reported 2 new human H5 infections, both in poultry farm workers. The pathogen belongs to clade 2.3.4.4b (D1.1); other epidemiological details were not stated. This clade differs from the B1.13 clade circulating in dairy cattle and is mainly found in wild birds, but the symptoms it causes are similar to those of B1.13. The country has reported 31 cases so far this year, of which 19 were linked to cattle, 11 to poultry and 1 was unknown.

Missouri reported 1 case of unknown source earlier, on 6 September. Serological testing was conducted on its 6 contacts (5 health workers and 1 household contact), and all results were negative, which excludes human-to-human transmission. However, the household contact showed a weak H5 neutralising antibody response (below the cut-off) and had symptoms at the same time as the patient, suggesting possible shared exposure to the pathogen; the source of infection remains unknown.

DmKgw7qHTlr_q948LjD2Pg.zh: 2024年第41週(10/7-10/13)全球陽性率約21.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(22.9%)、美洲區(12.9%)及非洲區(5.2%)為高。 日本第42週(10/14-10/20)病例數持續下降,定醫報告病例數為9,100餘例,每定醫點平均1.86例,第34-37週以KP.3.3變異株占比為高。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比上升。 歐洲區以KP.3.1.1變異株占比最高,其次為XEC變異株。
DmKgw7qHTlr_q948LjD2Pg.en:
Situation update: In week 41 of 2024 (7–13 October), the global positivity rate was about 21.2%, highest in the European Region (22.9%), the Region of the Americas (12.9%) and the African Region (5.2%).

Japan's case numbers continued to decline in week 42 (14–20 October). Sentinel medical institutions reported more than 9,100 cases, an average of 1.86 cases per sentinel site. KP.3.3 accounted for the highest share of variants in weeks 34–37.

In the United States, recent positivity, emergency department visit rates and hospitalization rates have all trended downward. The main circulating variant is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants has risen.

In the European Region, KP.3.1.1 accounts for the highest share of variants, followed by XEC.

8UflsQ4e-36CTFhgJaIyAA.zh: 美國爆發大腸桿菌O157:H7疫情,截至10/23共10州累計報告49例病例,其中10例住院及1例死亡,病例年齡介於13-88歲,多數病例於發病前曾食用某速食連鎖餐廳的漢堡,主要分布於科羅拉多州及內布拉斯加州,目前已對可能引起疫情事件之受污染食材進行調查。
8UflsQ4e-36CTFhgJaIyAA.en: The United States has an outbreak of E. coli O157:H7. As of 23 October, 49 cases had been cumulatively reported from 10 states, including 10 hospitalized and 1 death. Patients are aged 13 to 88 years. Most patients had eaten hamburgers from a fast-food chain restaurant before becoming ill, and cases are mainly distributed in Colorado and Nebraska. Investigations into contaminated ingredients that may have caused the outbreak are under way.

FnT_CbXm89P4h3lmeigDhw.zh: 美國加州10/23新增公布2例確診病例,感染型別及流病資訊未敘明,目前累計達15例;另該國華盛頓州某禽流感陽性禽場10/20通報4例疑病例,均為輕症且已接受治療。
FnT_CbXm89P4h3lmeigDhw.en: On 23 October, California announced 2 new confirmed cases; the infection type and epidemiological information were not stated, and the cumulative total in California has reached 15. In addition, a poultry farm in Washington State that tested positive for avian influenza reported 4 suspected cases on 20 October. All were mild and had received treatment.

W9ddQHSCTvhgbOS1ZzWOJA.zh: 美國今年4至9月疫情上升,所有年齡層報告數均增加,以未成年族群增幅較高,其中以4歲以下族群最為顯著,並於8月達高峰後持續迄今,當局呼籲醫護工作者提高警覺,並注意抗生素之使用。 日本疫情持續上升,單週定醫平均報告數達1.9,為近10年最高,且仍呈陡升趨勢,該國往年疫情高峰多發生於10至12月,峰介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發峰分別為0.9及1.6。
W9ddQHSCTvhgbOS1ZzWOJA.en:
United States: Cases have risen from April to September this year, with increases across all age groups, higher among minors, and most pronounced in children aged 4 and under. The peak occurred in August, and cases have continued since then. Authorities urge healthcare workers to remain alert and to pay attention to antibiotic use.

Japan: Cases continue to rise. The average weekly number of reports per sentinel medical institution reached 1.9, the highest in 10 years, and the curve is still climbing steeply. In past years, Japan's epidemic peaks have mostly occurred between October and December, with peaks between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the previous two outbreaks (2015 and 2016) were 0.9 and 1.6, respectively.

KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年1-9月累計1萬餘例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共9國報告病例,分別為巴西(8,258)、秘魯(936)、古巴(555)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)及蓋亞那(2),另美國(90)及加拿大(2)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例。
KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.en: Americas update: From January to September this year, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both in Brazil. A total of 9 countries reported cases: Brazil (8,258), Peru (936), Cuba (555), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2) and Guyana (2). The United States (90) and Canada (2) also reported cases, all of them imported.

6lsMzKdA5O3wO1c8gjMeqw.zh: 美國加州10/18公布再新增通報2例H5人類感染案例,細節迄未敘明。
6lsMzKdA5O3wO1c8gjMeqw.en: California announced 2 further reported H5 human infection cases on 18 October; details have not been disclosed.

ThQUV210JAlL_uPTCrLHXA.zh: 美國加州新增5例H5人類感染病例,今年截至10/16累計9間乳牛場報告11例病例,均為輕症,僅出現結膜炎症狀,且均曾於農場接觸乳牛。該國今年累計報告25例H5病例(含H5N1),其中15例曾與病牛接觸,9例曾與病禽接觸,1例接觸史不明,分布於加州(11)、科羅拉多州(10)、密西根州(2)、德州(1)及密蘇里州(1)。
ThQUV210JAlL_uPTCrLHXA.en: California reported 5 new H5 human infection cases. As of 16 October this year, 9 dairy farms have reported 11 cases cumulatively this year. All cases were mild, presented only with conjunctivitis, and all had contact with dairy cattle on the farms. The country has reported 25 H5 cases this year (including H5N1) cumulatively: 15 had contact with sick cattle, 9 had contact with sick poultry, and 1 had an unknown exposure history. Cases are distributed across California (11), Colorado (10), Michigan (2), Texas (1) and Missouri (1).

Ww_azonsycr40aEYFA9nRQ.zh: 美國今年疫情較往年為高,截至10/10累計32州報告267例病例,近期有緩和趨勢,病患中41%為5歲以下兒童,88%未接種疫苗或接種史不明,約40%住院,分布以伊利諾州、明蘇達州及奧勒岡州為多。 阿根廷中部內羅河省10/4爆發群聚感染事件,累計報告10例疑病例,其中3例已確診,確診者均為兒童且無疫苗接種史,研判與境外移入病例有關。
Ww_azonsycr40aEYFA9nRQ.en: US cases this year are higher than in previous years. As of 10 October, 267 cases had been reported cumulatively from 32 states, with a recent easing trend. Of the patients, 41% were children under 5 years old, 88% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and about 40% were hospitalized. Cases are concentrated in Illinois, Minnesota and Oregon. In Entre Ríos province in central Argentina, a cluster outbreak occurred on 4 October; 10 suspected cases were reported cumulatively, of which 3 have been confirmed. All confirmed cases were children with no vaccination history, and the outbreak is assessed to be related to an imported case from abroad.

HHHyrJBxlzEU5u6zwJypMg.zh: 美國疫情持續,今年截至第40週(10/5)累計報告17,611例病例,為去年同期之4.4倍,其中以賓州、紐約州、加州、伊利諾州等最為嚴峻。
HHHyrJBxlzEU5u6zwJypMg.en: The outbreak in the United States continues. As of week 40 (5 October) this year, 17,611 cases have been reported cumulatively, 4.4 times the figure for the same period last year. Pennsylvania, New York, California and Illinois are among the hardest-hit states.

CqZD3Eb0HCOYOc3PWHIO3A.zh: 美國加州新增報告2例H5人類感染病例,今年截至10/11累計5乳牛場報告6例病例,均為乳牛場工人,彼此間無密切接觸,僅出現結膜炎症狀;該國今年累計報告20例H5病例,其中10例曾與病牛接觸,9例曾與病禽接觸,1例接觸史不明,分布於科羅拉多州(10)、加州(6)、密西根州(2)、德州(1)及密蘇里州(1)。
CqZD3Eb0HCOYOc3PWHIO3A.en: California reported 2 new H5 human infection cases. As of 11 October this year, 5 dairy farms have reported 6 cases cumulatively this year. All were dairy farm workers with no close contact among them, and all had only conjunctivitis symptoms. The country has reported 20 H5 cases this year, of which 10 had contact with sick cattle, 9 had contact with sick poultry, and 1 had an unknown exposure history. Cases are distributed across Colorado (10), California (6), Michigan (2), Texas (1) and Missouri (1).

sJ9FdRQ3gLAOl1V3cG29dQ.zh: 美國加州中央谷地10/10報告新增1例H5N1人類感染病例,症狀輕微,個案曾接觸受感染的乳牛,該州迄今發生的4例確診病例均位於不同地點的乳牛場。另有2例可能病例之檢體送驗中,當局評估對一般民眾的風險為低,接觸受感染的動物者之感染風險較高。
sJ9FdRQ3gLAOl1V3cG29dQ.en: On 10 October, California's Central Valley reported 1 new mild H5N1 human infection case. The patient had contact with infected dairy cows. The state has had 4 confirmed cases to date, all at different dairy farm locations. Specimens from 2 other possible cases are being tested. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as low, while people who have contact with infected animals face a higher risk of infection.

YhiEV-Jq8Ld1Z0QgQ1ETbQ.zh: 2024年第39週(9/23-9/29)全球陽性率約23.7%,陽性率以歐洲區(25.8%)、美洲區(14.2%)及非洲區(5.0%)為高。 香港第40週(9/29-10/5)陽性率持續下降,於污水監測檢出KP.2、KP.3、JN.1、KP.3.1.1、LB.1、JN.1.7及JN.1.18等變異株。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,亦有檢出XEC變異株呈上升趨勢。
YhiEV-Jq8Ld1Z0QgQ1ETbQ.en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 39 of 2024 (23–29 September) was about 23.7%, highest in the European Region (25.8%), the Region of the Americas (14.2%) and the African Region (5.0%). Hong Kong SAR: the positivity rate continued to decline in week 40 (29 September–5 October), and wastewater surveillance detected variants KP.2, KP.3, JN.1, KP.3.1.1, LB.1, JN.1.7 and JN.1.18. United States: recent positivity rate, emergency department visit rate and hospitalization rate have all been declining. The predominant circulating variant is KP.3.1.1, and the XEC variant, which is on an upward trend, has also been detected.
